ClothingUniformJumpsuitDetectiveGrey.name: detective noir suit
ClothingUniformJumpsuitDetectiveGrey.description: A hard-boiled private investigator's grey suit, complete with tie clip.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitEngineering.name: engineering jumpsuit
ClothingUniformJumpsuitEngineering.description: If this suit was non-conductive, maybe engineers would actually do their damn job.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitEngineeringHazard.name: hazard jumpsuit
ClothingUniformJumpsuitEngineeringHazard.description: Woven in a grungy, warm orange. Lets others around you know that you really mean business when it comes to work.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitHoP.name: head of personnel's jumpsuit
ClothingUniformJumpsuitHoP.description: Rather bland and inoffensive. Perfect for vanishing off the face of the universe.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitHoS.name: head of security's jumpsuit
ClothingUniformJumpsuitHoS.description: It's bright red and rather crisp, much like security's victims tend to be.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitHoSAlt.name: head of security's turtleneck
ClothingUniformJumpsuitHoSAlt.description: It's a turtleneck worn by those strong and disciplined enough to achieve the position of Head of Security.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitHoSBlue.name: head of security's blue jumpsuit
ClothingUniformJumpsuitHoSBlue.description: A blue jumpsuit of Head of Security.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitHoSGrey.name: head of security's grey jumpsuit
ClothingUniformJumpsuitHoSGrey.description: A grey jumpsuit of Head of Security, which make him look somewhat like a passenger.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitHoSParadeMale.name: head of security's parade uniform
ClothingUniformJumpsuitHoSParadeMale.description: A male head of security's luxury-wear, for special occasions.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitHydroponics.name: hydroponics jumpsuit
ClothingUniformJumpsuitHydroponics.description: Has a strong earthy smell to it. Hopefully it's merely dirty as opposed to soiled.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitJanitor.name: janitor jumpsuit
ClothingUniformJumpsuitJanitor.description: The jumpsuit for the poor sop with a mop.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitMedicalDoctor.name: medical doctor jumpsuit
ClothingUniformJumpsuitMedicalDoctor.description: It's made of a special fiber that provides minor protection against biohazards. It has a cross on the chest denoting that the wearer is trained medical personnel.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitParamedic.name: paramedic jumpsuit
ClothingUniformJumpsuitParamedic.description: It's got a plus on it, that's a good thing right?

ClothingUniformJumpsuitBrigmedic.name: brigmedic jumpsuit
ClothingUniformJumpsuitBrigmedic.description: This uniform is issued to qualified personnel who have been trained. No one cares that the training took half a day.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitQM.name: quartermaster's jumpsuit
ClothingUniformJumpsuitQM.description: What can brown do for you?

ClothingUniformJumpsuitQMTurtleneck.name: quartermasters's turtleneck
ClothingUniformJumpsuitQMTurtleneck.description: A sharp turtleneck made for the hardy work environment of supply.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitQMFormal.name: quartermasters's formal suit
ClothingUniformJumpsuitQMFormal.description: Inspired by the quartermasters of military's past, the perfect outfit for supplying a formal occasion.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitResearchDirector.name: research director's turtleneck
ClothingUniformJumpsuitResearchDirector.description: It's a turtleneck worn by those with the know-how to achieve the position of Research Director. Its fabric provides minor protection from biological contaminants.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitScientist.name: scientist jumpsuit
ClothingUniformJumpsuitScientist.description: It's made of a special fiber that increases perceived intelligence and decreases personal ethics. It has markings that denote the wearer as a scientist.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitScientistFormal.name: scientist's formal jumpsuit
ClothingUniformJumpsuitScientistFormal.description: A uniform for sophisticated scientists, best worn with its matching tie.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitRoboticist.name: roboticist jumpsuit
ClothingUniformJumpsuitRoboticist.description: It's a slimming black with reinforced seams; great for industrial work.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitSec.name: security jumpsuit
ClothingUniformJumpsuitSec.description: A jumpsuit made of strong material, providing robust protection.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitSecBlue.name: blue shirt and tie
ClothingUniformJumpsuitSecBlue.description: I'm a little busy right now, Calhoun.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitSecGrey.name: grey security jumpsuit
ClothingUniformJumpsuitSecGrey.description: A tactical relic of years past before military groups decided it was cheaper to dye the suits red instead of washing out the blood.

ClothingUniformSecurityTrooper.name: trooper uniform
ClothingUniformSecurityTrooper.description: A formal uniform issued to the TSF Troopers. It used to come with a car.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitWarden.name: warden's uniform
ClothingUniformJumpsuitWarden.description: A formal security suit for officers complete with Nanotrasen belt buckle.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitLibrarian.name: librarian jumpsuit
ClothingUniformJumpsuitLibrarian.description: A cosy green jumper fit for a curator of books.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitLawyerRed.name: red lawyer suit
ClothingUniformJumpsuitLawyerRed.description: A flashy red suit worn by lawyers and show-offs.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitLawyerBlue.name: blue lawyer suit
ClothingUniformJumpsuitLawyerBlue.description: A flashy blue suit worn by lawyers and show-offs.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitLawyerBlack.name: black lawyer suit
ClothingUniformJumpsuitLawyerBlack.description: A subtle black suit worn by lawyers and gangsters.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitLawyerPurple.name: purple lawyer suit
ClothingUniformJumpsuitLawyerPurple.description: A stylish purple piece worn by lawyers and show people.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitLawyerGood.name: good lawyer's suit
ClothingUniformJumpsuitLawyerGood.description: A tacky suit perfect for a CRIMINAL lawyer!

ClothingUniformJumpsuitPyjamaSyndicateBl.name: black syndicate pyjamas
ClothingUniformJumpsuitPyjamaSyndicateBl.description: For those long nights in perma.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitPyjamaSyndicatePi.name: pink syndicate pyjamas
ClothingUniformJumpsuitPyjamaSyndicatePi.description: For those long nights in perma.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitPyjamaSyndicateRe.name: red syndicate pyjamas
ClothingUniformJumpsuitPyjamaSyndicateRe.description: For those long nights in perma.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitNanotrasen.name: nanotrasen jumpsuit
ClothingUniformJumpsuitNanotrasen.description: A stately blue jumpsuit to represent the NT.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitOperative.name: operative jumpsuit
ClothingUniformJumpsuitOperative.description: Uniform for elite syndicate operatives performing tactical operations in deep space.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitTacticool.name: tacticool jumpsuit
ClothingUniformJumpsuitTacticool.description: Uniform for subpar operative LARPers performing tactical insulated glove theft in deep space.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitMercenary.name: mercenary jumpsuit
ClothingUniformJumpsuitMercenary.description: Clothing for real mercenaries who have gone through fire, water and the jungle of planets flooded with dangerous monsters or targets for which a reward has been assigned.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitNinja.name: ninja jumpsuit
ClothingUniformJumpsuitNinja.description: Comfortable ninja suit, for convenience when relaxing and when you need to practice.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitAtmos.name: atmospheric technician jumpsuit
ClothingUniformJumpsuitAtmos.description: I am at work. I can't leave work. Work is breathing. I am testing air quality.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitAtmosCasual.name: atmospheric technician's casual jumpsuit
ClothingUniformJumpsuitAtmosCasual.description: Might as well relax with a job as easy as yours.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitPsychologist.name: psychologist suit
ClothingUniformJumpsuitPsychologist.description: I don't lose things. I place things in locations which later elude me.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitReporter.name: reporter suit
ClothingUniformJumpsuitReporter.description: A good reporter remains a skeptic all their life.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitJournalist.name: journalist suit
ClothingUniformJumpsuitJournalist.description: If journalism is good, it is controversial, by nature.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitMonasticRobeDark.name: dark monastic robe
ClothingUniformJumpsuitMonasticRobeDark.description: It's a dark robe, often worn by religious folk.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitMonasticRobeLight.name: light monastic robe
ClothingUniformJumpsuitMonasticRobeLight.description: It's a light robe, often worn by religious folk.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitMusician.name: musician's tuxedo
ClothingUniformJumpsuitMusician.description: A fancy tuxedo for the musically inclined.  Perfect for any lounge act!

ClothingUniformJumpsuitERTChaplain.name: ERT chaplain uniform
ClothingUniformJumpsuitERTChaplain.description: A special suit made for Central Command's elite chaplain corps.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitERTEngineer.name: ERT engineering uniform
ClothingUniformJumpsuitERTEngineer.description: A special suit made for the elite engineers under CentComm.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitERTJanitor.name: ERT janitorial uniform
ClothingUniformJumpsuitERTJanitor.description: A special suit made for the elite janitors under CentComm.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitERTLeader.name: ERT leader uniform
ClothingUniformJumpsuitERTLeader.description: A special suit made for the best of the elites under CentComm.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitERTMedic.name: ERT medical uniform
ClothingUniformJumpsuitERTMedic.description: A special suit made for the elite medics under CentComm.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitERTSecurity.name: ERT security uniform
ClothingUniformJumpsuitERTSecurity.description: A special suit made for the elite security under CentComm.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitPirate.name: pirate slops
ClothingUniformJumpsuitPirate.description: A pirate variation of a space sailor's jumpsuit.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitCossack.name: cossack suit
ClothingUniformJumpsuitCossack.description: The good old pants and brigantine.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitSyndieFormal.name: syndicate formal suit
ClothingUniformJumpsuitSyndieFormal.description: The syndicate's uniform is made in an elegant style, it's even a pity to do dirty tricks in this.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitSeniorEngineer.name: senior engineer jumpsuit
ClothingUniformJumpsuitSeniorEngineer.description: A sign of skill and prestige within the engineering department.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitSeniorResearcher.name: senior researcher jumpsuit
ClothingUniformJumpsuitSeniorResearcher.description: A sign of skill and prestige within the science department.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitSeniorPhysician.name: senior physician jumpsuit
ClothingUniformJumpsuitSeniorPhysician.description: A sign of skill and prestige within the medical department.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitSeniorOfficer.name: senior officer jumpsuit
ClothingUniformJumpsuitSeniorOfficer.description: A sign of skill and prestige within the security department.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitWeb.name: web jumpsuit
ClothingUniformJumpsuitWeb.description: Makes it clear that you are one with the webs.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitLoungewear.name: loungewear
ClothingUniformJumpsuitLoungewear.description: A long stretch of fabric that wraps around your body for comfort.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitGladiator.name: gladiator uniform
ClothingUniformJumpsuitGladiator.description: Made for true gladiators (or Ash Walkers).

ClothingUniformJumpsuitCasualBlue.name: casual blue jumpsuit
ClothingUniformJumpsuitCasualBlue.description: A loose worn blue shirt with a grey pants, perfect for someone looking to relax.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitCasualPurple.name: casual purple jumpsuit
ClothingUniformJumpsuitCasualPurple.description: A loose worn purple shirt with a grey pants, perfect for someone looking to relax.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitCasualRed.name: casual red jumpsuit
ClothingUniformJumpsuitCasualRed.description: A loose worn red shirt with a grey pants, perfect for someone looking to relax.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitCasualGreen.name: casual green jumpsuit
ClothingUniformJumpsuitCasualGreen.description: A loose worn green shirt with a grey pants, perfect for someone looking to relax.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitFamilyGuy.name: familiar garbs
ClothingUniformJumpsuitFamilyGuy.description: Makes you remember the time you did something funny.

UniformScrubsColorPurple.name: purple scrubs
UniformScrubsColorPurple.description: A combination of comfort and utility intended to make removing every last organ someone has and selling them to a space robot much more official looking.

UniformScrubsColorGreen.name: green scrubs
UniformScrubsColorGreen.description: A combination of comfort and utility intended to make removing every last organ someone has and selling them to a space robot much more official looking.

UniformScrubsColorBlue.name: blue scrubs
UniformScrubsColorBlue.description: A combination of comfort and utility intended to make removing every last organ someone has and selling them to a space robot much more official looking.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitRecruitNT.name: recruit jumpsuit
ClothingUniformJumpsuitRecruitNT.description: A classy grey jumpsuit with blue trims. Perfect for the dignified helper.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitRecruitSyndie.name: syndicate recruit jumpsuit
ClothingUniformJumpsuitRecruitSyndie.description: A dubious, dark-grey jumpsuit. As if passengers weren't dubious enough already.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitRepairmanNT.name: repairman jumpsuit
ClothingUniformJumpsuitRepairmanNT.description: A jumpsuit that reminds you of a certain crew-sector work position. Hopefully, you won't have to do the same job as THOSE freaks.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitRepairmanSyndie.name: syndicate repairman jumpsuit
ClothingUniformJumpsuitRepairmanSyndie.description: Functional, fashionable, and badass. Nanotrasen's engineers wish they could look as good as this.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitParamedicNT.name: paramedic jumpsuit
ClothingUniformJumpsuitParamedicNT.description: A basic white & blue jumpsuit made for Nanotrasen paramedics stationed in combat sectors.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitParamedicSyndie.name: syndicate paramedic jumpsuit
ClothingUniformJumpsuitParamedicSyndie.description: For some reason, wearing this makes you feel like you're awfully close to violating the Geneva Convention.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitChiefEngineerNT.name: chief engineer jumpsuit
ClothingUniformJumpsuitChiefEngineerNT.description: It is often joked that the role of the combat-sector Chief Engineer is where the actual, logistically-minded engineers are promoted to. Good luck.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitChiefEngineerSynd.name: syndicate chief engineer jumpsuit
ClothingUniformJumpsuitChiefEngineerSynd.description: An evil-looking jumpsuit with a reflective vest & red undershirt.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitChameleon.name: black jumpsuit
ClothingUniformJumpsuitChameleon.description: A generic black jumpsuit with no rank markings.

DrinkMeth.name: meth
DrinkMeth.description: Just a whole glass of meth.

ToolDebug.name: spanish army knife
ToolDebug.description: The pain of using this is almost too great to bear.

Acidifier.name: acid
Acidifier.description: Melts you into a puddle of yuck!

PortalRed.name: PortalRed
PortalRed.description: This one looks more like a redspace portal.

RadiationPulse.name: shimmering anomaly
RadiationPulse.description: Looking at this anomaly makes you feel strange, like something is pushing at your eyes.

FtlVisualizerEntity.name: FtlVisualizerEntity
FtlVisualizerEntity.description: Visualizer for shuttles arriving. You shouldn't see this!

AtmosFixFreezerMarker.name: Atmos Fix Freezer Marker
AtmosFixFreezerMarker.description: Change air temp to 235K, for freezer with a bit of wiggle room to get set up.

BorgChassisSyndicateAssault.name: syndicate assault cyborg
BorgChassisSyndicateAssault.description: A lean, mean killing machine with access to a variety of deadly modules.

BorgChassisSyndicateMedical.name: syndicate medical cyborg
BorgChassisSyndicateMedical.description: A combat medical cyborg. Has limited offensive potential, but makes more than up for it with its support capabilities.

BorgChassisSyndicateSaboteur.name: syndicate saboteur cyborg
BorgChassisSyndicateSaboteur.description: A streamlined engineering cyborg, equipped with covert modules. Its chameleon projector lets it disguise itself as a Nanotrasen cyborg.

BorgChassisDerelict.name: derelict cyborg
BorgChassisDerelict.description: A man-machine hybrid that assists in station activity. This one is in a state of great disrepair.

MobBat.name: bat
MobBat.description: Some cultures find them terrifying, others crunchy on the teeth.

MobBee.name: bee
MobBee.description: Nice to have, but you can't build a civilization on a foundation of honey alone.

MobAngryBee.name: bee
MobAngryBee.description: How nice a bee. Oh no, it looks angry and wants my pizza.

MobChicken.name: chicken
MobChicken.description: Comes before an egg, and IS a dinosaur!

MobCockroach.name: cockroach
MobCockroach.description: This station is just crawling with bugs.

MobGlockroach.name: glockroach
MobGlockroach.description: This station is just crawling with bu- OH GOD THAT COCKROACH HAS A GUN!!!

MobMothroach.name: mothroach
MobMothroach.description: This is the adorable by-product of multiple attempts at genetically mixing mothpeople with cockroaches.

MobDuckMallard.name: mallard duck
MobDuckMallard.description: An adorable mallard duck, it's fluffy and soft!

MobDuckWhite.name: white duck
MobDuckWhite.description: An adorable white duck, it's fluffy and soft!

MobDuckBrown.name: brown duck
MobDuckBrown.description: An adorable brown duck, it's fluffy and soft!

MobButterfly.name: butterfly
MobButterfly.description: Despite popular misconceptions, it's not actually made of butter.

MobCrab.name: crab
MobCrab.description: A folk legend goes around that his claw snaps spacemen out of existence over distasteful remarks. Be polite and tolerant for your own safety.

MobGoat.name: goat
MobGoat.description: Her spine consists of long sharp segments, no wonder she is so grumpy.

MobGoose.name: goose
MobGoose.description: Its stomach and mind are an enigma beyond human comprehension.

MobGorilla.name: gorilla
MobGorilla.description: Smashes, roars, looks cool. Don't stand near one.

MobKangaroo.name: kangaroo
MobKangaroo.description: A large marsupial herbivore. It has powerful hind legs, with nails that resemble long claws.

MobMonkey.name: monkey
MobMonkey.description: New church of neo-darwinists actually believe that EVERY animal evolved from a monkey. Tastes like pork, and killing them is both fun and relaxing.

MobBaseSyndicateMonkey.name: monkey
MobBaseSyndicateMonkey.description: New church of neo-darwinists actually believe that EVERY animal evolved from a monkey. Tastes like pork, and killing them is both fun and relaxing.

MobKobold.name: kobold
MobKobold.description: Cousins to the sentient race of lizard people, kobolds blend in with their natural habitat and are as nasty as monkeys; ready to pull out your hair and stab you to death.

MobGuidebookMonkey.name: guidebook monkey
MobGuidebookMonkey.description: A hopefully helpful monkey whose only purpose in life is for you to click on. Does this count as having a monkey give you a tutorial?

MobSlug.name: slug
MobSlug.description: And they called this a lizard?

MobParrot.name: parrot
MobParrot.description: Infiltrates your domain, spies on you, and somehow still a cool pet.

MobPenguin.name: penguin
MobPenguin.description: Their lives are constant pain due to their inner-body knees.

MobGrenadePenguin.name: grenade penguin
MobGrenadePenguin.description: A small penguin with a grenade strapped around its neck. Harvested by the Syndicate from icy shit-hole planets.

MobGiantSpider.name: tarantula
MobGiantSpider.description: Widely recognized to be the literal worst thing in existence.

MobClownSpider.name: clown spider
MobClownSpider.description: Combines the two most terrifying things in existence, spiders and clowns.

MobGiantSpiderWizard.name: wizard spider
MobGiantSpiderWizard.description: This spider looks a little magical

MobCatSpace.name: space cat
MobCatSpace.description: Feline pet, prepared for the worst.

MobSloth.name: sloth
MobSloth.description: Very slow animal. For people with low energy.

MobDionaNymph.name: diona nymph
MobDionaNymph.description: It's like a cat, only.... branch-ier.

MobReindeerBuck.name: reindeer buck
MobReindeerBuck.description: You think it can pull a sleigh?

MobArgocyteSlurva.name: slurva
MobArgocyteSlurva.description: A pathetic creature, incapable of doing much.

MobArgocyteSkitter.name: skitter
MobArgocyteSkitter.description: A devious little alien... Make sure they don't run off with your rations!

MobArgocyteSwiper.name: swiper
MobArgocyteSwiper.description: Where did that stack of steel go?

MobArgocyteCrawler.name: crawler
MobArgocyteCrawler.description: Deadly, pack-animals that maul unsuspecting travelers.

MobGoliath.name: goliath
MobGoliath.description: A massive beast that uses long tentacles to ensnare its prey, threatening them is not advised under any conditions.

ActionGoliathTentacle.name: [color=red]Tentacle Slam[/color]
ActionGoliathTentacle.description: Use your tentacles to grab and stun a target player!

MobHivelord.name: hivelord
MobHivelord.description: A truly alien creature, it is a mass of unknown organic material, constantly fluctuating. When attacking, pieces of it split off and attack in tandem with the original.

MobHivelordBrood.name: hivelord brood
MobHivelordBrood.description: A fragment of the original hivelord, rallying behind its original. One isn't much of a threat, but...

FoodHivelordRemains.name: hivelord remains
FoodHivelordRemains.description: All that remains of a hivelord, it seems to be what allows it to break pieces of itself off without being hurt... its healing properties will soon become inert if not used quickly. Try not to think about what you're eating.

FoodHivelordRemainsInert.name: inert hivelord remains
FoodHivelordRemainsInert.description: All that remains of a hivelord... Now all is truly lost.

MobCarpMagic.name: magicarp
MobCarpMagic.description: Looks like some kind of fish. Might be magical.

MobCarpHolo.name: holocarp
MobCarpHolo.description: Carp made out of holographic energies. Sadly for you, it is very much real.

MobShark.name: sharkminnow
MobShark.description: A dangerous shark from the blackness of endless space, who loves to drink blood.

MobQuartzCrab.name: MobQuartzCrab
MobQuartzCrab.description: An ore crab made from Quartz.

MobIronCrab.name: MobIronCrab
MobIronCrab.description: An ore crab made from iron.

MobUraniumCrab.name: MobUraniumCrab
MobUraniumCrab.description: An ore crab made from uranium.

MobSilverCrab.name: ore crab
MobSilverCrab.description: An ore crab made from silver.

ReagentSlime.name: reagent slime
ReagentSlime.description: It consists of a liquid, and it wants to dissolve you in itself.

MobAbomination.name: abomination
MobAbomination.description: A rejected clone, in constant pain and seeking revenge.

MobWatcherPride.name: pride watcher
MobWatcherPride.description: This rare subspecies only appears in June.

MobLuminousObject.name: luminous object
MobLuminousObject.description: A small glowing object that causes burns on the skin with its glow.

MobLuminousEntity.name: luminous entity
MobLuminousEntity.description: A blinding translucent entity, the bright eye seems dangerous and scalding.

MobTomatoKiller.name: tomato killer
MobTomatoKiller.description: Looks like it's not you eating tomatoes today, it's the tomatoes eating you.

MobCorgiIanOld.name: Old Ian
MobCorgiIanOld.description: Still the favorite pet corgi. Love his wheels.

MobCatException.name: Exception
MobCatException.description: Ask nicely, and maybe they'll give you one of their spare lives.

MobMcGriff.name: McGriff
MobMcGriff.description: This dog can tell something smells around here, and that something is CRIME!

MobPaperwork.name: Paperwork
MobPaperwork.description: Took up a new job sorting books in the library after he got transferred from Space Station 13. He seems to be just as slow at this.

MobWalter.name: Walter
MobWalter.description: He likes chems and treats. Walter.

MobPossumMorty.name: Morty
MobPossumMorty.description: The station's resident Didelphis virginiana. A sensitive but resilient kind of guy.

MobPossumPoppy.name: Poppy
MobPossumPoppy.description: It's an opossum, a small scavenging marsupial. It's wearing appropriate personal protective equipment.

MobRaccoonMorticia.name: Morticia
MobRaccoonMorticia.description: A powerful creature of the night. Her eyeshadow is always on point.

MobHamsterHamlet.name: Hamlet
MobHamsterHamlet.description: A grumpy, cute and fluffy hamster.

MobSpiderShiva.name: Shiva
MobSpiderShiva.description: The first defender of the station.

MobSlimesPet.name: Smile
MobSlimesPet.description: This masterpiece has gone through thousands of experiments. But it is the sweetest creature in the world. Smile Slime!

MobMonkeyPunpun.name: Pun Pun
MobMonkeyPunpun.description: A prominent representative of monkeys with unlimited access to alcohol.

MobCrabAtmos.name: Tropico
MobCrabAtmos.description: The noble and stalwart defender of Atmosia. Viva!

MobRatKing.name: rat king
MobRatKing.description: He's da rat. He make da roolz.

MobRatServant.name: rat servant
MobRatServant.description: He's da mini rat. He don't make da roolz.

ActionRatKingRaiseArmy.name: Raise Army
ActionRatKingRaiseArmy.description: Spend some hunger to summon an allied rat to help defend you.

ActionRatKingDomain.name: Rat King's Domain
ActionRatKingDomain.description: Spend some hunger to release a cloud of ammonia into the air.

ActionRatKingOrderStay.name: Stay
ActionRatKingOrderStay.description: Command your army to stand in place.

ActionRatKingOrderFollow.name: Follow
ActionRatKingOrderFollow.description: Command your army to follow you around.

ActionRatKingOrderCheeseEm.name: Cheese 'Em
ActionRatKingOrderCheeseEm.description: Command your army to attack whoever you point at.

ActionRatKingOrderLoose.name: Loose
ActionRatKingOrderLoose.description: Command your army to act at their own will.

MobCatShadow.name: shadow cat
MobCatShadow.description: A lovely piece of darkness. Hope he doesn't bring you a curse.

MobFireBot.name: firebot
MobFireBot.description: A little fire extinguishing bot. He looks rather anxious.

MobCleanBot.name: cleanbot
MobCleanBot.description: The creep of automation now threatening space janitors.

MobMedibot.name: medibot
MobMedibot.description: No substitute for a doctor, but better than nothing.

MobMimeBot.name: mimebot
MobMimeBot.description: Why not give the mimebot a friendly wave?

MobBearSpace.name: space bear
MobBearSpace.description: It looks friendly. Why don't you give it a hug?

MobKangarooSpace.name: space kangaroo
MobKangarooSpace.description: It looks friendly. Why don't you give it a hug?

MobSpiderSpace.name: space spider
MobSpiderSpace.description: It's so glowing, it looks dangerous.

MobCobraSpace.name: space cobra
MobCobraSpace.description: Long fangs and a glowing hood, and the alluring look begs to come closer.

MobTick.name: space tick
MobTick.description: It's a space tick, watch out for its nasty bite. CentComm reports that 90 percent of cargo leg amputations are due to space tick bites.

MobXeno.name: burrower
MobXeno.description: They mostly come at night. Mostly.

MobPurpleSnake.name: space adder
MobPurpleSnake.description: A menacing purple snake from Kepler-283c.

MobSmallPurpleSnake.name: space adder
MobSmallPurpleSnake.description: A smaller version of the menacing purple snake from Kepler-283c.

ActionSpawnRift.name: Summon Carp Rift
ActionSpawnRift.description: Summons a carp rift that will periodically spawns carps.

ActionDevour.name: [color=red]Devour[/color]
ActionDevour.description: Attempt to break a structure with your jaws or swallow a creature.

ActionDragonsBreath.name: [color=orange]Dragon's Breath[/color]
ActionDragonsBreath.description: Spew out flames at anyone foolish enough to attack you!

MobHoloparasiteGuardian.name: Holoparasite
MobHoloparasiteGuardian.description: A mesmerising whirl of hard-light patterns weaves a marvelous, yet oddly familiar visage. It stands proud, tuning into its owner's life to sustain itself.

MobIfritGuardian.name: Ifrit

ToyFigurineChiefMedicalOfficer.description: A figurine depicting the glorious head of the Medical department.

ToyFigurineChemist.name: chemist figure

PlushieGhost.name: ghost soft toy
PlushieGhost.description: The start of your personal GHOST GANG!

PlushieGhostRevenant.name: revenant soft toy
PlushieGhostRevenant.description: So soft it almost makes you want to take a nap...

PlushieBee.name: bee plushie
PlushieBee.description: A cute toy that resembles an even cuter programmer. You'd have to be a monster to grind this up.

PlushieHampter.name: hampter plushie
PlushieHampter.description: A cute stuffed toy that resembles a hamster. Its face looks squished.

PlushieRGBee.name: RGBee plushie
PlushieRGBee.description: A cute toy that resembles a bee plushie while you're on LSD.

PlushieNuke.name: nukie plushie
PlushieNuke.description: A stuffed toy that resembles a syndicate nuclear operative. The tag claims operatives to be purely fictitious.

PlushieArachind.name: arachnid plushie
PlushieArachind.description: An adorable stuffed toy that resembles an arachnid. It feels silky..

PlushieLizard.name: lizard plushie
PlushieLizard.description: An adorable stuffed toy that resembles a lizardperson. Made by CentComm as a token initiative to combat speciesism in work environments. "Welcome your new colleagues as you do this plush, with open arms!"

PlushieRainbowLizard.name: rainbow lizard plushie
PlushieRainbowLizard.description: An adorable stuffed toy that resembles a lizardperson of every color. You just might trip while staring at it...

PlushieSpaceLizard.name: space lizard plushie
PlushieSpaceLizard.description: An adorable stuffed toy that resembles a lizardperson in an EVA suit. Made by CentComm as a token initiative to combat speciesism in space environments. "Welcome your new colleges as you do this plush, with open arms!"

PlushieLizardInversed.name: drazil plushie
PlushieLizardInversed.description: An adorable stuffed toy that resembles a lizardperson from an inversed dimension. Hew!

PlushieDiona.name: diona plushie
PlushieDiona.description: An adorable stuffed toy that resembles a diona. Love water and cuddles. Do not wet!

PlushieSharkBlue.name: blue shark soft toy
PlushieSharkBlue.description: Big and safe to have by your side if you want to discover the world below the surface of the ocean.

PlushieSharkGrey.name: grey shark soft toy
PlushieSharkGrey.description: A quiet, reserved kind of shonk. Loves to ride the grey tide.

PlushieNar.name: nar'sie plushie

PlushieRainbowCarp.name: rainbow carp plushie

PlushieHolocarp.name: holocarp plushie

PlushieSlime.name: slime plushie
PlushieSlime.description: An adorable stuffed toy that resembles a slime. It's basically a hacky sack.

PlushieSnake.name: snake plushie
PlushieSnake.description: An adorable stuffed toy that resembles a snake.

ToyRubberDuck.name: rubber ducky
ToyRubberDuck.description: Not carried here by ocean currents.

PlushieAtmosian.name: atmosian plushie
PlushieAtmosian.description: An adorable stuffed toy that resembles a brave atmosian. Unfortunately, he won't fix those depressurizations for you.

PlushieXeno.name: xeno plushie
PlushieXeno.description: An adorable stuffed toy that resembles a scary xenomorf. You're lucky it's just a toy.

PlushieHuman.name: human plushie
PlushieHuman.description: This is a felt plush of a human. All craftsmanship is of the lowest quality. The human is naked. The human is crying. The human is screaming.

PlushieMoth.name: moth plushie
PlushieMoth.description: Cute and fluffy moth plushie. Enjoy, bz!

ToyNuke.name: nuke toy
ToyNuke.description: A plastic model of a Nuclear Fission Explosive. No uranium included... probably.

ToyIan.name: ian toy
ToyIan.description: Unable to eat, but just as fluffy as the real guy!

FoamCrossbow.name: foam crossbow
FoamCrossbow.description: Aiming this at Security may get you filled with lead.

RevolverCapGunFake.name: cap gun
RevolverCapGunFake.description: Looks almost like the real thing! Ages 8 and up.

FoamBlade.name: foamblade
FoamBlade.description: It says "Sternside Changs number 1 fan" on it.

BeachBall.name: beach ball

BalloonSyn.name: syndie balloon
BalloonSyn.description: Handed out to the bravest souls who survived the "atomic twister" ride at Syndieland.

BalloonNT.name: wayward balloon
BalloonNT.description: Specially designed to inflict maximum psychological damage.

BalloonCorgi.name: corgi balloon
BalloonCorgi.description: Just like owning a real dog - but a lot floatier.

PonderingOrbWizard.description: Ponderous, man... Really ponderous. Magically shows the station's camera network.

FoamCutlass.description: Cosplay as a pirate and force your friends to walk the plank.

ClownRecorder.description: When you just can't get those laughs coming the natural way!

NewtonCradle.description: A device bored paper pushers use to remind themselves that time did not stop yet. Contains gravity.

RubberChicken.name: rubber chicken
RubberChicken.description: A stress inducing parody of nature's most delectable avian.

SecurityWhistle.name: SecurityWhistle
SecurityWhistle.description: Sound of it make you feel fear.

SyndicateWhistle.name: trench whistle
SyndicateWhistle.description: A whistle used by Syndicate commanders to draw attention. Avanti!

SheetRPGlass.name: reinforced plasma glass
SheetRPGlass.description: A reinforced sheet of translucent plasma.

SheetClockworkGlass.name: clockwork glass

SheetBrass.name: brass
SheetBrass.description: A sheet of brass, primarily used by clockwork enthusiasts and the remnants of Ratvarian cults.

MaterialHideCorgi.name: corgi hide
MaterialHideCorgi.description: Luxury pelt used in only the most elite fashion. Rumors say this is found when a corgi is sent to the nice farm.

MaterialToothSpaceCarp.name: space carp tooth
MaterialToothSpaceCarp.description: Pretty small but plenty nasty. You like them best when they're not sinking into you.

MaterialToothSharkminnow.name: sharkminnow tooth
MaterialToothSharkminnow.description: Looks sharp. Sharp enough to poke someone's eye out. Holy fuck it's big.

MaterialGoliathHide.name: goliath hide plates
MaterialGoliathHide.description: Pieces of a goliath's rocky hide, these might be able to make your suit a bit more durable to attack from the local fauna.

ScrapSteel.name: blasted steel pile
ScrapSteel.description: A pile of steel welded together in extreme heat. It's of a decent size overall; you could probably get a fair amount of sheets out of it.

ScrapGlass.name: fried circuitry
ScrapGlass.description: A huge lump of various circuits, strangely fused together. You could likely extract some materials out of this.

ScrapAirlock1.name: airlock door
ScrapAirlock1.description: This used to keep air in. Now it doesn't seem to be doing anything at all.

ScrapAirlock2.name: airlock light
ScrapAirlock2.description: Serves it right for flashing red all those times.

ScrapCanister1.name: canister handle
ScrapCanister1.description: Helpful for holding a canister. Now you just need the actual canister part.

ScrapCanister2.name: canister valve
ScrapCanister2.description: A valve from a gas canister.

ScrapCloset.name: closet door
ScrapCloset.description: A blown off door from a maintenance closet. Looks like a nice piece of wall decor.

ScrapFaxMachine.name: fax machine
ScrapFaxMachine.description: The unfortunate result of one too many ASCII arts being sent to Central Command.

ScrapFireExtinguisher.name: split fire extinguisher
ScrapFireExtinguisher.description: The large gash down the center makes you worry for the previous user.

ScrapFirelock1.name: firelock door
ScrapFirelock1.description: At least you still know what it's meant for.

ScrapFirelock2.name: firelock door
ScrapFirelock2.description: OH! That's where the other half went!

ScrapIntercom.name: intercom scrap
ScrapIntercom.description: You wish it at least came with some encryption keys.

ScrapJetpack.name: busted jetpack
ScrapJetpack.description: Looks like it won't be flying any more.

ScrapMedkit.name: snapped medkit
ScrapMedkit.description: Hopefully they got some use out of it.

ScrapPAI.name: personal ai device
ScrapPAI.description: A buddy! You still in there? Hello? Buddy???

ScrapPAIGold.name: gilded personal ai device
ScrapPAIGold.description: Wow! What a one-in-a-million find! This would be worth a fortune... if it was in good condition.

ScrapTube.name: shattered sample tube
ScrapTube.description: A glass tube containing some kind of rare sample. Or at least, it used to contain it. Not much left in there now.

ScrapGeneratorPlasmaLeaking.name: leaking P.A.C.M.A.N. generator
ScrapGeneratorPlasmaLeaking.description: An old looking P.A.C.M.A.N. generator whos plasma tanks started leaking.

ScrapGeneratorPlasma.name: old P.A.C.M.A.N. generator
ScrapGeneratorPlasma.description: An old looking P.A.C.M.A.N. generator. It's in very poor condition and non functional.

ScrapGeneratorUranium.name: destroyed S.U.P.E.R.P.A.C.M.A.N. generator
ScrapGeneratorUranium.description: A S.U.P.E.R.P.A.C.M.A.N. generator that appears to have had some kind of catastrophic failure.

ScrapGeneratorFrame.name: generator frame
ScrapGeneratorFrame.description: A frame of a P.A.C.M.A.N. or S.U.P.E.R.P.A.C.M.A.N. type generator. Where is the rest of it?

ScrapGeneratorFuelTank.name: fuel tank

ScrapGeneratorFuelTankPlasma.name: ScrapGeneratorFuelTankPlasma
ScrapGeneratorFuelTankPlasma.description: A fuel tank from a portable generator. The gauge indicates it's got a little plasma left.

ShardGlassUranium.description: A small piece of uranium glass.

ShardGlassClockwork.name: clockwork glass shard
ShardGlassClockwork.description: A small piece of brass-infused glass.

ArabianLamp.description: Why the heck won't this piece of junk open!?

BedsheetCaptain.name: captain's bedsheet
BedsheetCaptain.description: It has a Nanotrasen symbol on it, and was woven with a revolutionary new kind of thread guaranteed to have 0.01% permeability for most non-chemical substances, popular among most modern captains.

BedsheetCE.name: CE's bedsheet
BedsheetCE.description: It's decorated with a wrench emblem. It's highly reflective and stain resistant, so you don't need to worry about ruining it with oil.

BedsheetCentcom.name: CentComm bedsheet
BedsheetCentcom.description: Woven with advanced nanothread for warmth as well as being very decorated, essential for all officials.

BedsheetClown.name: clown's bedsheet
BedsheetClown.description: A rainbow blanket with a clown mask woven in. It smells faintly of bananas.

BedsheetCMO.name: CMO's bedsheet
BedsheetCMO.description: It's a sterilized blanket that has a cross emblem. There's some cat fur on it, likely from Runtime.

BedsheetCosmos.name: cosmos bedsheet
BedsheetCosmos.description: Made from the dreams of those who wonder at the stars.

BedsheetCult.name: cult bedsheet
BedsheetCult.description: You might dream of Nar'Sie if you sleep with this. It seems rather tattered and glows of an eldritch presence.

BedsheetHOP.name: HOP's bedsheet
BedsheetHOP.description: It's decorated with a key emblem. For those rare moments when you can rest and cuddle with Ian without someone screaming for you over the radio.

BedsheetHOS.name: HOS's bedsheet
BedsheetHOS.description: It's decorated with a shield emblem. While crime doesn't sleep, you do, but you are still THE LAW!

BedsheetMedical.name: medical bedsheet
BedsheetMedical.description: It's a sterilized blanket commonly used in the Medbay. Sterilization is voided if a virologist is present onboard the station.

BedsheetMime.name: mime's bedsheet
BedsheetMime.description: A very soothing striped blanket.  All the noise just seems to fade out when you're under the covers in this.

BedsheetNT.name: NT bedsheet
BedsheetNT.description: It has the Nanotrasen logo on it and an aura of duty.

BedsheetRD.name: RD's bedsheet
BedsheetRD.description: It appears to have a beaker emblem, and is made out of fire-resistant material, although it probably won't protect you in the event of fires you're familiar with every day.

BedsheetSyndie.name: syndicate bedsheet
BedsheetSyndie.description: It has a syndicate emblem and it has an aura of evil.

BedsheetWiz.name: wizard's bedsheet
BedsheetWiz.description: A special fabric enchanted with magic so you can have an enchanted night. It even glows!

BookSpaceEncyclopedia.name: space encyclopedia
BookSpaceEncyclopedia.description: An encyclopedia containing all the knowledge. The author of this encyclopedia is unknown.

BookBartendersManual.name: bartender's manual
BookBartendersManual.description: This manual is stained with beer.

BookHowToCookForFortySpaceman.name: How To Cook For Forty Spacemen
BookHowToCookForFortySpaceman.description: A book about cooking written by a space chef.

BookLeafLoversSecret.name: leaf lover's secret
BookLeafLoversSecret.description: It has a strong weed smell. It motivates you to feed and seed.

BookEngineersHandbook.name: engineer's handbook
BookEngineersHandbook.description: A handbook about engineering written by an TSF-NT senior engineer.

BookScientistsGuidebook.name: scientist's guidebook
BookScientistsGuidebook.description: A guidebook about science written by a TSF-NT scientist.

BookSecurity.name: security 101
BookSecurity.description: A book about security written by a washed-out TSF-NT detective. The book is stained with blood. It seems to have been used more as a weapon than reading material.

BookHowToRockAndStone.name: how to rock and stone
BookHowToRockAndStone.description: A very detailed guide about salvage written by Karl, a legendary space miner, however he's missing. It motivates you to rock and stone.

BookMedicalReferenceBook.name: medical reference book
BookMedicalReferenceBook.description: A reference book about medical written by an old doctor. The handwriting is barely comprehensible.

BookHowToSurvive.name: how to survive
BookHowToSurvive.description: Ironically the author of this book is dead.

BookChemicalCompendium.name: chempendium
BookChemicalCompendium.description: A comprehensive guide written by some old skeleton of a professor about chemical synthesis.

BookSpaceLaw.name: space law
BookSpaceLaw.description: A set of Nanotrasen guidelines for keeping law and order on their space stations.

BookRandom.name: BookRandom
BookRandom.description: Each book is unique! What is hidden in this one?

BookAtmosDistro.name: Newton's Guide to Atmos: The Distro
BookAtmosDistro.description: There are endless illegible notes scribbled in the margins. Most of the text is covered in handwritten question marks.

BookAtmosWaste.name: Newton's Guide to Atmos: Waste
BookAtmosWaste.description: There are endless illegible notes scribbled in the margins. Most of the text is covered in handwritten question marks.

BookAtmosAirAlarms.name: Newton's Guide to Atmos: Air Alarms
BookAtmosAirAlarms.description: There are endless illegible notes scribbled in the margins. Most of the text is covered in handwritten question marks.

BookAtmosVentsMore.name: Newton's Guide to Atmos: Vents and More
BookAtmosVentsMore.description: There are endless illegible notes scribbled in the margins. Most of the text is covered in handwritten question marks.

BookNarsieLegend.name: the legend of nar'sie
BookNarsieLegend.description: The book is an old, leather-bound tome with intricate engravings on the cover. The pages are yellowed and fragile with age, with the ink of the text faded in some places. It appears to have been well-read and well-loved, with dog-eared pages and marginalia scrawled in the margins. Despite its aged appearance, the book still exudes a sense of mystical power and wonder, hinting at the secrets and knowledge contained within its pages.

BookTruth.name: exploring different philosophical perspectives on truth and the complexity of lying
BookTruth.description: A book exploring the different philosophical perspectives on truth and lying has a worn cover, with creases and marks indicating frequent use and thoughtful contemplation. The spine shows signs of wear from being pulled off the shelf again and again. The pages themselves are filled with underlines, notes in the margins, and highlighted passages as readers grapple with the nuances and complexities of the topic.

BookWorld.name: shaping the state of the world - interplay of forces and choices
BookWorld.description: The book is a well-preserved hardcover with a simple, elegant design on the cover, depicting the image of a world in motion. The pages are crisp and clean, with no signs of wear or tear, suggesting that it has been well-cared for and valued by its previous owner. The text is printed in a clear, legible font, and the chapters are organized in a logical and easy-to-follow manner, making it accessible to readers of all levels of expertise.

BookIanAntarctica.name: adventures of robert & ian - exploring antarctica
BookIanAntarctica.description: The book is a small paperback in good condition, with an illustration of Ian the corgi and the colony of penguins on the cover. The title, "Ian and Robert's Antarctic Adventure", is written in bold white letters against a blue background. The back cover features a brief summary of the story, highlighting the themes of humility, resilience, and the beauty of nature.

BookSlothClownSSS.name: the sloth and the clown - space station shenanigans
BookSlothClownSSS.description: The book looks new, with a glossy cover featuring Chuckles the clown and Snuggles the sloth floating in space with a backdrop of stars and planets. Chuckles is dressed in his banana costume and Snuggles is sleeping on a hammock made of space ropes. The title "The Sloth and the Clown - Space Station Shenanigans" is written in bold and colorful letters.

BookSlothClownPranks.name: the sloth and the clown - pranks on zorgs
BookSlothClownPranks.description: The book is in excellent condition, with crisp pages and a bright cover. The cover of the book features Chuckles and Snuggles, surrounded by the different species they encountered during their adventures in space. In the background, the Zorgs can be seen peeking out from behind a spaceship.

BookSlothClownMMD.name: the sloth and the clown - maze maze danger
BookSlothClownMMD.description: The book looks new and vibrant, with an image of Chuckles and Snuggles standing in front of the changing maze on the cover. The title "The Sloth and the Clown - Maze Maze Danger" is written in bold, colorful letters that pop against a background of space and stars.

BookStruck.name: the humbling and transformative experience of being struck by lightning
BookStruck.description: The cover of the book is an electrifying image of lightning striking the ground, with a silhouette of a person standing in the midst of it. The title is written in bold letters in white against a black background, conveying the power and intensity of the experience. The subtitle is written in smaller letters below the title, providing a hint of the philosophical and spiritual themes explored within.

BookSun.name: reaching for the sun - a plant's quest for life
BookSun.description: The book is new, with a bright and vibrant cover featuring a plant stretching its leaves towards the sun. The title, "Reaching for the Sun - A Plant's Quest for Life," is written in bold, green letters, with an image of the sun rising behind the plant. The cover evokes a sense of growth, energy, and the beauty of nature.

BookPossum.name: fallen ambitions - the tragic tale of morty the possum
BookPossum.description: The book is in good condition, with a hardcover and a dark green forest background. In the center of the cover, there is a sad looking possum sitting on a branch, with a distant and lonely expression on its face. The title, "Fallen Ambitions - The Tragic Tale of Morty the Possum," is written in bold, gold letters above the possum.

BookCafe.name: the cafe possum
BookCafe.description: The book is in new condition, with a vibrant and whimsical cover that features a charming illustration of a tiny possum peeking out from behind a coffee cup, with a colorful and bustling cafe scene in the background. The title "The Cafe Possum" is written in bold, playful lettering, and the author's name is printed in a smaller font below it.

BookFeather.name: a feather of magic - the wandering bird's journey to belonging
BookFeather.description: The book would be in new condition, with a glossy cover depicting the wandering bird surrounded by a glowing forest, with the magical feather at the center. The title, "A Feather of Magic," would be written in bold, glittering letters, while the subtitle, "The Wandering Bird's Journey to Belonging," would be written in smaller print underneath. The back cover would feature a brief summary of the story, along with reviews from critics praising the book's themes of hope and renewal.

BookIanLostWolfPup.name: the adventures of ian and renault - finding the lost wolf pup
BookIanLostWolfPup.description: The book is a new condition with a colorful cover, depicting Ian the corgi and Renault the fox on a journey through the forest, with the lost wolf pup to their feet. The title "The Adventures of Ian and Renault - Finding the Lost Wolf Pup" is prominently displayed at the top, with the author's name below. The cover has a whimsical and adventurous feel to it, attracting readers of all ages.

BookIanRanch.name: the adventures of ian and renault - ranch expedition
BookIanRanch.description: The book appears to be new, with crisp pages and an unblemished cover. The cover features a colorful illustration of Ian and Renault, surrounded by various animals they encountered on the ranch, including horses, cows, and chickens. The title, "The Adventures of Ian and Renault - Ranch Expedition," is written in bold letters above the image, with the subtitle, "Helping Animals in Need," written below.

BookIanOcean.name: the adventures of ian and renault - an ocean adventure
BookIanOcean.description: The book is new and in excellent condition. The cover shows Ian and Renault running and playing on the beach, with the blue ocean and golden sand in the background. The title is written in bold, playful letters, and the subtitle reads "An Ocean Adventure."

BookIanMountain.name: the adventures of ian and renault - a mountain expedition
BookIanMountain.description: The book is in new condition. The cover is a stunning mountain landscape with Ian and Renault in the foreground, looking out over the vista of the surrounding peaks and valleys. The title is written in bold, block letters at the top, with the subtitle, "A Mountain Expedition," written underneath.

BookIanCity.name: the adventures of ian and renault - exploring the city
BookIanCity.description: The book is in new condition, with crisp pages and a glossy cover. The cover features a colorful illustration of Ian and Renault exploring the city, with tall buildings and bustling streets in the background. Ian is leading the way, with his tail wagging excitedly, while Renault follows close behind, her ears perked up and her eyes wide with wonder. The title, "The Adventures of Ian and Renault," is written in bold, playful letters, with the subtitle, "Exploring the City," written below in smaller font.

BookIanArctic.name: the adventures of ian and renault - an arctic journey of courage and friendship
BookIanArctic.description: The book looks new and adventurous, with a picture of Ian and Renault standing in front of an icy landscape with snowflakes falling all around them. The title, "The Adventures of Ian and Renault," is written in bold letters at the top, with a subtitle that reads, "An Arctic Journey of Courage and Friendship."

BookIanDesert.name: the adventures of ian and renault - exploring the mysterious desert
BookIanDesert.description: The book is in new condition and would have a colorful cover depicting Ian and Renault against a desert backdrop. The cover would feature images of various animals and plants that the two encountered on their adventure, such as a rattlesnake, coyotes, sand dunes, and an oasis. The title, "The Adventures of Ian and Renault" is prominently displayed on the cover in bold letters, while the subtitle "Exploring the Mysterious Desert" is written in smaller letters underneath.

BookNames.name: the power of names - a philosophical exploration
BookNames.description: The book is a gently used philosophy text, with a cover that features a close-up of a person's mouth, with the word "names" written on their lips. The title is "The Power of Names - A Philosophical Exploration," and the author's name is prominently displayed underneath. The overall design is simple and elegant, with the focus on the text rather than any flashy graphics or images.

BookEarth.name: earthly longing
BookEarth.description: The book is in good condition, with a slightly faded cover due to exposure to sunlight.  The cover of the book depicts a panoramic view of the Earth from space, with a bright blue ocean and green landmasses. In the foreground, a lone astronaut is seen sitting in front of a window, gazing wistfully at the Earth. The title of the book, "Earthly Longing," is written in bold white letters against a black background at the top of the cover.

BookAurora.name: journey beyond - the starship aurora mission
BookAurora.description: The book is in excellent condition, with a shiny cover depicting a spaceship hovering above a planet, perhaps with the Earth in the background. The title "Journey Beyond - The Starship Aurora Mission" is written in bold, silver letters. The cover also features a quote from a review, "A breathtaking tale of human achievement and exploration" to entice potential readers.

BookTemple.name: the nature of the divine - embracing the many gods
BookTemple.description: The book appears new with crisp pages and an uncreased spine. The cover features an image of a temple with a glowing, multicolored aura around it, symbolizing the various gods discussed in the book. The title is displayed prominently in gold lettering, with the author's name and a brief summary of the book written in smaller text below.

BookWatched.name: watched
BookWatched.description: The book is in good condition, with a slightly worn cover that features a dark and ominous space station looming in the background. The title "Watched" is written in bold letters that seem to be staring back at the reader, conveying the feeling of being constantly observed. The blurb on the back cover hints at a thrilling and suspenseful tale of paranoia and danger in a confined setting.

BookMedicalOfficer.name: horizon's battle - a medical officer's tale of trust and survival
BookMedicalOfficer.description: The cover features Smith, the medical officer, in his uniform, looking determined and ready to face any challenge. The backdrop shows the SS Horizon under attack, with explosions and smoke filling the space station. In the foreground, a wizard with a staff can be seen, adding an element of mystery and intrigue to the scene. The title is prominently displayed in bold letters, with the author's name and a tagline indicating the book's action-packed and suspenseful nature.

BookMorgue.name: the ghostly residents of the abandoned morgue
BookMorgue.description: The book looks old and worn, with faded lettering on the cover. The cover depicts a dark and eerie morgue, with a full moon casting an ominous glow over the scene. In the foreground are Morty the possum and Morticia the raccoon, with mischievous expressions on their faces, peeking out from behind a metal shelf. The title is written in bold, spooky letters, with the subtitle "A Tale of Animal Spirits" written in smaller font below.

BookRufus.name: rufus and the mischievous fairy
BookRufus.description: The book is in new condition, with vibrant colors and illustrations on the cover. The cover shows Rufus on his bicycle, with Blossom flying beside him in a playful manner. The title is written in bold, whimsical font, with the characters' names highlighted in a contrasting color. The overall aesthetic is charming and inviting, appealing to children and adults alike.

BookMap.name: the map of adventure
BookMap.description: The book is in a good condition, with a glossy cover depicting a jungle scene with vibrant colors and intricate details. The title "The Map of Adventure," is written in bold, gold lettering. The cover also features an image of a mysterious suitcase with the map spilling out of it.

BookJourney.name: a journey of music, mountains, and self-discovery
BookJourney.description: The book is in excellent condition, with crisp pages and a glossy cover. The cover features a striking image of a mountain range, with a silhouette of a climber with a guitar on their back in the foreground. The title is bold and eye-catching, with the subtitle "A Journey of Music, Mountains, and Self-Discovery."

BookInspiration.name: finding inspiration - a writer's journey through the woods
BookInspiration.description: The book is in a new condition with a cover depicting a serene forest scene with a waterfall and colorful wildflowers. The title of the book "Finding Inspiration - A Writer's Journey Through the Woods" and the author's name are prominently displayed at the bottom.

BookJanitorTale.name: the tales of a tired janitor
BookJanitorTale.description: A clean looking book, smelling vaguely of soap and bleach.

BrbSign.name: brb sign
BrbSign.description: Lets others know you are away.

BrokenBottle.name: broken bottle
BrokenBottle.description: In Space Glasgow this is called a conversation starter.

SyndicateBusinessCard.description: A black card with the syndicate's logo. There's something written on the back.

CandleInfinite.description: It's either magic or high tech, but this candle never goes out. On the other hand, its flame is quite cold.

CandyBowl.description: Grab as much as you can fit in your pockets!

CoordinatesDisk.description: A disk containing the coordinates to a location in space. Necessary for any FTL-traversing vessel to reach their destination. Fits inside shuttle consoles.

NukeDiskFake.description: A nuclear auth disk, capable of arming a nuke if used along with a code. Note from nanotrasen reads "THIS IS YOUR MOST IMPORTANT POSESSION"

EggSpider.description: Is it a gemstone? Is it an egg? It looks expensive.

FireExtinguisherMini.description: A light and compact fibreglass-framed model fire extinguisher. It holds less water than its bigger brother.

LampGold.description: A light emitting device that would look great on a desk.

LampInterrogator.description: Ultra-bright lamp for the bad cop.

FloodlightBroken.description: A pole with powerful mounted lights on it. It's broken.

ZiptiesBroken.description: These zipties look like they tried to manage the wrong cables.

PirateHandyFlag.description: Holding it in your hands, show these carp that you're not kidding.

UniversalIDCard.description: An ID card that gives you access beyond your wildest dreams.

ModularReceiver.description: A vital part used in the creation of firearms.

RifleStock.description: A robust wooden stock, used in the creation of firearms.

InflatableWall.description: An inflated membrane. Activate to deflate. Do not puncture.

InflatableDoor.description: An inflated membrane. Activate to deflate. Now with a door. Do not puncture.

KudzuFlowerFriendly.description: A colorful carpet of flowers sprawling in every direction. You're not sure whether to take it down or leave it up.

LandMineModular.description: This bad boy could be packing any number of dangers. Or a bike horn.

PaperArtifactAnalyzer.description: The readout of a device forgotten to time.

PaperCaptainsThoughts.name: captain's thoughts
PaperCaptainsThoughts.description: A page of the captain's journal. In luxurious lavender.

PaperCargoBountyManifest.name: bounty manifest
PaperCargoBountyManifest.description: A paper label designating a crate as containing a bounty. Selling a crate with this label will fulfill the bounty.

BoxFolderCentCom.name: CentComm folder
BoxFolderCentCom.description: CentComm's miserable little pile of secrets!

BoxFolderClipboard.name: clipboard
BoxFolderClipboard.description: The weapon of choice for those on the front lines of bureaucracy.

BoxFolderCentComClipboard.name: CentComm clipboard
BoxFolderCentComClipboard.description: A luxurious clipboard upholstered with green velvet. Often seen carried by CentComm officials, seldom seen actually used.

BoxFolderQmClipboard.name: requisition digi-board
BoxFolderQmClipboard.description: A bulky electric clipboard, filled with shipping orders and financing details. With so many compromising documents, you ought to keep this safe.

TraitorCodePaper.name: syndicate codeword
TraitorCodePaper.description: A leaked codeword to possibly get in touch with the Syndicate.

AllTraitorCodesPaper.name: syndicate codewords registry
AllTraitorCodesPaper.description: A registry of all active Syndicate codewords.

Envelope.name: envelope
Envelope.description: A small envelope for keeping prying eyes off of your sensitive documents.

LuxuryPen.name: luxury pen
LuxuryPen.description: A fancy and expensive pen that you only deserve to own if you're qualified to handle vast amounts of paperwork.

CyberPen.name: Cybersun pen
CyberPen.description: A high-tech pen straight from Cybersun's legal department, capable of refracting hard-light at impossible angles through its diamond tip in order to write. So powerful, it's even able to rewrite officially stamped documents should the need arise.

PenCentcom.name: CentComm pen
PenCentcom.description: In an attempt to keep up with the "power" of the cybersun bureaucracy, NT made a replica of cyber pen, in their corporate style.

PenCap.name: captain's fountain pen
PenCap.description: A luxurious fountain pen for the captain of the station.

PenHop.name: hop's fountain pen
PenHop.description: A luxurious fountain pen for the hop of the station.

PetCarrier.name: big pet carrier
PetCarrier.description: Allows large animals to be carried comfortably.

PotatoAIChip.name: supercompact AI chip
PotatoAIChip.description: This high-tech AI chip requires a voltage of exactly 1.1V to function correctly.

RubberStampGreytide.name: greytide's rubber stamp
RubberStampGreytide.description: A rubber stamp for stamping important documents. The tide washes over you, just looking at it...

RubberStampPsychologist.name: psychologist's rubber stamp
RubberStampPsychologist.description: A rubber stamp for stamping important documents. Prescribe those treatments!

RubberStampWizard.name: wizard's rubber stamp
RubberStampWizard.description: A chaotic wizard stamp for serving unchaotic paperwork, how ironic.

SpaceCash.name: credits
SpaceCash.description: Veridian Standard Credits, the lifeblood of the galaxy! Most commonly referred to as "Credits" they are prints sourced from the Veridian Emerald Bank, the largest bank in the galaxy.

Spaceshroom.name: spaceshroom
Spaceshroom.description: A cluster of wild mushrooms that likes to grow in dark, moist environments.

FoodSpaceshroom.name: spaceshroom
FoodSpaceshroom.description: A wild mushroom. There's no telling what effect it could have...

FoodSpaceshroomCooked.name: cooked spaceshroom
FoodSpaceshroomCooked.description: A wild mushroom that has been cooked through. It seems the heat has removed its chemical effects.

SadTromboneImplant.name: sad trombone implant
SadTromboneImplant.description: This implant plays a sad tune when the user dies.

LightImplant.name: light implant
LightImplant.description: This implant emits light from the user's skin on activation.

BikeHornImplant.name: bike horn implant
BikeHornImplant.description: This implant lets the user honk anywhere at any time.

TrackingImplant.name: TSFMC tracking implant
TrackingImplant.description: This implant has a condition monitor for the TSFMC radio channel.

StorageImplant.name: storage implant
StorageImplant.description: This implant grants hidden storage within a person's body using bluespace technology.

FreedomImplant.name: freedom implant
FreedomImplant.description: This implant lets the user break out of hand restraints up to three times before ceasing to function anymore.

RadioImplant.name: radio implant
RadioImplant.description: This implant grants access to the Syndicate channel without a headset.

UplinkImplant.name: uplink implant
UplinkImplant.description: This implant lets the user access a hidden Syndicate uplink at will.

EmpImplant.name: EMP implant
EmpImplant.description: This implant creates a 2.75 m, 10 s, 2.7 MJ electromagnetic pulse when activated.

ScramImplant.name: scram implant
ScramImplant.description: This implant randomly teleports the user within a large radius when activated.

DnaScramblerImplant.name: DNA scrambler implant
DnaScramblerImplant.description: This implant lets the user randomly change their appearance and name once.

MicroBombImplant.name: micro-bomb implant
MicroBombImplant.description: This implant detonates the user upon activation or upon death.

MacroBombImplant.name: macro-bomb implant
MacroBombImplant.description: This implant creates a large explosion on death after a preprogrammed countdown.

DeathAcidifierImplant.name: death-acidifier implant
DeathAcidifierImplant.description: This implant melts the user and their equipment upon death.

DeathRattleImplant.name: death rattle implant
DeathRattleImplant.description: This implant will inform the Syndicate radio channel should the user fall into critical condition or die.

FakeMindShieldImplant.name: fake mindshield implant
FakeMindShieldImplant.description: This implant allows the implanter to produce a fake signal that NT security huds use to identify individuals implanted with a mindshield.

MindShieldImplant.name: mindshield implant
MindShieldImplant.description: This implant will shield the brain from external influences and prevent mind control devices.

RadioImplantCentcomm.name: radio implant
RadioImplantCentcomm.description: This implant grants access to the Centcomm channel without a headset. Only authorized for Centcomm employees.

FloorTileItemJungleAstroGrass.description: Fake grass that covers up wires and even comes with realistic NanoTrimmings!

FloorTileItemAstroIce.name: astro-ice
FloorTileItemAstroIce.description: Fake ice that's as slippery as the real thing, while being easily removable!

FloorTileItemAstroSnow.name: astro-snow
FloorTileItemAstroSnow.description: Fake snow that's as fluffy as the real thing, while being easily removable!

FloorTileItemAstroAsteroidSand.name: asteroid astro-sand
FloorTileItemAstroAsteroidSand.description: Fake sand. Luckily, it's not as coarse as the real thing.

Torch.description: A torch fashioned from some wood.

TreasureDatadiskEncrypted.name: encrypted datadisk
TreasureDatadiskEncrypted.description: An old data disk. Someone savvier than you could unencrypt it and learn something juicy. All you can do is sell it.
