Though known to overheat occasionally in prolonged battle, this does not stop the Marine special forces who favor them.

WeaponPulseRifle.name: VCD QBH-11 Pulse Rifle
WeaponPulseRifle.description: The first pulse model reproduced since the technology fell into TSF hands after the end of the Corporate War, this rifle defines cutting edge technology in the hands of elite TSF military troops and the officers that command them.

WeaponBorgPulseRifle.name: Cyborg pulse rifle
WeaponBorgPulseRifle.description: A weapon that used to be used by the special operations units of NT, but mounted onto a silicon.

WeaponLaserCannon.name: laser cannon
WeaponLaserCannon.description: A heavy duty, high powered laser weapon. On the handle is a label that says 'for authorized use only.'

WeaponParticleDecelerator.name: portable particle decelerator
WeaponParticleDecelerator.description: A portable particle decelerator capable of decomposing a tesla or singularity. On the handle is a label that says 'for authorized use only.'

WeaponXrayCannon.name: x-ray cannon
WeaponXrayCannon.description: An illegal and experimental weapon that uses concentrated x-ray energy against its target.

WeaponDisablerPractice.name: practice disabler
WeaponDisablerPractice.description: A self-defense weapon that exhausts organic targets, weakening them until they collapse. This one has been undertuned for cadets making it mostly harmless.

WeaponDisabler.name: disabler
WeaponDisabler.description: A civilian grade self-defense weapon that exhausts organic targets, weakening them until they collapse.

WeaponDisablerSMG.name: disabler SMG
WeaponDisablerSMG.description: Advanced weapon that exhausts organic targets, weakening them until they collapse. On the handle is a label that says 'for authorized use only.'

WeaponTaser.name: taser
WeaponTaser.description: A low-capacity, energy-based stun gun used by security teams to subdue targets at range. On the handle is a label that says 'for authorized use only.'

WeaponAntiqueLaser.name: antique laser pistol
WeaponAntiqueLaser.description: This is an antique laser pistol. All craftsmanship is of the highest quality. It is decorated with a mahogany grip and chrome filigree. The object menaces with spikes of energy. On the item is an image of a captain and a clown. The clown is dead. The captain is striking a heroic pose.

WeaponAdvancedLaser.name: advanced laser pistol
WeaponAdvancedLaser.description: An experimental civilian grade high-energy laser pistol with a self-charging nuclear battery.

WeaponPistolCHIMP.name: C.H.I.M.P. handcannon
WeaponPistolCHIMP.description: Just because it's a little C.H.I.M.P. doesn't mean it can't punch like an A.P.E.

WeaponPistolCHIMPUpgraded.name: experimental C.H.I.M.P. handcannon
WeaponPistolCHIMPUpgraded.description: This C.H.I.M.P. seems to have a greater punch than is usual...

WeaponBehonkerLaser.name: eye of a behonker
WeaponBehonkerLaser.description: The eye of a behonker, it fires a laser when squeezed. An illegal weapon often used by the cult of the Honkmother.

WeaponEnergyShotgun.name: NT energy shotgun
WeaponEnergyShotgun.description: A one-of-a-kind prototype energy weapon that uses various shotgun configurations. It offers the possibility of both lethal and non-lethal shots, making it a versatile weapon.

WeaponMinigun.name: minigun
WeaponMinigun.description: Vzzzzzt! Rahrahrahrah! Vrrrrr! Uses .10 rifle ammo. Illegal for use in the Frontier sector.

WeaponLightMachineGunL6.name: PA L6B SAW (7.62x39mm)
WeaponLightMachineGunL6.description: A rather traditionally made LMG with a pleasantly lacquered wooden pistol grip. Uses 7.62x39mm ammo. it serves as a remnant of humanity's greed and ambition during The Fracture.

WeaponLightMachineGunL6C.name: PA L6C ROW (7.62x39mm)
WeaponLightMachineGunL6C.description: A L6 SAW for use by cyborgs. Creates 762x39mm ammo on the fly from an internal ammo fabricator, which slowly self-charges.

WeaponLauncherRocket.name: PA RPG-7
WeaponLauncherRocket.description: A modified ancient rocket-propelled grenade launcher.

WeaponLauncherMultipleRocket.name: multiple rocket launcher
WeaponLauncherMultipleRocket.description: A modified ancient rocket-propelled grenade launcher.

WeaponTetherGun.name: tether gun
WeaponTetherGun.description: Manipulates gravity around objects to fling them at high velocities.

WeaponForceGun.name: force gun
WeaponForceGun.description: Manipulates gravity around objects to fling them at high velocities.

WeaponTetherGunAdmin.name: tether gun
WeaponTetherGunAdmin.description: Manipulates gravity around objects to fling them at high velocities.

WeaponForceGunAdmin.name: force gun
WeaponForceGunAdmin.description: Manipulates gravity around objects to fling them at high velocities.

WeaponPistolViper.name: LWC PT-45A viper (9x19mm)
WeaponPistolViper.description: A small, easily concealable, but somewhat underpowered gun. Retrofitted with a fully automatic receiver. Uses 9x19mm ammo. While the schematics to build new Vipers has been lost, they are so abundant from the Corporate War that building new ones is no longer required. Outfitted with a threaded barrel & tactical device mount.

WeaponPistolEchis.name: LWC PT-45C echis (9x19mm)
WeaponPistolEchis.description: A viper for use by cyborgs. Creates 9x19mm on the fly from an internal ammo fabricator, which slowly self-charges.

WeaponPistolMercenaryEchis.name: LWC mercenary PT-45C echis (9x19mm)
WeaponPistolMercenaryEchis.description: A viper for use by cyborgs, redesigned for mercenary use. Creates 9x19mm on the fly from an internal ammo fabricator, which slowly self-charges.

WeaponPistolCobra.name: CS PT-72 cobra (6.35x40mm)
WeaponPistolCobra.description: A rugged, robust spec-ops handgun with an inbuilt silencer. Uses 6.35x40mm Caseless ammo. A common sight among Phaethon imperials, they are the most commonly seen sidearm among boarding crews or agents.

WeaponPistolMk58.name: MA Mk-58 (.45 ACP)
WeaponPistolMk58.description: The Mark 58 Offensive Handgun, the most abundant sidearm in the entire galaxy. Commonly called a Corporate War fragment, it was used until the bitter end. Uses .45 ACP ammo. Outfitted with a threaded barrel & tactical device mount.

ArrowRegular.name: arrow
ArrowRegular.description: You can feel the power of the steppe within you.

ArrowImprovisedPlasma.name: plasma glass shard arrow
ArrowImprovisedPlasma.description: The greyshirt's preferred projectile. Now with extra lethality!

ArrowImprovisedUranium.name: uranium glass shard arrow
ArrowImprovisedUranium.description: The greyshirt's preferred projectile. Now with added radiation!

ProjectileLocker.name: cursed locker
ProjectileLocker.description: A cursed magical locker! Can you resist?

ProjectilePolyboltCarp.name: carp polybolt
ProjectilePolyboltCarp.description: Nooo, I don't wanna be fish!

ProjectilePolyboltMonkey.name: monkey polybolt
ProjectilePolyboltMonkey.description: Nooo, I don't wanna be monkey!

ProjectilePolyboltDoor.name: door polybolt
ProjectilePolyboltDoor.description: Nooo, I don't wanna be door!

ProjectilePolyboltBread.name: bread polybolt
ProjectilePolyboltBread.description: Nooo, I don't wanna be bread!

MeteorUrist.name: Urist McMeteor
MeteorUrist.description: As a successful member of society with a stable unflinching psyche and limitless drive, natural affinity for finance and domination, you have been selected, no, you have been effortlessly guided by divine (biological) trauma towards this moment. The gates of destiny fling open, and once again you're left standing on pulsating nothingness. A strobing headache of the soul.

BulletKinetic.name: kinetic bolt
BulletKinetic.description: Not too bad, but you still don't want to get hit by it.

BulletCharge.name: charge bolt
BulletCharge.description: Marks a target for additional damage.

WeaponRevolverInspector.name: Inspector (.45 magnum)
WeaponRevolverInspector.description: A detective's best friend. Uses .45 magnum ammo. On the handle is a label that says 'for authorized use only.'

WeaponRevolverMateba.name: NT Mateba (.45 magnum)
WeaponRevolverMateba.description: A legendary sidearm from the Corporate Era, once used by corporate kill-teams, it now belongs to TSF Officers across the galaxy. Uses .45 magnum ammo. On the handle is a label that says 'for authorized use only.'

WeaponRevolverPython.name: LWC Python (.45 magnum)
WeaponRevolverPython.description: A revolver that is commonly found around Phaethon Dynasty space, it's typically used by high-ranking imperials. Uses .45 magnum ammo.

WeaponRevolverPythonGatfruit.name: LWC Python (.45 magnum)
WeaponRevolverPythonGatfruit.description: A revolver that is commonly found around Phaethon Dynasty space, it's typically used by high-ranking imperials. Uses .45 magnum ammo. It seems to be made of fragile plant matter, and isn't as valuable for contraband recycling.

WeaponRifleAk.name: LWC AKM (7.62x39mm)
WeaponRifleAk.description: An old Pre-Fracture Era rifle. Uses 7.62x39mm ammo. When the Fracture began to spread across the Old Earth territories, few weapons were as reliable as the AKM

WeaponRifleFoam.name: Foam Force Astro Ace
WeaponRifleFoam.description: A premium foam rifle of the highest quality. Its plastic feels rugged, and its mechanisms sturdy.

WeaponSubMachineGunWt550.name: UI WT550 (4.6x30mm)
WeaponSubMachineGunWt550.description: An excellent SMG, produced by a Black Market Arms Company known as Ullman Industries. Uses 4.6x30mm ammo. On the receiver is a label that says 'for authorized use only.'

WeaponShotgunBulldog.name: PA M-12 Bulldog (12 gauge)
WeaponShotgunBulldog.description: An automatic magazine-fed shotgun for close-quarters combat. Kicks like a mule on steroids. Uses 12 gauge shotgun shells.

WeaponShotgunDoubleBarreled.name: double-barreled shotgun (12 gauge)
WeaponShotgunDoubleBarreled.description: An immortal classic. A civilian grade shotgun. Uses 12 gauge shotgun shells.

WeaponShotgunDoubleBarreledRubber.name: double-barreled shotgun (12 gauge)
WeaponShotgunDoubleBarreledRubber.description: An immortal classic. Uses 12 gauge shotgun shells.

WeaponShotgunEnforcer.name: Enforcer (12 gauge)
WeaponShotgunEnforcer.description: A premium semi-automatic shotgun, and the pride of all security forces. Uses 12 gauge shotgun shells.

WeaponShotgunKammerer.name: Kammerer (12 gauge)
WeaponShotgunKammerer.description: An old yet faithful design, and a favorite among irregular forces on many worlds. Uses 12 gauge shotgun shells.

WeaponShotgunHandmade.name: handmade pistol (12 gauge)
WeaponShotgunHandmade.description: Looks unreliable, but legal. Uses 12 gauge shotgun shells.

WeaponShotgunBlunderbuss.name: blunderbuss (12 gauge)
WeaponShotgunBlunderbuss.description: Deadly at close range, an illegal shotgun often found at the side of a pirate.

WeaponShotgunImprovised.name: improvised shotgun (12 gauge)
WeaponShotgunImprovised.description: A shitty, but legal, hand-made shotgun that uses 12 gauge shotgun shells. It can only hold one round in the chamber.

Musket.name: musket
Musket.description: This should've been in a museum long before you were born. Uses 145x114mm ammo.

WeaponPistolFlintlock.name: flintlock pistol
WeaponPistolFlintlock.description: A pirate's companion. Yarrr! Uses 145x114mm ammo. An illegal weapon often used by pirates.

WeaponFlareGun.name: flare gun
WeaponFlareGun.description: A compact, single-shot flare launcher. Used for firing signal flares.

WeaponImprovisedPneumaticCannon.name: improvised pneumatic cannon
WeaponImprovisedPneumaticCannon.description: Improvised using nothing but a pipe, some zipties, and a pneumatic cannon. Doesn't accept tanks without enough gas.

LauncherCreamPie.name: pie cannon
LauncherCreamPie.description: Load cream pie for optimal results.

LauncherSyringe.name: syringe gun
LauncherSyringe.description: Load full of poisoned syringes for optimal fun.

ArmBlade.name: arm blade
ArmBlade.description: A grotesque blade made out of bone and flesh that cleaves through people as a hot knife through butter.

IncompleteBaseBallBat.name: incomplete baseball bat
IncompleteBaseBallBat.description: A few planks of wood stuck together.

WeaponMeleeKnockbackStick.name: knockback stick
WeaponMeleeKnockbackStick.description: And then he spleefed all over.

CaneBlade.name: cane blade
CaneBlade.description: A sharp blade with a cane shaped hilt.

Chainsaw.name: chainsaw
Chainsaw.description: A very large chainsaw. Usually you use this for cutting down trees... usually.

RitualDagger.name: ritual dagger
RitualDagger.description: A strange dagger used by sinister groups for rituals and sacrifices.

EldritchBlade.name: eldritch blade
EldritchBlade.description: A sword humming with unholy energy.

UnholyHalberd.name: unholy halberd
UnholyHalberd.description: A poleaxe that seems to be linked to its wielder.

EnergySword.name: energy sword
EnergySword.description: A very loud & dangerous sword with a beam made of pure, concentrated plasma. Cuts through unarmored targets like butter.

EnergyDaggerLoud.name: energy dagger
EnergyDaggerLoud.description: A not as loud and dangerous dagger with a beam made of pure, concentrated plasma. This one is completely undisguised.

EnergyDaggerBox.name: e-dagger box
EnergyDaggerBox.description: A small box containing an e-dagger. Packaging disintegrates when opened, leaving no evidence behind.

EnergySwordDouble.name: double-bladed energy sword
EnergySwordDouble.description: A variant of the classic Energy Sword with blades on both ends.

HyperEutacticBlade.name: hypereutactic-blade
HyperEutacticBlade.description: A supermassive weapon envisioned to cleave the very fabric of space and time itself in twain, the hypereutactic blade dynamically flash-forges a hypereutactic crystaline nanostructure capable of passing through most known forms of matter like a hot knife through butter.

CyborgEnergySwordDouble.name: CyborgEnergySwordDouble
CyborgEnergySwordDouble.description: A double-bladed e-sword now stuck onto a cyborg, who and why would they do this? Specially designed for cyborgs.

FireAxe.name: fireaxe
FireAxe.description: Truly, the weapon of a madman. Who would think to fight fire with an axe?

FireAxeFlaming.name: fire axe
FireAxeFlaming.description: Why fight fire with an axe when you can fight with fire and axe? Now featuring rugged rubberized handle!

Gohei.name: gohei
Gohei.description: A wooden stick with white streamers at the end. Originally used by shrine maidens to purify things. Now used by the station's weeaboos.

Sledgehammer.name: sledgehammer
Sledgehammer.description: The perfect tool for wanton carnage.

Mjollnir.name: Mjollnir
Mjollnir.description: A weapon worthy of a god, able to strike with the force of a lightning bolt. It crackles with barely contained energy.

SingularityHammer.name: Singularity Hammer
SingularityHammer.description: The pinnacle of close combat technology, the hammer harnesses the power of a miniaturized singularity to deal crushing blows.

KitchenKnife.name: kitchen knife
KitchenKnife.description: A general purpose Chef's Knife made by Asters Merchant Guild. Guaranteed to stay sharp for years to come..

ButchCleaver.name: butcher's cleaver
ButchCleaver.description: A huge blade used for chopping and chopping up meat. This includes clowns and clown-by-products.

CombatKnife.name: combat knife
CombatKnife.description: A deadly knife intended for melee confrontations.

SurvivalKnife.name: survival knife
SurvivalKnife.description: Weapon of first and last resort for combatting space carp.

KukriKnife.name: kukri knife
KukriKnife.description: Professionals have standards. Be polite. Be efficient. Have a plan to kill everyone you meet.

BladedFlatcapGrey.name: grey flatcap
BladedFlatcapGrey.description: Fashionable for both the working class and old man Jenkins. It has glass shards hidden in the brim.

BladedFlatcapBrown.name: brown flatcap
BladedFlatcapBrown.description: Stupid clown! You made me look bad! It has glass shards hidden in the brim.

Shiv.name: shiv
Shiv.description: A crude weapon fashioned from a piece of cloth and a glass shard.

ReinforcedShiv.name: reinforced shiv
ReinforcedShiv.description: A crude weapon fashioned from a piece of cloth and a reinforced glass shard.

PlasmaShiv.name: plasma shiv
PlasmaShiv.description: A crude weapon fashioned from a piece of cloth and a plasma glass shard.

UraniumShiv.name: uranium shiv
UraniumShiv.description: A crude weapon fashioned from a piece of cloth and a uranium glass shard. Violates the geneva convention!

ThrowingKnife.name: throwing knife
ThrowingKnife.description: This blood-red knife is very aerodynamic and easy to throw, but good luck trying to fight someone hand-to-hand.

Pickaxe.name: pickaxe
Pickaxe.description: Notched to perfection, for jamming it into rocks.

MiningDrill.name: mining drill
MiningDrill.description: Powerful tool used to quickly drill through rocks.

MiningDrillDiamond.name: diamond tipped mining drill
MiningDrillDiamond.description: A significantly more efficient mining drill tipped with diamond.

WeaponCrusherDagger.name: crusher dagger
WeaponCrusherDagger.description: A scaled down version of a proto-kinetic crusher. Uses kinetic energy to vibrate the blade at high speeds.

WeaponCrusherGlaive.name: crusher glaive
WeaponCrusherGlaive.description: An early design of the proto-kinetic accelerator, in glaive form.

WeaponMeleeNeedle.name: official security anti-inflatable armament
WeaponMeleeNeedle.description: A specialty weapon used in the destruction of unique syndicate morale-boosting equipment.

Spear.name: spear
Spear.description: Definition of a Classic. Keeping murder affordable since 200,000 BCE.

SpearReinforced.name: reinforced spear
SpearReinforced.description: A spear with a reinforced glass shard as a tip.

SpearPlasma.name: plasma spear
SpearPlasma.description: A spear with a plasma shard as a tip.

SpearUranium.name: uranium spear
SpearUranium.description: A spear with a uranium shard as a tip.

Stunprod.name: stun prod
Stunprod.description: A stun prod for questionably legal incapacitation.

CaptainSabre.name: captain's sabre
CaptainSabre.description: A common sighting among ship captains. Once ceremonial, it now has common use for self-defense.

Katana.name: katana
Katana.description: Ancient craftwork made with not so ancient plasteel.

EnergyKatana.name: energy katana
EnergyKatana.description: A katana infused with strong energy.

Cutlass.name: cutlass
Cutlass.description: A wickedly curved blade, often seen in the hands of space pirates.

WhiteCane.name: white cane
WhiteCane.description: This isn't for you. It's for the people who can't figure out you're blind when you ask if cargo is the bar.

Bola.name: bola
Bola.description: Linked together with some spare cuffs and metal.

ExGrenade.name: explosive grenade
ExGrenade.description: Grenade that creates a small but devastating explosion.

SyndieMiniBomb.name: syndicate minibomb
SyndieMiniBomb.description: A syndicate-manufactured explosive used to stow destruction and cause chaos.

SelfDestructSeq.name: self destruct
SelfDestructSeq.description: Go out on your own terms!

SingularityGrenade.name: singularity grenade
SingularityGrenade.description: Grenade that simulates the power of a singularity, pulling things in a heap.

WhiteholeGrenade.name: whitehole grenade
WhiteholeGrenade.description: Grenade that repulses everything around for some time.

NuclearGrenade.name: the nuclear option
NuclearGrenade.description: Please don't throw it, think of the children.

ModularGrenade.name: modular grenade
ModularGrenade.description: A grenade casing. Requires a trigger and a payload.

EmpGrenade.name: EMP grenade
EmpGrenade.description: A grenade designed to wreak havoc on electronic systems.

HolyHandGrenade.name: holy hand grenade
HolyHandGrenade.description: O Lord, bless this thy hand grenade, that with it thou mayst blow thine enemies to tiny bits, in thy mercy.

SmokeGrenade.name: smoke grenade
SmokeGrenade.description: A tactical grenade that releases a large, long-lasting cloud of smoke when used.

CleanerGrenade.name: cleanade
CleanerGrenade.description: Special grenade for janitors, releasing large cloud of space cleaner foam.

TearGasGrenade.name: tear gas grenade
TearGasGrenade.description: A riot control tear gas grenade. Causes irritation, pain and makes you cry your eyes out.

MetalFoamGrenade.name: metal foam grenade
MetalFoamGrenade.description: An emergency tool used for patching up holes. Almost as good as real walls.

AirGrenade.name: air grenade
AirGrenade.description: A special solid state chemical grenade used for quickly releasing standard air into a spaced area. Fills up to 30 tiles!

GrenadeDummy.name: trick grenade
GrenadeDummy.description: All the grenade without any of the boom.

SyndieTrickyBomb.name: syndicate trickybomb
SyndieTrickyBomb.description: A syndicate-manufactured explosive used to make an excellent distraction.

GrenadeStinger.name: stinger grenade
GrenadeStinger.description: Nothing to see here, please disperse.

GrenadeIncendiary.name: incendiary grenade
GrenadeIncendiary.description: Guaranteed to light up the mood.

GrenadeShrapnel.name: shrapnel grenade
GrenadeShrapnel.description: Releases a deadly spray of shrapnel that causes severe bleeding.

ClusterBang.name: clusterbang
ClusterBang.description: Can be used only with flashbangs. Explodes several times.

ClusterBangFull.name: ClusterBang
ClusterBangFull.description: Launches three flashbangs after the timer runs out.

ClusterGrenade.name: clustergrenade
ClusterGrenade.description: Why use one grenade when you can use three at once!

ClusterBananaPeel.name: cluster banana peel
ClusterBananaPeel.description: Splits into 6 explosive banana peels after throwing, guaranteed fun!

SlipocalypseClusterSoap.name: slipocalypse clustersoap
SlipocalypseClusterSoap.description: Spreads small pieces of syndicate soap over an area upon landing on the floor.

GrenadeFoamDart.name: foam dart grenade
GrenadeFoamDart.description: Releases a bothersome spray of foam darts that cause severe welching.

ThrowingStar.name: throwing star
ThrowingStar.description: An ancient weapon still used to this day, due to its ease of lodging itself into its victim's body parts.

Stunbaton.name: stun baton
Stunbaton.description: A stun baton for incapacitating people with. Actively harming with this is considered bad tone.

CyborgStunbaton.name: cyborg stun baton
CyborgStunbaton.description: A stun baton for incapacitating people with, designed for cyborgs. Actively harming with this is considered bad tone.

Truncheon.name: truncheon
Truncheon.description: A rigid, steel-studded baton, meant to harm. On the handle is a label that says 'for authorized use only.'

Flash.name: flash
Flash.description: An ultrabright flashbulb with a trigger, which causes the victim to be dazed and lose their eyesight for a moment. Useless when burnt out.

PortableFlasher.name: portable flasher
PortableFlasher.description: An ultrabright flashbulb with a proximity trigger, useful for making an area security-only.

BannerNanotrasen.name: nanotrasen banner
BannerNanotrasen.description: A banner displaying the Nanotrasen logo. It looks rather cheap.

BannerCargo.name: cargo banner
BannerCargo.description: A banner displaying the colors of the cargo department.

BannerEngineering.name: engineering banner
BannerEngineering.description: A banner displaying the colors of the engineering department. Scrungularty.

BannerMedical.name: medical banner
BannerMedical.description: A banner displaying the colors of the medical department. How sterile.

BannerSyndicate.name: syndicate banner
BannerSyndicate.description: A banner from which, according to the syndicate, you should feel hatred for NT.

BannerScience.name: science banner
BannerScience.description: A banner displaying the colors of the science department. Where science has no bounds, and regulations are rarely followed.

BannerSecurity.name: security banner
BannerSecurity.description: A banner displaying the colors of the security department.

BannerBlue.name: blue banner
BannerBlue.description: A banner displaying the color blue. Dabudidabudai.

BannerRed.name: red banner
BannerRed.description: A banner displaying the color red. The edgy one.

BannerYellow.name: yellow banner
BannerYellow.description: A banner displaying the color yellow. Reminds you of ducks and lemon stands.

BannerGreen.name: green banner
BannerGreen.description: A banner displaying the color green. Grass, leaves, guacamole.

Bonfire.name: bonfire
Bonfire.description: What can be better than a late evening under the sky with guitar and friends?

LegionnaireBonfire.name: legionnaire bonfire
LegionnaireBonfire.description: There, in the land of lava and ash, place to to cook marshmallow and potato.

DecoratedFirTree.name: decorated fir tree
DecoratedFirTree.description: A very festive tree for a very festive holiday.

Fireplace.name: fireplace
Fireplace.description: A place that has fire. Cozy!

Mannequin.name: mannequin
Mannequin.description: It can wear any clothing with style.

ShowcaseRobot.name: security robot showcase
ShowcaseRobot.description: A non-functional replica of an old security robot.

ShowcaseRobotWhite.name: white robot showcase
ShowcaseRobotWhite.description: A non-functional replica of an old robot.

ShowcaseRobotAntique.name: cargo robot showcase
ShowcaseRobotAntique.description: A non-functional replica of an old cargo robot.

ShowcaseRobotMarauder.name: marauder showcase
ShowcaseRobotMarauder.description: A non-functional replica of a marauder, painted green.

StatueVenusRed.name: statue of a pure maiden
StatueVenusRed.description: An ancient marble statue. The subject is depicted with a floor-length braid and is wielding a red toolbox.

StatueVenusBlue.name: statue of a pure maiden
StatueVenusBlue.description: An ancient marble statue. The subject is depicted with a floor-length braid and is wielding a blue toolbox.

StatueBananiumClown.name: bananium savior statue
StatueBananiumClown.description: A bananium statue. It portrays the return of the savior who will rise up and lead the clowns to the great honk.

BoozeDispenser.name: booze dispenser
BoozeDispenser.description: A booze dispenser with a single slot for a container to be filled.

SodaDispenser.name: soda dispenser
SodaDispenser.description: A beverage dispenser with a selection of soda and several other common beverages. Has a single fill slot for containers.

AirlockAssembly.name: airlock assembly
AirlockAssembly.description: It opens, it closes, and maybe crushes you.

Airlock.name: airlock
Airlock.description: It opens, it closes, and maybe crushes you.

AirlockExternal.name: AirlockExternal
AirlockExternal.description: It opens, it closes, it might crush you, and there might be only space behind it.

HighSecDoor.name: high security door
HighSecDoor.description: Keeps the bad out and keeps the good in.

AirlockShuttle.name: external airlock
AirlockShuttle.description: Necessary for connecting two space craft together.

AirlockShuttleAssembly.name: external airlock assembly
AirlockShuttleAssembly.description: An incomplete structure necessary for connecting two space craft together.

WoodDoor.name: wooden door
WoodDoor.description: A door, where will it lead?

PaperDoor.name: paper door
PaperDoor.description: A door, where will it lead?

PlasmaDoor.name: plasma door
PlasmaDoor.description: A door, where will it lead?

GoldDoor.name: gold door
GoldDoor.description: A door, where will it lead?

SilverDoor.name: silver door
SilverDoor.description: A door, where will it lead?

BananiumDoor.name: bananium door
BananiumDoor.description: A door, where will it lead?

WebDoor.name: web door
WebDoor.description: A door, leading to the lands of the spiders... or a spaced room.

BaseSecretDoorAssembly.name: secret door assembly
BaseSecretDoorAssembly.description: It opens, it closes, and maybe crushes you.

ShuttersRadiation.name: radiation shutters
ShuttersRadiation.description: Why did they make these shutters radioactive?

ShuttersWindow.name: window shutters
ShuttersWindow.description: The Best (TM) place to see your friends explode!

ShuttersFrame.name: shutter frame
ShuttersFrame.description: A frame for constructing a shutter.

WindoorAssembly.name: windoor assembly

Call your doctor for medical advice about these or any other side effects you may experience.

PosterLegitSMEpi.description: Safety Moth™ informs the viewer to help injured/deceased crewmen with their epinephrine injectors. "Epipen a pal when they're in peril! Prevent organ rot with this one simple trick!"

PosterLegitSMPills.name: Safety Moth - Pill Bottles
PosterLegitSMPills.description: Safety Moth™ informs the viewer that leaving pills unsupervised on tables could lead to unforeseen consequences. "Hungry critters love to eat everything! Keep your pills safe in crates and pill bottles!"

PosterLegitSMAnomalies.name: Safety Moth - Anomalies
PosterLegitSMAnomalies.description: Safety Moth™ promotes proper safety equipment when working around anomalies. "Every good Moths wears protection when working with anomalies, but don't get too close! Not everything that glows is a friend!"

PosterLegitSMGlimmer.name: Safety Moth - Glimmer Safety Precautions
PosterLegitSMGlimmer.description: Safety Moth™ tells the viewer to wear insulative equipments and hide in lockers when the glimmer gets within critical levels. Evacuating might be a better strategy.

SignSec.name: security sign
SignSec.description: A sign indicating the Security department.

SignConspiracyBoard.name: conspiracy board
SignConspiracyBoard.description: Perfect for tracking the multiple layers of criminal activities.

SignDojo.name: dojo sign
SignDojo.description: A sign indicating a place with discipline and tatami mats.

DragonSurviveObjective.name: Survive
DragonSurviveObjective.description: You have to stay alive to maintain control.

StealResearchObjective.name: StealResearchObjective
StealResearchObjective.description: Your gloves can be used to hack a research server and steal its precious data. If science has been slacking you'll have to get to work.

SpiderChargeObjective.name: SpiderChargeObjective
SpiderChargeObjective.description: This bomb can be detonated in a specific location. Note that the bomb will not work anywhere else!

NinjaSurviveObjective.name: Survive
NinjaSurviveObjective.description: You wouldn't be a very good ninja if you died, now would you?

TerrorObjective.name: Call in a threat
TerrorObjective.description: Use your gloves on a communication console in order to bring another threat to the station.

MassArrestObjective.name: Set everyone to wanted
MassArrestObjective.description: Use your gloves to hack a criminal records console, setting the entire station to be wanted!

EscapeThiefShuttleObjective.name: Escape to centcomm alive and unrestrained.
EscapeThiefShuttleObjective.description: You don't want your illegal activities to be discovered by anyone, do you?

EscapeShuttleObjective.name: Escape to centcomm alive and unrestrained.
EscapeShuttleObjective.description: One of our undercover agents will debrief you when you arrive. Don't show up in cuffs.

KillRandomPersonObjective.name: KillRandomPersonObjective
KillRandomPersonObjective.description: Do it however you like, just make sure they don't make it to centcomm.

KillRandomHeadObjective.name: KillRandomHeadObjective
KillRandomHeadObjective.description: We need this head gone and you probably know why. Good luck, agent.

RandomTraitorAliveObjective.name: RandomTraitorAliveObjective
RandomTraitorAliveObjective.description: Identify yourself at your own risk. We just need them alive.

RandomTraitorProgressObjective.name: RandomTraitorProgressObjective
RandomTraitorProgressObjective.description: Identify yourself at your own risk. We just need them to succeed.

WizardSurviveObjective.name: Survive
WizardSurviveObjective.description: The Space Wizards Federation want you to live!

WizardDemonstrateObjective.name: Show off
WizardDemonstrateObjective.description: Give the station a good demonstration of your powers!

ActionMimeInvisibleWall.name: Create Invisible Wall
ActionMimeInvisibleWall.description: Create an invisible wall in front of you, if placeable there.

XenoArtifactEffectUniversalIntercom.name: XenoArtifactEffectUniversalIntercom
XenoArtifactEffectUniversalIntercom.description: Obtains ability of long-distance communication device

XenoArtifactSolutionStorage.name: XenoArtifactSolutionStorage
XenoArtifactSolutionStorage.description: Obtains ability of container for chemical solutions

CDDogtags.name: dogtags
CDDogtags.description: A set of dogtags, hanging from a small piece of cord for wearing and carrying.

CEActionZFlightUp.name: Fly up
CEActionZFlightUp.description: Beat your wings and rise one Z-Level.

CEActionZFlightDown.name: Fly down
CEActionZFlightDown.description: Ease off and descend one Z-Level.

CEActionZFlightToggle.name: Toggle flight
CEActionZFlightToggle.description: Take to the air, or set back down.

CEActionToggleLookUp.name: Look up
CEActionToggleLookUp.description: You lift your head and look up at the sky.

CEWater.name: water
CEWater.description: You're definitely going to get your feet wet.

ActionBackToAi.name: Back to Ai
ActionBackToAi.description: Sends your mind back to the core.

ActionOpenRemoteDevicesMenu.name: Open list of remote devices
ActionOpenRemoteDevicesMenu.description: Opens a menu with available remote devices.

BiomeSourceTerritoryMiddle.name: territory middle ring biome source (runtime configured per GridTerritory)

DroneController.name: drone control server
DroneController.description: Pilots the drone it's on, if controlled by a drone control console.

ComputerDroneControl.name: drone control console
ComputerDroneControl.description: A console that lets you control linked drones.

ComputerDroneControlStation.name: station drone control console
ComputerDroneControlStation.description: A console that lets you control linked drones.

DroneControlCircuitboard.name: drone control console board
DroneControlCircuitboard.description: A computer printed circuit board for a drone control console.

ActionToggleTray.name: Toggle T-ray
ActionToggleTray.description: Toggles T-ray hud on and off.

ActionChitzite.name: Cough Up Chitzite
ActionChitzite.description: Purge the excess radiation build-up from your body, and gain a cool danger rock.

OrganChitinidStomach.name: stomach
OrganChitinidStomach.description: Gross. This is hard to stomach.

OrganFeroxiLungs.name: feroxian lungs and gills
OrganFeroxiLungs.description: A pair of amphibious lungs along with gills, filtering oxygen out of the air continuously.

OrganHarpyLungs.name: lungs
OrganHarpyLungs.description: An advanced pair of avian lungs. Filters oxygen by way of moving air constantly through air sacs.

BoxTapeRecorder.name: tape recorder box
BoxTapeRecorder.description: A box with colorful cassette tapes and a tape recorder.

ClothingHeadsetPrison.name: prisoner headset
ClothingHeadsetPrison.description: A headset used by prisoners. Criminally uncomfortable.

ClothingEyesGlassesMesonTray.name: advanced engineering goggles
ClothingEyesGlassesMesonTray.description: Protective meson goggles that have an integrated T-ray scanner and diagnostic HUD. The multilayer laminate protects from any intense flash.

ClothingUniformJumpsuitKilt.name: kilt
ClothingUniformJumpsuitKilt.description: A fine bit o' garb for the lad an' lasses.

MobFeroxiDummy.name: Feroxi Dummy
MobFeroxiDummy.description: A dummy feroxi meant to be used in character setup.

MobHarpyDummy.name: Urist McHands
MobHarpyDummy.description: A dummy Harpy meant to be used in character setup.

ActionHarpyPlayMidi.name: Play MIDI
ActionHarpyPlayMidi.description: Sing your heart out! Right click yourself to set an instrument.

ActionSyrinxChangeVoiceMask.name: Set name
ActionSyrinxChangeVoiceMask.description: Change the name others hear to something else.

MobRodentiaDummy.name: Rodentia Dummy
MobRodentiaDummy.description: A dummy rodentia meant to be used in character setup.

MobVulpkaninDummy.name: Vulpkanin Dummy
MobVulpkaninDummy.description: A dummy vulpkanin meant to be used in character setup.

MailMetricsCartridge.name: mail metrics cartridge
MailMetricsCartridge.description: A cartridge that tracks statistics related to mail deliveries.

TapeRecorder.name: tape recorder
TapeRecorder.description: Anything said into this device can and will be used against you in a court of space law.

CassetteTape.name: cassette tape
CassetteTape.description: A magnetic tape that can hold up to two minutes of content on either side.

WeaponRifleBB.name: BB Gun
WeaponRifleBB.description: The classic Red Ryder BB gun. Don't shoot your eye out.

FireExtinguisherBluespace.name: bluespace fire extinguisher
FireExtinguisherBluespace.description: An experimental fire extinguisher that uses bluespace technology to gradually refill itself. The faint blue glow is only slightly disconcerting.

CheekStorage.name: cheek storage
CheekStorage.description: The cheeks of an animal, capable of storing small objects.

PaperDyedGrass.name: PaperDyedGrass
PaperDyedGrass.description: A piece of grass green paper.

PaperDyedOcean.name: PaperDyedOcean
PaperDyedOcean.description: A piece of ocean blue paper.

PaperDyedSky.name: PaperDyedSky
PaperDyedSky.description: A piece of sky blue paper.

BoxReamClassic.name: Papermoon classic color paper ream
BoxReamClassic.description: Brighten up your records and more with Papermoon colored paper, in the six classic colors you've come to know and love. Dyed throughout for maximum colorfastness.

BoxReamBright.name: Papermoon happy color paper ream
BoxReamBright.description: Make getting a pink slip a joyous occassion with Papermoon colored paper, in six cheerful and vibrant colors. Dyed throughout for maximum colorfastness.

PaperStickyNote.name: sticky note
PaperStickyNote.description: A sticky note, for when you want your reminders to stick

PlantBagOfHolding.name: plant bag of holding
PlantBagOfHolding.description: A robust bag of holding for fruitful botanists with more plants than pockets.

Gavel.name: gavel
Gavel.description: A hardwood mallet made to keep order in the court.

GavelBlock.name: gavel block
GavelBlock.description: A hardwood block that, when hit with a gavel, emits an aura of authority.

TrialTimer.name: trial timer
TrialTimer.description: A fancy timer with a screen, designed to keep trials within their time limit.

VendingMachineRestockPride.name: Pride-O-Mat restock box
VendingMachineRestockPride.description: The station needs more plushie sharks and you know it. A label reads "THE BOX IS TAMPER-PROOF AND WILL DESTROY ITS CONTENT ON HARM."

Chitzite.name: chitzite
Chitzite.description: A small radioactive stone formed in the chest cavity of a radioactive chitinid, gross.... but kinda pretty?

WaterVaporTank.name: water vapor tank
WaterVaporTank.description: A standard cylindrical gas tank for water vapor. It can hold 5 L of gas.

EmergencyWaterVaporTank.name: emergency water vapor tank
EmergencyWaterVaporTank.description: An easily portable tank for emergencies. Contains very little water vapor, rated for survival use only. It can hold 0.66 L of gas.

ExtendedEmergencyWaterVaporTank.name: extended-capacity emergency water vapor tank
ExtendedEmergencyWaterVaporTank.description: An emergency tank with extended capacity. Technically rated for prolonged use. It can hold 1.5 L of gas.

DoubleEmergencyWaterVaporTank.name: double emergency water vapor tank
DoubleEmergencyWaterVaporTank.description: A high-grade dual-tank emergency life support container. It holds a decent amount of water vapor for its small size. It can hold 2.5 L of gas.

LatheUpgradeKitHyper.name: hyper-convection upgrade kit
LatheUpgradeKitHyper.description: An upgrade kit with all the parts needed to upgrade a lathe. This one will save materials at the cost of speed and producing heat.

LatheUpgradeKitCryo.name: cryo-stabilizing upgrade kit
LatheUpgradeKitCryo.description: An upgrade kit with all the parts needed to upgrade a lathe. This one will speed up production at the cost of freezing the area.

BreachingCharge.name: breaching charge
BreachingCharge.description: A breaching explosive for security officers to break through walls.

WeaponEnergyGun.name: energy gun
WeaponEnergyGun.description: A basic hybrid energy gun with two settings: disable and kill. On the handle is a label that says 'for authorized use only.'

WeaponCyborgEnergyGun.name: cyborg energy gun
WeaponCyborgEnergyGun.description: A basic hybrid energy gun with two settings: disable and kill. Designed for cyborgs. On the handle is a label that says 'for authorized use only.'

WeaponEnergyGunMultiphase.name: LWC X-01 multiphase energy gun
WeaponEnergyGunMultiphase.description: This is an expensive, modern recreation of an antique laser gun. This gun has several unique firemodes, but lacks the ability to recharge over time in exchange for a larger battery. On the handle is a label that says 'for authorized use only.'

WeaponPistolMk32.name: MA Mk32 "Universal" (9x19mm)
WeaponPistolMk32.description: A cheap, civilian grade, ubiquitous sidearm, produced by Midnight Arms Co. While it shares similarities to the MK58, it has been fully improved upon from it's Corporate War counterpart. Uses 9x19mm ammo.

WeaponPistolPollock.name: LWC C17 Pollock (9x19mm)
WeaponPistolPollock.description: A compact and mass-produced combat pistol. Uses 9x19mm ammo.

WeaponRifleVulcan.name: HWM FCM "Vulcan" (7.62x51mm)
WeaponRifleVulcan.description: One of the heaviest small arms to grace Security's armory, The Herstal Weapon Manufacture FCM (Fusil de Combat Moyen) "Vulcan", this rifle is a modern take on a classic, informally dubbed the "Right Arm of the Free World". Uses 7.62x51mm ammo.

WeaponSniperCeremonial.name: ceremonial rifle (7.62x51mm)
WeaponSniperCeremonial.description: A ceremonial variant of the Mark 1 Rifle, in tasteful blue and white. Uses 7.62x51mm ammo.

WeaponRifleJackdaw.name: CS CAWS-25 Jackdaw (6.35x40mm)
WeaponRifleJackdaw.description: The beginning of the end is heralded by the song of a Jackdaw. Uses 6.35x40mm Caseless ammo.

WeaponSubMachineGunTypewriter.name: PA Typewriter (.45 ACP)
WeaponSubMachineGunTypewriter.description: A modern take on the classic design used by mobsters throughout space and time. Uses .45 ACP ammo.

WoodenKeg.name: wooden keg
WoodenKeg.description: A musty old wooden keg, with a tap attached to the front.

WoodenKegRootBeer.name: root beer keg
WoodenKegRootBeer.description: A musty old wooden keg, with a tap attached to the front. Smells like root beer.

WoodenKegBeer.name: beer keg
WoodenKegBeer.description: A musty old wooden keg, with a tap attached to the front. Smells like beer.

WoodenKegWine.name: wine keg
WoodenKegWine.description: A musty old wooden keg, with a tap attached to the front. Smells like wine.

OrganIPCTongue.name: vocal modulator
OrganIPCTongue.description: A vocal modulator, used to produce speech.

OrganIPCPump.name: micro pump
OrganIPCPump.description: A micro pump, used to circulate coolant.

MobIPC.name: Urist McPositronic
MobIPC.description: A positronic brain in a metal body.

MobIPCDummy.name: Urist McPositronic
MobIPCDummy.description: A dummy IPC meant to be used in character setup.

BasicTauCetiBasicTranslatorImplant.name: basic common translator implant
BasicTauCetiBasicTranslatorImplant.description: Provides your illiterate friends the ability to understand the common galactic tongue.

TauCetiBasicTranslatorImplant.name: advanced common translator implant
TauCetiBasicTranslatorImplant.description: A more advanced version of the translator implant, teaches your illiterate friends the ability to both speak and understand the galactic tongue!

BubblishTranslatorImplant.name: bubblish translator implant
BubblishTranslatorImplant.description: An implant that helps you speak and understand the language of slimes! Special vocal chords not included.

NekomimeticTranslatorImplant.name: nekomimetic translator implant
NekomimeticTranslatorImplant.description: A translator implant intially designed to help domestic cat owners understand their pets, now granting the ability to understand and speak to Felinids!

DraconicTranslatorImplant.name: draconic translator implant
DraconicTranslatorImplant.description: A translator implant giving the ability to speak to dragons! Subsequently, also allows to communicate with the Unathi.

CanilunztTranslatorImplant.name: canilunzt translator implant
CanilunztTranslatorImplant.description: A translator implant that helps you communicate with your local yeepers. Yeep!

SolCommonTranslatorImplant.name: sol-common translator implant
SolCommonTranslatorImplant.description: An implant giving the ability to understand and speak SolCommon. Raaagh!

NovuNedericTranslatorImplant.name: novu-nederic translator implant
NovuNedericTranslatorImplant.description: An implant giving the ability to understand and speak Novu-Nederic. Hoezee!

RootSpeakTranslatorImplant.name: root-speak translator implant
RootSpeakTranslatorImplant.description: An implant that lets you speak for the trees. Or to the trees.

MofficTranslatorImplant.name: Moffic translator implant
MofficTranslatorImplant.description: An implant designed to help domesticate mothroaches. Subsequently, allows you to communicate with the moth people.

ElDwarfTranslatorImplant.name: el'dwarf translator implant
ElDwarfTranslatorImplant.description: An implant giving the ability to understand and speak ElDwarf. Rock!

AzazibaTranslatorImplant.name: azaziba translator implant
AzazibaTranslatorImplant.description: An implant giving the ability to understand and speak Azaziba.

ChittinTranslatorImplant.name: chittin translator implant
ChittinTranslatorImplant.description: An implant giving the ability to understand and speak Chittin.

MarishTranslatorImplant.name: marish translator implant
MarishTranslatorImplant.description: An implant giving the ability to understand and speak Marish.

NewKinPidginTranslatorImplant.name: ka'rakk translator implant
NewKinPidginTranslatorImplant.description: An implant giving the ability to understand and speak Ka'rakk.

TranslatorForeigner.name: foreigner's translator
TranslatorForeigner.description: A special-issue translator that helps foreigner's speak and understand this station's primary language.

CanilunztTranslator.name: Canilunzt translator
CanilunztTranslator.description: Translates speech between Canilunzt and Galactic Common, allowing your local yeepers to communicate with the locals and vice versa!

BubblishTranslator.name: Bubblish translator
BubblishTranslator.description: Translates speech between Bubblish and Galactic Common, helping communicate with slimes and slime people.

NekomimeticTranslator.name: Nekomimetic translator
NekomimeticTranslator.description: Translates speech between Nekomimetic and Galactic Common, enabling you to communicate with your pet cats.

DraconicTranslator.name: Sinta'Unathi translator
DraconicTranslator.description: Translates speech between Sinta'Unathi and Tau-Ceti Basic, making it easier to understand your local Unathi.

SolCommonTranslator.name: Sol Common translator
SolCommonTranslator.description: Translates speech between Sol Common and Galactic Common. Like a true Earthman!

NovuNedericTranslator.name: Novu-Nederic translator
NovuNedericTranslator.description: Translates speech between Novu-Nederic and Galactic Common. Like a true Earthman!

RootSpeakTranslator.name: RootSpeak translator
RootSpeakTranslator.description: Translates speech between RootSpeak and Galactic Common. You may now speak for the trees.

MofficTranslator.name: Moffic translator
MofficTranslator.description: Translates speech between Moffic and Galactic Common, helping you understand the buzzes of your pet mothroach!

XenoTranslator.name: Xeno translator
XenoTranslator.description: Translates speech between Xeno and Galactic Common. This will probably not help you survive an encounter, though.

AnimalTranslator.name: Animal translator
AnimalTranslator.description: Translates all the cutes noises that most animals make into a more understandable form!

ElDwarfTranslator.name: El'Dwarf Standard translator
ElDwarfTranslator.description: Translates speech between El'Dwarf and Tau-Ceti Basic. For talking to Dwarves!

AzazibaTranslator.name: Azaziba translator
AzazibaTranslator.description: Translates speech between Unathi and Azaziba. For Unathi to speak the Archaic form of their native tongue!

ChittinTranslator.name: Chittin translator
ChittinTranslator.description: Translates speech between Chittin and Tau-Ceti Basic. For talking to Chitinids!

MarishTranslator.name: Marish translator
MarishTranslator.description: Translates speech between Marish and Tau-Ceti Basic. For talking to Shadowkin!

NewKinPidginTranslator.name: Ka'rakk translator
NewKinPidginTranslator.description: Interprets speech for, colloquially, Vox Pidgin. It almost sounds... Alive, inside. Atleast it takes batteries!

ActionEmergencyTeleport.name: emergency teleport
ActionEmergencyTeleport.description: When the wearer enters critical condition, automatically teleports them to a random nearby location.

ActionChemicalImplant.name: Inject chemicats into bloodstream
ActionChemicalImplant.description: Bring chemicats from small capsules in implant and injure it to bloodstream

ActionStimulantsImplant.name: Inject stimulants into bloodstream
ActionStimulantsImplant.description: Bring stimulants into your bloodstream now

ActionCombatImplant.name: Inject medicals into bloodstream
ActionCombatImplant.description: Bring medicals into your bloodstream now

ActionLifeInsuranceRevive.name: Activate Life Insurance
ActionLifeInsuranceRevive.description: Spend one insurance policy to clone your body and return to life.

ActionMineralResonance.name: Mineral Resonance
ActionMineralResonance.description: Due to the resonance from clicking your jaw, you can recognize where the ore is located.

ActionPheromones.name: Pheromones
ActionPheromones.description: Spread your pheromones and ecrypt hidden message within it, only kidans like you can see and read it

ActionToggleActiveCloak.name: Toggle active cloak
ActionToggleActiveCloak.description: Turn on or off your active cloak device

ActionToggleGhostHiding.name: Toggle hiding
ActionToggleGhostHiding.description: Hides you from other observers making you visible only for admins

OrganTajaranEyes.name: tajaran eyes
OrganTajaranEyes.description: Looks like this cat has one less life.

ExodusCargoDeliveryCrate.name: shipping crate
ExodusCargoDeliveryCrate.description: A shipping crate used to pack bulk supply orders.

ClothingBackpackFleetLootT1.name: fleet container T1
ClothingBackpackFleetLootT1.description: A cache recovered from an autonomous fleet ship. Contains ship components and technical data.

ClothingBackpackFleetLootT2.name: fleet container T2
ClothingBackpackFleetLootT2.description: A cache recovered from a malfunctioning AI core. Contains ship components, technical data, plutonium and americium.

BoxAirGrenades.name: box of air grenades
BoxAirGrenades.description: A box containing six air grenades.

BoxAsakimBeaconKitFamily.name: beacon pack "Family"
BoxAsakimBeaconKitFamily.description: Three Zenith-line call beacons — baseline, A-variant, and E-variant.

BoxAsakimBeaconKitTwins.name: beacon pack "Twins"
BoxAsakimBeaconKitTwins.description: A matched pair of Concord-X call beacons.

BoxAsakimBeaconKitWing.name: beacon pack "Wing"
BoxAsakimBeaconKitWing.description: One Azimuth capital beacon and two Crow escorts.

BoxAsakimBeaconKitWatch.name: beacon pack "Watch"
BoxAsakimBeaconKitWatch.description: A Mantaray command beacon flanked by two Nebula hulls.

BoxAsakimBeaconKitAssault.name: beacon pack "Assault"
BoxAsakimBeaconKitAssault.description: Medium and small Asakim infantry vessel beacons.

BoxAsakimBeaconKitPearl.name: beacon pack "Pearl"
BoxAsakimBeaconKitPearl.description: Stratostar capital beacon with a small Asakim infantry escort.

BoxAsakimBeaconKitArgument.name: beacon pack "Argument"
BoxAsakimBeaconKitArgument.description: Razor-N strategic beacon with two Wyrm hulls as disposable cover.

BoxAsakimBeaconKitPrayer.name: beacon pack "Prayer"
BoxAsakimBeaconKitPrayer.description: Three Omen call beacons. Light hulls, rapid response.

CrateAsakimBeaconKitSurplus.name: sealed beacon allocation crate
CrateAsakimBeaconKitSurplus.description: A sealed pre-fracture allocation crate. Contains one random beacon pack. No refunds, no inventory list, no second chances.

CrateAsakimCloningKit.name: cloning kit crate
CrateAsakimCloningKit.description: Contains four flatpacks for constructing a cloning facility and one full stack of biomass.

CrateServiceHookah.name: ящик для кальяна
CrateServiceHookah.description: Полный набор для сборки кальяна: колба, шахта, блюдце, трубка, угли и табак.

CrateFactionDevelopmentMaterials.name: faction development materials crate
CrateFactionDevelopmentMaterials.description: Contains a strategic reserve of construction and research materials.

CrateEngineeringNebulaThrusterLarge.name: large phasic thruster crate
CrateEngineeringNebulaThrusterLarge.description: Contains a large phasic thruster flatpack.

CrateEngineeringNebulaThrusterCorner.name: corner phasic thruster crate
CrateEngineeringNebulaThrusterCorner.description: Contains a corner phasic thruster flatpack.

CrateWeaponTurretFang.name: Fang heavy 90mm autocannon crate
CrateWeaponTurretFang.description: Contains a Fang heavy 90mm autocannon flatpack.

CrateWeaponTurretM220.name: M220 RUBICON EMP launcher crate
CrateWeaponTurretM220.description: Contains a M220 RUBICON EMP launcher flatpack.

CrateWeaponTurretTarnyxReload.name: ADBX-31 TARNYX 150mm EMP Cannon crate
CrateWeaponTurretTarnyxReload.description: Contains ADBX-31 TARNYX 150mm EMP Cannon flatpack.

CrateWeaponTurretTovek.name: ADMX-250 TOVEK Missile Pod crate
CrateWeaponTurretTovek.description: Contains ADMX-250 TOVEK Missile Pod flatpack.

CrateWeaponTurretVespera.name: ADMP-50 VESPERA Missile Rack crate
CrateWeaponTurretVespera.description: Contains ADMP-50 VESPERA Missile Rack flatpack.

CrateWeaponTurretPrometheus.name: TPC Prometheus Laser Cannon crate
CrateWeaponTurretPrometheus.description: Contains TPC Prometheus Laser Cannon flatpack.

CrateWeaponTurretCerberus.name: TPC Cerberus Plasma scattercannon crate
CrateWeaponTurretCerberus.description: Contains TPC Cerberus Plasma scattercannon flatpack.

CrateWeaponTurretType35.name: Type-35 MARAUDER-type plasma cannon crate
CrateWeaponTurretType35.description: Contains Type-35 MARAUDER-type plasma cannon flatpack.

ClothingEyesHudChemMed.name: chem-medical hud
ClothingEyesHudChemMed.description: A heads-up display that scans the humanoids in view and provides accurate data about their health status and chemical composition of a solution.

ClothingHelmetHardsuitCenturionAsakim.name: centurion kasature-pattern combat harness helmet
ClothingHelmetHardsuitCenturionAsakim.description: Part of an advanced pre-fracture combat harness.

ClothingHelmetHardsuitPrefectAsakim.name: prefect kasature-pattern command harness helmet
ClothingHelmetHardsuitPrefectAsakim.description: The helmet of a senior pre-fracture Asakim command harness.

ClothingNeckCloakTalma.name: talma
ClothingNeckCloakTalma.description: Short shoulder cape. The lining is hand embroidered.

ClothingNeckCloakTravelerBlack.name: mantle of timelessness
ClothingNeckCloakTravelerBlack.description: Short shoulder cape. The lining is hand embroidered.

ClothingNeckCloakTravelerGold.name: mantle of the windsong
ClothingNeckCloakTravelerGold.description: Short shoulder cape. The lining is hand embroidered.

ClothingNeckCloakTravelerRed.name: mantle of memory
ClothingNeckCloakTravelerRed.description: Short shoulder cape. The lining is hand embroidered.

ClothingNeckCloakWebCloak.name: mantle of the spider kin
ClothingNeckCloakWebCloak.description: To the Arachnids, silk is more than mere material — it is a language frozen in patterns. Every thread, every curve is a tale woven from personal history, oaths, and the legacy of an entire bloodline. Such a gift is the rarest of honors, for to give another a piece of one's own fate is an act reserved only for those deemed equal... or worthy of becoming part of the Kin's story.

ClothingOuterHardsuitCenturionAsakim.name: centurion kasature-pattern combat exoskeleton
ClothingOuterHardsuitCenturionAsakim.description: An advanced exoskeleton harness of cutting edge, corporate-era technology. It connects itself directly to the brain of the wearer, and requires advanced brain augmentation and cybernetics to function. Incredibly rare, and practically alien in technology compared to modern tacsuits. Once equipped, the armor cannot be removed without external release.

ClothingBackpackExodusAbaddon.name: ABADDON backpack
ClothingBackpackExodusAbaddon.description: A combat backpack with a bluespace storage compartment.

ClothingBeltExodusAbaddon.name: ABADDON medical chest rig
