BorgModuleAsakimEsword.name: black shield energy sword cyborg module
BorgModuleAsakimEsword.description: A module that comes with a double energy sword and an Asakim neural pinpointer.

BorgModuleColossusSecurity.name: colossus security cyborg module
BorgModuleColossusSecurity.description: A law-enforcement module with a Lawbringer, stun baton, and a handcuff storage slot.

BorgModuleColossusField.name: colossus field cyborg module
BorgModuleColossusField.description: A module that comes with an energy shotgun and a force field projector.

BorgModuleColossusBreaching.name: colossus breaching cyborg module
BorgModuleColossusBreaching.description: A module that comes with a cyborg-adapted breaching hammer.

BorgModuleColossusCombat.name: colossus combat cyborg module
BorgModuleColossusCombat.description: A heavy combat module with a self-loading Anaconda and a high-frequency katana.

BorgModuleBluespaceRPED.name: bluespace RPED cyborg module
BorgModuleBluespaceRPED.description: An engineering cyborg module that provides a bluespace RPED.

CyborgEndoskeletonColossusSecurity.name: colossus security cyborg endoskeleton
CyborgEndoskeletonColossusSecurity.description: A reinforced cyborg frame configured for assembling a Colossus-Central security cyborg.

CyborgEndoskeletonPDV.name: PDV cyborg endoskeleton
CyborgEndoskeletonPDV.description: A cyborg frame configured for assembling a PDV cyborg.

CyborgEndoskeletonTSF.name: TSF cyborg endoskeleton
CyborgEndoskeletonTSF.description: A cyborg frame configured for assembling a TSF cyborg.

BorgModuleMalfSRD.name: hacked ship repair cyborg module
BorgModuleMalfSRD.description: A module with a regenerating ship repair device for malfunctioning drone vessels and a self-recharging RCD.

BorgModuleMalfEsword.name: hacked double energy sword cyborg module
BorgModuleMalfEsword.description: A module with a double energy sword adapted for malfunctioning drone cyborgs.

BorgModuleMalfWeapon.name: hacked heavy weapon cyborg module
BorgModuleMalfWeapon.description: A module with one-handed Anubis and Ratel weapons that regenerate their own ammunition.

TechDiskColossusBorgModules.name: colossus cyborg modules tech disk
TechDiskColossusBorgModules.description: A disk capable of adding Colossus-Central cyborg field and breaching modules to a server's recipes.

TechDiskColossusSecurityBorgEndoskeleton.name: colossus security cyborg endoskeleton tech disk
TechDiskColossusSecurityBorgEndoskeleton.description: A disk capable of adding a Colossus-Central security cyborg endoskeleton to a server's recipes.

HookahFlask.name: колба кальяна
HookahFlask.description: Стеклянная колба. Основа кальяна — вставьте шахту.

HookahSaucer.name: блюдце кальяна
HookahSaucer.description: Металлическое блюдце. Вставьте в колбу с шахтой.

HookahPartial.name: колба с шахтой
HookahPartial.description: Колба с вставленной шахтой. Добавьте блюдце.

HookahElectric.name: электрический кальян
HookahElectric.description: Современный кальян с электрическим нагревателем. Без углей, без огня - только табак и батарейка.

HookahElectricSponsorBox.name: коробка с электрическим кальяном
HookahElectricSponsorBox.description: Внутри современный электрический кальян. Без углей, без огня - только табак и батарейка.

HookahElectricHose.name: трубка электрического кальяна
HookahElectricHose.description: Гибкий шланг. Один конец - в кальян, другой - в лёгкие.

ExodusBiohazardSprayer.name: biohazard foam sprayer
ExodusBiohazardSprayer.description: A self-replenishing foam sprayer for clearing chimera biomass and rot vines. Activate it in hand and remain still while it prepares a discharge.

ExodusBiohazardSprayerAbaddon.name: Abaddon biohazard foam sprayer
ExodusBiohazardSprayerAbaddon.description: A self-replenishing foam sprayer for the Abaddon squad. Instantly releases decontamination foam when activated in hand and regenerates its charge in 10 seconds.

ShipRepairDeviceMalf.name: hacked SRD
ShipRepairDeviceMalf.description: A regenerating ship repair device configured to reconstruct malfunctioning drone vessels. Holds 800 charges.

ShipRepairDeviceAsakimRedacted.name: asakim pre-fracture SRD
ShipRepairDeviceAsakimRedacted.description: A resonant ship repair device keyed to Asakim neural patterns.

ShipRepairDeviceSyndicate.name: syndicate SRD
ShipRepairDeviceSyndicate.description: A resonant ship repair device keyed to Syndicate operative neural patterns.

CartridgeLightPhaserMaco.name: MACo light phaser cartridge
CartridgeLightPhaserMaco.description: A disposable plutonium cartridge for one shot from a Midnight Arms Co. light phaser. The weapon holds two cartridges. This is not a rechargeable battery.

BulletLightPhaserMaco.name: phaser pulse
BulletLightPhaserMaco.description: A fast, broad energy pulse fired by a phaser.

WeaponSmartLmgAsakimBorg.name: SKR-WS MLA-79 cyborg smart LMG
WeaponSmartLmgAsakimBorg.description: A cyborg-integrated MLA-79 with a compact ammunition fabricator.

WeaponLightPhaserMaco.name: MACo light phaser
WeaponLightPhaserMaco.description: A bulky handheld phaser manufactured by Midnight Arms Co. Holds two disposable plutonium cartridges. Requires both hands to fire a broad pulse capable of severing a limb. Can be carried on the back.

WeaponTurretMalf.name: hacked turret
WeaponTurretMalf.description: An automated ballistic turret reprogrammed to protect malfunctioning drones and their allied autonomous drone ships.

WeaponGravityProjector.name: gravitational projector
WeaponGravityProjector.description: A gravitational projector that fires a spreading wave, pushing back personnel and damaging structures. Its force diminishes with distance.

WeaponKunisaMachineGun.name: Kunisa plasma machine gun
WeaponKunisaMachineGun.description: A heavy infantry variant of the Kunisa autopulser with an enlarged capacitor and reinforced emitter cooling.

SecBreachingHammerBorg.name: cyborg breaching hammer
SecBreachingHammerBorg.description: A breaching hammer adapted for cyborg use. Its reinforced actuator gives it the full force of a two-handed swing without requiring a second hand.

WeaponEnergyHalberdMARSOC.name: energy halberd
WeaponEnergyHalberdMARSOC.description: A polearm issued to TSF assault teams, its energy blade glowing pale blue. Reflected shots feed the smite capacitor, ready to discharge into an enemy with a crack of thunder.

CyborgMonomolecularBlade.name: monomolecular blade
CyborgMonomolecularBlade.description: A cyborg-mounted blade with a monomolecular edge, designed to sever limbs in close combat.

PlasteelArmingSwordEngraveable.name: plasteel arming sword
PlasteelArmingSwordEngraveable.description: An ancient design manufactured with modern materials and machines for a very specific target demographic.

IronFoamGrenade.name: iron foam grenade
IronFoamGrenade.description: An emergency tool used for patching up hull breaches with iron foam.

AsakimKudzuGrenade.name: synthetic vine grenade
AsakimKudzuGrenade.description: A VEF field medical grenade that deploys a slowly expanding network of synthetic filaments. Treats oxygen deprivation on contact without hindering movement.

WeaponLRC21PPLExodusAbaddon.name: ABADDON LRC-21 PPL
WeaponLRC21PPLExodusAbaddon.description: A TSF-biocoded pulsed plasma lance with an integrated reactor and a semi-automatic firing system.

WeaponHeavyPulseCannonExodusAbaddon.name: ABADDON heavy pulse cannon
WeaponHeavyPulseCannonExodusAbaddon.description: A compact TSF-biocoded pulse cannon with a continuously replenished energy reserve.

WeaponPulseAnnihilatorExodusAbaddon.name: ABADDON pulse ANNIHILATOR
WeaponPulseAnnihilatorExodusAbaddon.description: A TSF-biocoded pulse shotgun with an integrated reactor. Each volley fires six full-power rifle pulses. Can be fired one-handed.

WeaponMurasamaExodusAbaddon.name: ABADDON Murasama
WeaponMurasamaExodusAbaddon.description: A Murasama high-frequency blade biocoded for TSF personnel.

EnergySwordExodusAbaddon.name: ABADDON energy sword
EnergySwordExodusAbaddon.description: An energy sword biocoded for TSF personnel.

CyborgWeaponMalfAnubis.name: hacked cyborg Anubis
CyborgWeaponMalfAnubis.description: A one-handed Anubis grenade launcher adapted for cyborg use. Its internal fabricator holds six SAPHE grenades and regenerates one every ten seconds.

CyborgWeaponMalfRatel.name: hacked cyborg Ratel
CyborgWeaponMalfRatel.description: A one-handed Ratel machine gun adapted for cyborg use. Its internal fabricator holds sixty 7.62x51mm FMJ rounds and regenerates one every second.

CyborgWeaponLMGGrizzly.name: RMP-68 "Grizzly" (6.8x52mm caseless)
CyborgWeaponLMGGrizzly.description: A medium machine gun adapted for cyborg use. Its internal ammo fabricator cannot be reloaded externally and slowly recharges itself.

CyborgWeaponLaserTurboNF.name: cyborg turbo laser mk3
CyborgWeaponLaserTurboNF.description: A turbo laser adapted for cyborg use. Its internal power system cannot be reloaded externally and slowly recharges itself.

CyborgWeaponTeslaGun.name: CyborgWeaponTeslaGun
CyborgWeaponTeslaGun.description: A tesla gun adapted for cyborg use. Its internal power system cannot be reloaded externally and slowly recharges itself.

CyborgWeaponLauncherRocket.name: PA RPG-7
CyborgWeaponLauncherRocket.description: A rocket launcher adapted for cyborg use. Its internal ammo fabricator cannot be reloaded externally and slowly recharges itself.

WeaponEnergyShotgunBorg.name: cyborg NT energy shotgun
WeaponEnergyShotgunBorg.description: A prototype energy shotgun adapted for cyborg use. It offers lethal and non-lethal shotgun modes and slowly recharges itself.

CyborgEnergyCutlass.name: cyborg energy cutlass
CyborgEnergyCutlass.description: An energy cutlass adapted for cyborg use.

220mmCartridgeSAPHE.name: 220mm SAPHE shell
220mmCartridgeSAPHE.description: A semi-armor-piercing high-explosive shell for TYPHON 220mm autocannons. Penetrates less than APHE, but detonates with a much larger blast.

WeaponTurretShardAnchorable.name: Light mass driver "Shard"
WeaponTurretShardAnchorable.description: Ultralight mass driver weapon of unknown origin, designated "Shard" during initial reverse engineering attempts. Light damage, but long range and little upkeep to mount on ships.

WeaponTurretPinholeAnchorable.name: Pinhole-class railgun
WeaponTurretPinholeAnchorable.description: Mass driver weapon of unknown origin. Reverse engineering attempts have indicated extremely high projectile velocity and high-mass projectiles with unresolved ship-pushing payload.

WeaponTurretTyphon.name: TYPHON 220mm autocannon
WeaponTurretTyphon.description: A single-barrel 220mm autocannon for sustained automatic fire. Fires 220mm auto shells with slightly reduced brute strength. Can be remotely activated or linked up to a GCS.

WeaponHarpoonGusar.name: KA-S1 GUSAR
WeaponHarpoonGusar.description: A weapon that fires a hook with incredible piercing power. Can hold other shuttles. Don't fire it at those stronger than you.

WeaponHarpoonBorodinskiy.name: KA-H BORODINSKIY
WeaponHarpoonBorodinskiy.description: A weapon that fires a hook with incredible piercing power. Can hold other shuttles. Don't fire it at those stronger than you.

WeaponTurretRainMissile.name: Rain rocket launcher
WeaponTurretRainMissile.description: A self-loading fixed missile launcher. It fires light guided rockets at high speed.

WeaponTurretSliverMissile.name: Sliver rocket launcher
WeaponTurretSliverMissile.description: A self-loading fixed missile launcher. It fires light guided rockets.

WeaponTurretAC-35.name: AC-35 Chaingun
WeaponTurretAC-35.description: A quad-barrel, 35mm chaingun firing solid shot AP rounds, designed to be mounted upon fighters by Armamenti Corvus. Can be remotely activated or linked up to a GCS.

ExodusChimeraCore.name: hive heart
ExodusChimeraCore.description: A crimson heart heaves between plates of bone. Thick veins burrow beneath the plating, and the surrounding flesh shudders with every beat. The air reeks of warm blood and raw meat.

ActionGrowChimeraCore.name: Grow hive heart
ActionGrowChimeraCore.description: Root a living heart in a station free of another's banner. Remain still while the flesh binds to the chosen patch of floor: a sudden movement or wound will interrupt its growth.

BannerPDV.name: PDV banner
BannerPDV.description: A banner displaying the sigil of the Phaeton Dynasty.

BannerKhsira.name: Khsira banner
BannerKhsira.description: A banner bearing the emblem of the Khsira Empire.

BannerUSSP.name: USSP banner
BannerUSSP.description: A banner displaying the colors of the USSP.

CompanyTerritoryBannerTSFCivilian.name: TSF civilian banner
CompanyTerritoryBannerTSFCivilian.description: A blue-and-white banner bearing the star of the Trans-Solar Federation.

CompanyTerritoryBannerPDVCivilian.name: PDV civilian banner
CompanyTerritoryBannerPDVCivilian.description: A burgundy banner with pale vertical stripes and the Phaethon Dynasty's golden sigil.

ComputerAsakimComms.name: asakim communications computer
ComputerAsakimComms.description: A pre-fracture communications console keyed to Asakim neural patterns.

ComputerShipyardCitadel.name: citadel shipyard console
ComputerShipyardCitadel.description: Used to commission imperial yachts from the Citadel shipyard reserves.

DrakeBomb.name: Drake Industries bomb
DrakeBomb.description: A heavy timed bomb manufactured by Drake Industries.

BulkAutoMiningEmitter.name: automated mining laser
BulkAutoMiningEmitter.description: A ship-mounted mining laser. Converts original asteroid and planetoid terrain to liquid metal and supplies it to a refinery through an ore duct underneath. Firing at artificial grids damages the emitter.

BulkAutoMiningEmitterCircuitboard.name: bulk mining laser board
BulkAutoMiningEmitterCircuitboard.description: An industrial laser control board. Assembly requires three units of americium.

BulkAutoMiningConsole.name: mining laser fire-control console
BulkAutoMiningConsole.description: Select asteroid grids on the radar to coordinate powered mining lasers on this ship.

BulkAutoMiningConsoleCircuitboard.name: mining laser fire-control board
BulkAutoMiningConsoleCircuitboard.description: A circuit board for a mining laser fire-control console.

BulkMiningRefinery.name: liquid metal refinery
BulkMiningRefinery.description: Separates ore from liquid metal and produces extremely toxic chlorine trifluoride. Connect an ore duct underneath and an armored gas pipe just beyond the south edge of the body, two tiles from the center, leading to a mining exhaust injector. Trapped gas corrodes the machine; overfilling causes a powerful explosion.

BulkMiningExhaust.name: mining exhaust injector
BulkMiningExhaust.description: A two-tile exhaust unit that discharges chlorine trifluoride through its north-facing nozzle every 27 seconds. Connect armored gas pipes to the south-facing inlet and aim the nozzle into space.

BulkMiningExhaustCircuitboard.name: mining exhaust injector board
BulkMiningExhaustCircuitboard.description: A circuit board for an industrial waste gas injector.

BulkMiningRefineryLarge.name: industrial liquid metal refinery
BulkMiningRefineryLarge.description: A 5x5 refinery with large reserves and four replaceable filters. A full local tank reduces material costs by up to 20%; each working filter saves another 5%. Produces twice the exhaust gas. Connect armored gas pipes three tiles south of its center. Incompatible with hyper-convection upgrades.

BulkMiningLinkRelay.name: liquid metal relay laser
BulkMiningLinkRelay.description: A simplified mining laser that links liquid metal networks between ships. It cannot excavate terrain. Connect an ore duct underneath and establish a link from a mining console.

BulkMiningLinkRelayCircuitboard.name: liquid metal relay laser board
BulkMiningLinkRelayCircuitboard.description: A circuit board for a relay laser that connects liquid metal networks without mining equipment.

ExodusDatafarmResearchFaction100.name: ExodusDatafarmResearchFaction100
ExodusDatafarmResearchFaction100.description: A power-hungry server dedicated to gathering research data. It generates 100 research points per second and is bolted to the floor.

UnfinishedMachineFrame3x3Centered.name: centered machine frame (3x3)
UnfinishedMachineFrame3x3Centered.description: A machine under construction with its mounting point in the center. Needs more parts.

MachineFrame3x3Centered.name: centered machine frame (3x3)
MachineFrame3x3Centered.description: A wired machine frame with its mounting point in the center.

MachineFrameDestroyed3x3Centered.name: destroyed centered machine frame (3x3)
MachineFrameDestroyed3x3Centered.description: The remains of a machine with its mounting point in the center. Can be salvaged with a welding tool.

UnfinishedMachineFrame5x5.name: machine frame (5x5)
UnfinishedMachineFrame5x5.description: A large machine under construction. Needs more parts.

MachineFtlSuppressorTsf.name: BS-1000 "Bastion" bluespace suppressor
MachineFtlSuppressorTsf.description: A TSF interdiction device. While powered it projects a 1 km bluespace suppression field that no ship can FTL out of or into, including the ship carrying it.

MachineFtlSuppressorPdv.name: "Lasso" bluespace suppressor
MachineFtlSuppressorPdv.description: A compact Phaeton Dynasty interdictor. While powered it projects a 750 m bluespace suppression field that no ship can FTL out of or into, including the ship carrying it.

MachineShipDrillLarge.name: large ship drill
MachineShipDrillLarge.description: A massive drill for mining in front of large salvage shuttles.

LifeInsuranceScanner.name: life insurance scanning capsule
LifeInsuranceScanner.description: A patient scanning capsule that records DNA onto a linked life insurance console.

LifeInsuranceCloner.name: life insurance cloning capsule
LifeInsuranceCloner.description: A cloning capsule that rebuilds an insured patient's body on demand.

LifeInsuranceConsole.name: life insurance console
LifeInsuranceConsole.description: Records patient DNA, sells life insurance policies, and runs the cloning capsule.

ShipRepairDroneStationMalf.name: hacked repair drone station
ShipRepairDroneStationMalf.description: A repair drone station reprogrammed by a malfunctioning AI, with five hacked drones and a rechargeable backup battery.

ShieldGeneratorMediumMalf.name: MS-250 "Fracture" shield generator
ShieldGeneratorMediumMalf.description: A scarred MS-250 kept running by an unrelenting will. Heavy crimson waves writhe across its field. Scratched into the scorched panel is a command: "HOLD THE LINE. LOSSES ARE UNACCEPTABLE."

MiningSlurryTank.name: liquid metal tank
MiningSlurryTank.description: A compact industrial tank that stores liquid metal without electricity. Connect an ore duct beneath its center and anchor the tank to connect it to the network. Unanchoring preserves its contents.

MiningSlurryTankLarge.name: industrial liquid metal tank
MiningSlurryTankLarge.description: A large 3x3 industrial tank that stores liquid metal without electricity. Connect an ore duct beneath its center and anchor the tank to connect it to the network. Unanchoring preserves its contents.

MiningSlurryTankCircuitboard.name: liquid metal tank board
MiningSlurryTankCircuitboard.description: A circuit board for a compact liquid metal tank.

MiningSlurryTankLargeCircuitboard.name: industrial liquid metal tank board
MiningSlurryTankLargeCircuitboard.description: A circuit board for a large liquid metal tank. Requires a centered 3x3 machine frame.

ScuttleDeviceTacticalNuclear.name: tactical nuclear charge
ScuttleDeviceTacticalNuclear.description: A mobile high-yield nuclear charge with a 90-second timer. Its countdown continues during transport, even outside a station.

ShieldGeneratorMS750.name: MS-750 "Prometheus" Shield Generator
ShieldGeneratorMS750.description: Pre-fracture shielding salvaged from a sealed armoury. Massive capacity, radiates while active, and overloads catastrophically.

ShieldGeneratorMS1000.name: MS-1000 "Triptych" Shield Generator
ShieldGeneratorMS1000.description: A white resonant shield generator that projects three nested field layers. A critical overload collapses one layer and vents part of the stored load before the core is exposed.

ShieldGeneratorPOISmall.name: FS-411 "Outpost" Shield Generator
ShieldGeneratorPOISmall.description: The Outpost. A static-deployment derivative of the Sentinel - same compact profile and recharge cycle, hardened against kinetic impacts for fixed installations.

ShieldGeneratorMS150.name: MS-150 "Sentinel" Shield Generator
ShieldGeneratorMS150.description: Developed by the Sintez Holding for protection against asteroid collisions. Weak against projectiles.

ShipRepairDroneStation.name: repair drone station
ShipRepairDroneStation.description: A base with five reserved berths for ship repair drones and a rechargeable backup battery.

SlotMachine.name: slot machine
SlotMachine.description: One-armed bandit. The house always wins.

VendingMachineNanoMedPlusHospital.name: NanoMed Plus
VendingMachineNanoMedPlusHospital.description: NanoMed Plus in a special product configuration. Don't hesitate to use it!

GasPipeArmoredBroken.name: broken armored gas pipe
GasPipeArmoredBroken.description: Ruptured armor and torn inner lining. It can no longer carry gas.

BulkMiningPipe.name: ore duct
BulkMiningPipe.description: A subfloor duct that carries liquid metal. Lay it under machines on exposed plating to connect them.

BulkMiningPipeStack.name: ore duct coil
BulkMiningPipeStack.description: A coil of subfloor ore ducts for linking automated mining lasers to refineries.

GeneratorASRG.name: ASRG
GeneratorASRG.description: A radioisotope Stirling generator for long-term power. It only runs while surrounded by enough atmosphere.

GeneratorASRGDamaged.name: damaged ASRG
GeneratorASRGDamaged.description: A radioisotope Stirling generator for long-term power. This one has damaged shielding and still needs enough atmosphere to run.

GyrodyneMachineCircuitboard.name: gyrodyne machine board
GyrodyneMachineCircuitboard.description: A machine board for a gyrodyne. A powerful bluespace-assisted gyroscope.

Gyrodyne.name: gyrodyne
Gyrodyne.description: A massive bluespace-assisted gyroscope capable of rotating even the largest vessels. Requires significant power to operate.

NebulaThruster.name: phasic thruster
NebulaThruster.description: A shuttle thruster tuned to underperform in open space and overperform in nebula fields.

NebulaThrusterLarge.name: large phasic thruster
NebulaThrusterLarge.description: A three-tile-wide phasic thruster with five times the thrust of a standard phasic thruster.

NebulaThrusterCorner.name: corner phasic thruster
NebulaThrusterCorner.description: A compact phasic thruster with two independently controlled nozzles at right angles.

VacuumGradientThrusterMachineCircuitboar.name: vacuum gradient thruster machine board
VacuumGradientThrusterMachineCircuitboar.description: A machine board for a vacuum gradient thruster. Handle with radiation protection.

VacuumGradientThruster.name: vacuum gradient thruster
VacuumGradientThruster.description: A massive thruster that manipulates vacuum energy gradients for propulsion. Does not require open space to operate. Highly radioactive when active.

PosterContrabandYesERP.name: Yes ERP
PosterContrabandYesERP.description: Sometimes you just need to say “YES”

WallNanolaminateShielded.name: shielded nanolaminate wall
WallNanolaminateShielded.description: A dense wall made of a strange material with additional radiation shielding.

WallNanolaminateShieldedDiagonal.name: shielded nanolaminate wall
WallNanolaminateShieldedDiagonal.description: A dense wall made of a strange material with additional radiation shielding.

BoxSorter.name: box sorter
BoxSorter.description: Sorts trade crates from the conveyor to teleporter pads by destination. Frames for new pads are stored inside.

CargoBoxTeleporter.name: cargo teleporter
CargoBoxTeleporter.description: Destination point for sorted cargo boxes. Place on an outgoing conveyor line so boxes ride on after arrival. Its channel number is set by clicking on it.

CargoTeleporterFrame.name: teleporter frame
CargoTeleporterFrame.description: A folded teleporter pad. Use it on a conveyor to deploy the exit.

BoxSorterMachineCircuitboard.name: box sorter machine board
BoxSorterMachineCircuitboard.description: A machine printed circuit board for a cargo sorter.

FoamTrapAssembly.name: foam trap assembly
FoamTrapAssembly.description: An incomplete foam trap frame. Insert a foam grenade to arm it.

FoamTrapAluminium.name: aluminium foam trap
FoamTrapAluminium.description: An armed trap loaded with an aluminium foam grenade. Releases foam when destroyed.

FoamTrapNanolaminate.name: nanolaminate foam trap
FoamTrapNanolaminate.description: An armed trap loaded with a nanolaminate foam grenade. Releases reinforced foam when destroyed.

FoamTrapIron.name: iron foam trap
FoamTrapIron.description: An armed trap loaded with an iron foam grenade. Releases iron foam when destroyed.

RouletteTable.name: XenoRoulette table
RouletteTable.description: A casino roulette table connected to the station banking network.

GeneticHealingCocoon.name: fluffy cocoon
GeneticHealingCocoon.description: A snug cocoon woven from soft silk. It feels warm and peaceful inside.

GeneticHealingCocoonBroken.name: torn cocoon
GeneticHealingCocoonBroken.description: Scraps of silk left behind by a torn cocoon.

FoodCakeEyeKidan.name: eye cake
FoodCakeEyeKidan.description: A cake from someone else's eyes. You have a hard time holding back the tears when you look at it.

FoodBurgerKidan.name: kidan burger
FoodBurgerKidan.description: You wouldn't tell from the looks of it that the secret ingredient is kidan.

FoodMealKidanStick.name: kidan on a stick
FoodMealKidanStick.description: Skewered pieces of meat. It looks delicious until you don't know whose meat has been cooked.

FoodMeatKidanCutletCooked.name: kidan cooked cutlet
FoodMeatKidanCutletCooked.description: They say the meat contains a magic potion. It will make you the strongest wizard in the world.

FoodSoupKidan.name: ground soup
FoodSoupKidan.description: Fresh and refreshing, it has a slight earthy aftertaste. Great for breakfast.

EncryptionKeyMedicalSpeak.name: medical encryption key
EncryptionKeyMedicalSpeak.description: An encryption key used by those who save lives.

EncryptionKeyAsakimRemnants.name: Asakim remnants encryption key
EncryptionKeyAsakimRemnants.description: An integrated encryption key for Asakim combat exoskeletons.

HoloGeneric.name: holo projector
HoloGeneric.description: Stop suicidal passengers from killing everyone during atmos emergencies.

SkechiTranslatorImplant.name: Skechi translator implant
SkechiTranslatorImplant.description: An implant giving the ability to understand and speak Skechi.

SkechiTranslator.name: Skechi translator
SkechiTranslator.description: Translates speech between Skechi and Tau-Ceti. Its for talking with resomi!

GoJuiceChemistryBottle.name: go-juice bottle
GoJuiceChemistryBottle.description: A bottle of combat stimulant. Contains 30 units of go-juice.

VirologistPDA.name: virology PDA
VirologistPDA.description: Smells faintly of bleach and quarantine tape.

CrateExodusPdvSupply1.name: Phaethon Dynasty supply crate
CrateExodusPdvSupply1.description: Sealed Vanguard supplies. Selling the intact crate at a cargo depot pays the courier and funds PDV requisitions.

CrateExodusPdvSupply2.name: Phaethon Dynasty supply crate
CrateExodusPdvSupply2.description: Sealed Vanguard supplies. Selling the intact crate at a cargo depot pays the courier and funds PDV requisitions.

CrateExodusPdvSupply3.name: Phaethon Dynasty supply crate
CrateExodusPdvSupply3.description: Sealed Vanguard supplies. Selling the intact crate at a cargo depot pays the courier and funds PDV requisitions.

CrateExodusPdvSupply4.name: Phaethon Dynasty supply crate
CrateExodusPdvSupply4.description: Sealed Vanguard supplies. Selling the intact crate at a cargo depot pays the courier and funds PDV requisitions.

CrateExodusPdvSupply5.name: Phaethon Dynasty supply crate
CrateExodusPdvSupply5.description: Sealed Vanguard supplies. Selling the intact crate at a cargo depot pays the courier and funds PDV requisitions.

VirusActionLaserEyes.name: laser eyes
VirusActionLaserEyes.description: Fire a laser from your eyes at a chosen spot. Every shot scorches your own eyes.

ActionVirusFireBreathing.name: fire breathing
ActionVirusFireBreathing.description: Hurl a fireball at a chosen spot. It burns the target, and you catch fire too.

ActionToggleKeenHearing.name: keen hearing
ActionToggleKeenHearing.description: Listen for nearby heartbeats, even through walls.

ActionRotSatedConsume.name: Consume corpse
ActionRotSatedConsume.description: Strip and consume a nearby corpse, then give birth to larvae.

ActionRotSatedStop.name: Stop consuming
ActionRotSatedStop.description: Interrupt feeding and regain movement. Already formed larvae will be born.

ActionRotSatedStrike.name: Ground strike
ActionRotSatedStrike.description: Smash structures in the 3 by 3 area beneath you.

VirusImmunityImplant.name: virus immunity implant
VirusImmunityImplant.description: A microscopic chip that renders the bearer immune to every virus.

CrateDiseaseMachineBoards.name: disease machine board crate

These rare, organic piezoelectric crystals are of incredible cultural significance to the artist castes of the Ethereals, owing to their appearance; which is exactly similar to that of an Ethereal's heart. Which one you have in your suit is unclear, but either way, it's been repurposed to be an internal power source for a Modular Outerwear Device.

WeaponEnergyGunLawbringer.name: DT-12 Lawbringer

WeaponSubMachineSmart.name: MMC Abielle Smart-SMG (.160 smart)
WeaponSubMachineSmart.description: An experiment in smart-weapon technology that guides bullets towards the target the gun was aimed at when fired. While the tracking functions work fine, the gun is prone to insanely wide spread thanks to its practically non-existant barrel.

WeaponStasisGun.name: stasis gun
WeaponStasisGun.description: A device to stop the temporal flow of any living (or not) creature

EnergySwordWelder.name: welder energy sword
EnergySwordWelder.description: Roughly converted from a welding tool, this energy sword hums an unstable flame. It looks like it's about to fall apart.

EnergySwordWelderExperimental.name: welder energy sword
EnergySwordWelderExperimental.description: A very loud & dangerous sword with a beam made of pure, concentrated plasma. Cuts through unarmored targets like butter.

UnfinishedWelderSword.name: unfinished welder sword
UnfinishedWelderSword.description: A crude assembly of parts that vaguely resembles a weapon. It's completely non-functional.

MantisBlade.name: mantis blade
MantisBlade.description: They won’t see the steel until it’s too late.

StasisBaton.name: futuristic stunbaton
StasisBaton.description: An advanced security baton for shutting down interfering tiders

NavyOfficerSabre.name: navy officer's sabre
NavyOfficerSabre.description: Plastitanium sabre used primarily in ceremonies by naval officers, it remains a proven weapon.

HyperFlash.description: An ultrabright flashbulb with a trigger. This one seems to be much more potent than an ordinary one.

TimelineDisruptor.description: A device capable of extracting an object placed inside from the current timeline.

ActionBlackFlash.description: Throw a hit with all of your strength. This will drain a lot of stamina.

ActionSpawnBiomassWall.description: Spawns a thick wall of biomass.

ActionCorticalBorerInfest.name: Infest
ActionCorticalBorerInfest.description: Infest target Humanoid. Target host must have a bloodstream.

ActionCheckBlood.name: Check Blood
ActionCheckBlood.description: Inspect the blood of your host to see how they are doing.

ActionControlHost.name: Take Control
ActionControlHost.description: Take full control of your host, lasts for 40 seconds on awake hosts.

ActionEndControlHost.name: Relinquish Control
ActionEndControlHost.description: Give up hold of the host's body early.

ActionLayEggHost.name: Lay Egg
ActionLayEggHost.description: Force your host to vomit an egg. Costs 200 chemicals.

ActionDashMuscleFibersImplant.name: muscle fibers dash
ActionDashMuscleFibersImplant.description: Use your muscle fibers implant to do a quick dash.

ActionEnergyCyberneticsShuntTSF.name: KR-22 implant shunt
ActionEnergyCyberneticsShuntTSF.description: Teleport to anywhere you can see.

ActionScrammerScramADM.name: SCRAM!
ActionScrammerScramADM.description: Randomly teleports you within a moderate distance.

ActionActivatePersonalShield.name: Activate personal shield
ActionActivatePersonalShield.description: Activates suit's personal energy shield that slowly consumes battery charge.

OrganAsakimBrain.name: asakim brain
OrganAsakimBrain.description: A mess of flesh and silicon, veins interlaced with unknown implants and cybernetics.

OrganAsakimHeart.name: asakim heart
OrganAsakimHeart.description: A large heart, capable of metabolizing more chemicals at once.

OrganAsakimLungs.name: asakim lungs
OrganAsakimLungs.description: Heavy, huge lungs, genetically engineered to assist in energizing the body's raw strength in melee.

OrganChimeraStomach.name: chimera stomach
OrganChimeraStomach.description: A strange organ that serves as the center for the metabolism of a Chimera.

OrganChimeraBrain.name: chimera brain
OrganChimeraBrain.description: The heart of a chimera growth.

OrganChimeraLiver.name: chimera spike gland
OrganChimeraLiver.description: Takes the location of the liver in the body, and repurposes them to be used as a gland for growing bone spikes instead.

OrganChimeraLungs.name: chimera pheropod
OrganChimeraLungs.description: Distributes pheromones allowing for hivemind communication with other Chimeras. Serves as the lungs for the parasite as well.

OrganHeartTSFSandevistan.name: TSF WJY-21X "Leuko" implant suite
OrganHeartTSFSandevistan.description: An experimental piece of cyberware developed under contract by Erebus HI that replaces the heart. Equipped with an experimental reverse-engineered slower-recharging design of a MMC sandevistan.

OrganHeartTSFShunt.name: TSF KR-22 "Zenit" implant suite
OrganHeartTSFShunt.description: A highly experimental piece of cyberware developed in some hellish TSF blacksite that replaces the heart. Allows the user to do a short localized teleport to any position in their line of sight.

OrganInternalAirSystem.name: PD-VI LS-210 IAS
OrganInternalAirSystem.description: A cybernetic organ that replaces the lungs with a suite of filters and other devices. Not enough to keep you breathing in space, but filters out toxic gases and makes you need a little less to breathe.

OrganPDVAdvancedHeart.name: PD-VI VV/KE prosthetic heart
OrganPDVAdvancedHeart.description: A fast-pumping compact artifical heart. Can process a lot of reagents at once, and lets you take more damage before going down, but lowers your stamina and processes medicine slower.

OrganHeartMMCSakimoto.name: MMC EVT-001 "Sakimoto" replacement heart
OrganHeartMMCSakimoto.description: A strange piece of cybernetic hardware designed to replace the heart. The exact manner of how is unknown, but it allows the user to channel a form of latent energy into a single hit.

OrganHydrakinLungs.name: hydrakin lungs
OrganHydrakinLungs.description: Hydrakin lungs, capable of processing any gas without negative effects.

OrganProtogenBrain.name: brain
OrganProtogenBrain.description: The source of incredible, unending intelligence. 01001000 01101111 01101110 01101011 00101110

OrganProtogenEyes.name: eyes
OrganProtogenEyes.description: Emits LED lights to resemble eyes.

OrganProtogenTongue.name: tongue
OrganProtogenTongue.description: A fleshy muscle located within a Protogen's mouth, wherever that is.

OrganProtogenEars.name: ears
OrganProtogenEars.description: Lets a Protogen process audio. And listen to their favorite techno hits.

OrganProtogenLungs.name: lungs
OrganProtogenLungs.description: Filters oxygen from an atmosphere, which is then sent into the bloodstream to be used as an electron carrier. God knows how a Protogen breathes at all.

OrganProtogenHeart.name: heart
OrganProtogenHeart.description: Even the most stone-cold, technology-based heart was alive once.

OrganProtogenStomach.name: stomach
OrganProtogenStomach.description: Gross. This is hard to stomach.

OrganProtogenLiver.name: liver
OrganProtogenLiver.description: Pairing suggestion: fermented RAM sticks and CPU drives.

OrganProtogenKidneys.name: kidneys
OrganProtogenKidneys.description: Filters toxins and computer viruses from the bloodstream.

ClothingBackpackDuffelPDVBurner.name: Burner Bundle
ClothingBackpackDuffelPDVBurner.description: A high caliber Burner rifle. Comes with some anti materiel and high explosive ammunition.

ClothingBackpackDuffelPDVFilledGrenadeLa.name: China-Lake bundle
ClothingBackpackDuffelPDVFilledGrenadeLa.description: An old China-Lake grenade launcher bundled with 11 rounds of various destruction capability.

ClothingBackpackDuffelPDVC4tBundle.description: Contains a lot of C-4 charges.

ClothingBackpackRogueNanotrasenT3.description: An ominous special operations gear crate.

CrateAmmoBox57mmSmart.name: AK-570 57mm HMNG drum box

ClothingOuterHardsuitCCTCMediumPremium.description: A reinforced variant of the CSW-19 "Century", the "Centurion" is designed with the PMC's commanders in mind, boasting improved quality and protection.

ClothingOuterHardsuitAsakim.name: kasature-pattern combat exoskeleton
ClothingOuterHardsuitAsakim.description: An advanced exoskeleton harness of cutting edge, corporate-era technology. It connects itself directly to the brain of the wearer, and requires advanced brain augmentation and cybernetics to function. Incredibly rare, and practically alien in technology compared to modern tacsuits. Once equipped, the armor cannot be removed without external release.

ClothingOuterHardsuitMercenaryWarlord.name: PMC WL-01
ClothingOuterHardsuitMercenaryWarlord.description: Nicknamed "Warlord",a former state-of-the-art technology in military equipment, now widespread among the mercenaries and black markets due to its schematics being revealed to the public, the warlord combat suit has been modified to withstand space depressurized atmosphere, rating it space capable.

ClothingOuterHardsuitScaf.name: SCAF hardsuit
ClothingOuterHardsuitScaf.description: A kevlar reinforced combat hardsuit. Old yet sturdy nonetheless.

ClothingOuterHardsuitMieyoMining.name: MMC mining suit
ClothingOuterHardsuitMieyoMining.description: A basic EVA suit for MMC employees and non-combat use.

ClothingOuterHardsuitMieyoCombat.name: MMC kurogane tacsuit
ClothingOuterHardsuitMieyoCombat.description: A tactical combat suit for MMC asset protection & corporate security. It's very light, but not too defensive.

ClothingOuterHardsuitPirateScaf.name: PDV SCAF hardsuit
ClothingOuterHardsuitPirateScaf.description: An old SCAF suit painted in an PDV tan color scheme. The armor feels degraded, but lighter.

ClothingOuterHardsuitAshen.name: PDV CV-32 combat hardsuit
ClothingOuterHardsuitAshen.description: A combat hardsuit designed by the Phaethon Dynasty. A heavier but still general-purpose hardsuit. Sacrifices most of its protection for reinforced ballistic platings.

ClothingOuterHardsuitPDVMedic.name: PDV CV-82 combat tacsuit
ClothingOuterHardsuitPDVMedic.description: Fast combat hardsuit designed by the Phaethon Dynasty. The armor features various reinforced plating in vital areas.

ClothingOuterHardsuitVizier.name: PDV CV-67 combat tacsuit
ClothingOuterHardsuitVizier.description: An adorned tacsuit designed with an imperfect nanolaminate composition. High maneuverability, sturdy armor.

ClothingOuterHardsuitAshenElite.name: PDV CV-53 combat tacsuit
ClothingOuterHardsuitAshenElite.description: Originally based off of the CV-32 hardsuit, the CV-53 tacsuit sacrifices conventional armor plating for environmental protection, and a rechargeable hard-shield.

ClothingOuterHardsuitTarkhan.name: PDV CV-280 'Basilisk' combat hardsuit
ClothingOuterHardsuitTarkhan.description: A combat hardsuit designed by the Phaethon Dynasty for Tarkhans. Utilizes an imperfect nanolaminate composition like the CV-67 to save weight, and an installed hydraulic rig for more mobility, and painted in a royal Tarkhan white palette. A rare sight.

ClothingOuterHardsuitTrauma.name: armed trauma unit T-23 tacsuit
ClothingOuterHardsuitTrauma.description: The standard combat suit for the Armed Trauma Unit. It has an integrated limited-range mass scanner in the helmet.

ClothingOuterHardsuitTraumaLeader.name: armed trauma unit T-53 tacsuit
ClothingOuterHardsuitTraumaLeader.description: Developed for extracting mission-critical patients under heavy fire, this is the standard gear of the Armed Trauma Unit's captain, with heavy plating and an integrated long-range mass scanner to match.

ClothingOuterHardsuitM82c.name: M82c hardsuit
ClothingOuterHardsuitM82c.description: A hardsuit issued to marines operating in low-pressure and high-risk environments. Specialized in bullet protection.

ClothingOuterHardsuitM82b.name: M82b hardsuit
ClothingOuterHardsuitM82b.description: Corpsman variant of the M82c outfitted with caustic and radiological shielding. Some of the blunt-absorbent gel layer is sacrificed for the NBC protection.

ClothingOuterHardsuitM86.name: M86 Mk.3(R) hardsuit
ClothingOuterHardsuitM86.description: An armored hardsuit, designed to be an upgrade for the M82 series. The extra general armor gives it significant weight to move around.

ClothingOuterHardsuitNfsdSheriff.name: TSFMC M92 colonel tacsuit
ClothingOuterHardsuitNfsdSheriff.description: A heavy, gilded tacsuit, stripped of its shield but now capable of taking a lot of physical damage. Usually assigned to commanding officers of TSF flagships.

ClothingOuterHardsuitNfsdExperimental.name: TSFMC M92-X tacsuit
ClothingOuterHardsuitNfsdExperimental.description: An experimental modification of the M92 tacsuit for spec-ops units of the TSFMC. Durable, and comes with an integrated hard-shield along with numerous gadgets at the cost of insulation and solid armor.

ClothingOuterHardsuitM86Mk4.name: M86 Mk.4(B) hardsuit
ClothingOuterHardsuitM86Mk4.description: A limited-production redesign proposal for the M86 Mk.3(R), outfitted with an inbuilt personal shield generator.

ClothingOuterHardsuitUIEnforcer.name: U.I. ENFORCER combat tacsuit
ClothingOuterHardsuitUIEnforcer.description: Infamously one of the most reliable combat tacsuits that the Black Market has to offer, developed by Ullman Industries. "Heads up display sold seperately!"

ClothingOuterHardsuitUIEnforcerMKII.name: U.I. ENFORCER MKII combat tacsuit
ClothingOuterHardsuitUIEnforcerMKII.description: Based off of the infamous MKI design with versatility in mind. This is Ullman Industries' top of the line combat suit. Whether it be slipping away from the feds, taking out the competition, or serving your corporate overlords, this marvel of engineering will make sure that you get it done.

ClothingOuterHardsuitUllmanEngineer.name: U.I. engineering hardsuit
ClothingOuterHardsuitUllmanEngineer.description: A protective hardsuit worn by black market engineering specialists. Developed by Ullman Industries.

ClothingOuterHardsuitUIPilot.name: U.I. pilot voidsuit
ClothingOuterHardsuitUIPilot.description: A voidsuit made for black market pilots. Developed by Ullman Industries

ClothingOuterHardsuitUIDirector.name: U.I. VK-1 experimental hardsuit
ClothingOuterHardsuitUIDirector.description: Felix Ullman's top of the line personal hardsuit. A warning label engraved on the chestplate reads "Theft of this suit has a high chance of death! Seriously, I will find you. You will die."

ClothingOuterHardsuitUNSAArmoredEva.name: armored EVA suit
ClothingOuterHardsuitUNSAArmoredEva.description: A standard EVA suit modified by the UNSA as a cheap and nimble alternative to voidsuits for use by Vanguards.

ClothingOuterHardsuitUsspL27.name: USSP L-27 tacsuit
ClothingOuterHardsuitUsspL27.description: The standard combat suit of USSP naval operations.

ClothingOuterHardsuitUsspL10.name: USSP L-10 lightsuit
ClothingOuterHardsuitUsspL10.description: An old USSP model of combat suit that is still in use in the frontlines.

ClothingOuterHardsuitUsspL10A.name: USSP L-10-A lightsuit
ClothingOuterHardsuitUsspL10A.description: An old USSP model of combat suit that is still in use in the frontlines.

ClothingOuterHardsuitUsspM10.name: USSP M-10 scoutsuit
ClothingOuterHardsuitUsspM10.description: A new prototype of combat suit using the old L-10 as a baseline. It has a integrated mass scanner in his helmet.

ClothingOuterHardsuitUsspL30.name: USSP L-30 Naval Commissar parade hardsuit.
ClothingOuterHardsuitUsspL30.description: A highly decorated hardsuit with upgraded mobility and higher quality lighter armor plates to quickly convey orders on the frontline. (or not be sweaty in a parade)

ClothingOuterHardsuitOfficerCombat.name: USSP UF-16 "Voenkom" commissar tacsuit
ClothingOuterHardsuitOfficerCombat.description: Developed by Union armament manufacturers for use by members of the commissariat on the frontlines. Features enhanced plating for survivability, allowing commanders to continue to give orders even while under heavy fire.

ClothingOuterHardsuitViperGroupStandard.name: JACKAL mk.II viper hardsuit
ClothingOuterHardsuitViperGroupStandard.description: A combat hardsuit adorned with signature markings of the Viper Group. The armor is remarkably flexible for the protection it offers.

ClothingOuterHardsuitViperGroupMedic.name: RIPPER mk.III viper hardsuit
ClothingOuterHardsuitViperGroupMedic.description: A combat medical hardsuit adorned with signature markings of the Viper Group. The armor features various reinforced plating in vital areas.

ClothingOuterHardsuitViperGroupJuggernau.name: IMP mk.IV viper hardsuit
ClothingOuterHardsuitViperGroupJuggernau.description: A heavy combat hardsuit adorned with signature markings of the Viper Group. The armor features reinforced plating and padding fitting for close encounters.

ClothingOuterHardsuitViperGroupShield.name: MEDUSA mk.VI viper hardsuit
ClothingOuterHardsuitViperGroupShield.description: A heavy combat hardsuit adorned with signature markings of the Viper Group. The armor features a personal shield projector integrated into the suit.

ClothingOuterHardsuitViperGroupInitiate.name: BROOD mk.I viper hardsuit
ClothingOuterHardsuitViperGroupInitiate.description: A combat hardsuit adorned with signature markings of the Viper Group. Commonly worn by privateers recently awakened from cryosleep.

ClothingOuterDrakeIndustriesTruckerPuffy.name: puffy vest
ClothingOuterDrakeIndustriesTruckerPuffy.description: A flashy looking puffy and somewhat elastic vest. It makes an insane amount of noise at the slighest movement, but at least they bothered making some pockets on the inside.

ClothingOuterVestWebElite.name: elite web vest
ClothingOuterVestWebElite.description: A synthetic armor vest. This one has added webbing and heat resistant fibers.

ClothingModsuitChestplateUSSPVaryag.name: Panzerkorps Varyag
ClothingModsuitChestplateUSSPVaryag.description: Thick plating fused with internal atmosphere control.

ClothingModsuitChestplateUSSPZastavnik.name: Brust Zastavnika
ClothingModsuitChestplateUSSPZastavnik.description: An imposing armored shell designed to absorb punishment and maintain stability under pressure.

ClothingModsuitChestplateRogue.name: RX-01 modsuit chestplate
ClothingModsuitChestplateRogue.description: The chestpiece has some warning label on the inside about radiation leaks- and a note next to it 'Remove this label in the final product - Felix

ClothingModsuitChestplateVolta.name: Volta Modsuit Chestplate
ClothingModsuitChestplateVolta.description: Reinforced military modification of Sapper Modsuit, featuring better bullet resistance.

ClothingModsuitChestplateMercenary.name: mercenary modsuit chestplate
ClothingModsuitChestplateMercenary.description: A well rounded modsuit that focuses on mobility with its Actuator Enhancement System allowing its wearer to leap across the battlefield for rapid redeployment.

ClothingOuterEVASuitDME.name: DME EVA Suit
ClothingOuterEVASuitDME.description: An EVA suit with a built-in helmet commonly issued to wealthy traders.

ClothingShoesTacticalSwatTan.name: tan tactical swat boots
ClothingShoesTacticalSwatTan.description: A pair of tactical swat boots for when you want to turn up the heat.

ClothingShoesTacticalSwatOlive.name: olive tactical swat boots
ClothingShoesTacticalSwatOlive.description: A pair of tactical swat boots for when you want to turn up the heat.

ClothingShoesTacticalSwatBlack.description: A pair of tactical swat boots for when you want to turn up the heat.

ClothingShoesTacticalSwatRangerGreen.description: A pair of tactical swat boots for when you want to turn up the heat.

ClothingShoesTacticalSwatCoyoteBrown.description: A pair of tactical swat boots for when you want to turn up the heat.

ClothingShoesTacticalSwatWhite.name: white tactical swat boots
ClothingShoesTacticalSwatWhite.description: A pair of tactical swat boots for when you want to turn up the heat.

ClothingShoesBootsMagDrakeIndustries.name: painted magboots
ClothingShoesBootsMagDrakeIndustries.description: Yep, that's just repainted science boots.

ClothingShoesBootsMagVoid.name: voidboots
ClothingShoesBootsMagVoid.description: Magboots enhanced with bluespace tethering technology, allowing you to walk on the void of space.

ClothingShoesBootsMagAsakim.name: pre-fracture magboots
ClothingShoesBootsMagAsakim.description: State-of-the-art magnetic boots made for combat with advanced harnesses.

ClothingShoesBootsMagAshen.name: tactical magboots
ClothingShoesBootsMagAshen.description: Tactical magnetic boots that have a heavy magnetic pull and integrated thrusters for boarding. It can hold 0.75 L of gas.

ClothingShoesBootsMagPDVAdvanced.name: advanced tactical magboots
ClothingShoesBootsMagPDVAdvanced.description: Experimental high tech magboots, reverse engineered from the remnants of Pre-fracture technology. These sets are only found in hands of the Dynasty's most valued soldiers.

ClothingShoesBootsMagVoidTrauma.name: ATU boots
ClothingShoesBootsMagVoidTrauma.description: Lightweight voidboots reinforced for harsh space conditions, designed to maintain mobility and reduce movement loss from injury.

ClothingShoesBootsMagVoidTraumaLeader.name: advanced ATU boots
ClothingShoesBootsMagVoidTraumaLeader.description: Upgrade to conventional void boots, reinforced with additional plating for frontline trauma personnel. Their heavy construction is offset by an integrated mobility system that keeps the wearer moving despite severe injury.

ClothingShoesClothwrapBlack.name: black cloth footwraps
ClothingShoesClothwrapBlack.description: A roll of treated canvas used for wrapping feet or paws, dyed black.

ClothingModsuitBootsUSSPVaryag.name: Marshevyye Varyag
ClothingModsuitBootsUSSPVaryag.description: Heavy-duty boots designed for combat and EVA.

ClothingModsuitBootsUSSPZastavnik.name: Sapogi Zastavnika
ClothingModsuitBootsUSSPZastavnik.description: Thick, reinforced boots with magnetic stabilizers and shock absorption.

ClothingModsuitBootsRogue.name: RX-01 modsuit boots
ClothingModsuitBootsRogue.description: Magnetized voidboots to help you avoid slips, trips, and Feds.

ClothingModsuitBootsMercenary.name: mercenary modsuit boots
ClothingModsuitBootsMercenary.description: The suits Actuator Enhancement System paired with the built in magboots make boarding actions a breeze.

WeaponOmnigun.name: omnigun
WeaponOmnigun.description: shoot with anything i dont fucking care.

MobPDVBaseA.name: PDV guardsman
MobPDVBaseA.description: A guardsman of the Sultan's illustrious Vanguard. He looks to be armed with a C-20r.

MobTSFMCBaseA.name: TSFMC marine
MobTSFMCBaseA.description: A typical TSFMC marine grunt on guard duty. He looks to be armed with a lecter.

MobVoidBaseTSF.name: wayward marine
MobVoidBaseTSF.description: Long gone from home, hollowed out from emissions. Expect a fight.

MobVoidBasePDV.name: wayward guardsman
MobVoidBasePDV.description: Long gone from home, hollowed out from emissions. Expect a fight.

MaterialIridite.name: iridite
MaterialIridite.description: A complex alloy synthesized from atmospheric gases, commonly used outside of the sector for heavy industrial machinery, nanofibers, and high-grade computers.

SheetPlastitanium.name: plastitanium
SheetPlastitanium.description: An advanced, high-strength alloy. Even if it's extremely abundant in core sectors, it is hard to find in the Colossus region.

SheetUraniumFissile.name: fissile uranium
SheetUraniumFissile.description: Ingots of pure, unadulterated weapons-grade uranium isotopes. Expect some trouble with this. DEFINITELY don't keep them close together.

SheetUraniumDepleted.name: depleted uranium
SheetUraniumDepleted.description: Ingots of durable, dense and ridiculously heavy depleted uranium, no longer fissile - but nonetheless useful for things unrelated to warcrimes.

SheetPdvComposite.name: adamantite
SheetPdvComposite.description: An advanced composite alloy made exclusively by the Dynasty. While it isn't actually "adamantite", it does contain some anomalous material harvested from the Colossus radius which could be likened to such a mythical substance. Informally known as Sultanium.

ChimeraFleshKudzu.name: chimera hive biomass
ChimeraFleshKudzu.description: A rapidly growing cluster of chimera biomass. WHY ARE YOU STOPPING TO LOOK AT IT?!

LetoferolSpikeGun.name: letoferol bone spike
LetoferolSpikeGun.description: Shoots a short salvo of bone spikes.

ActionLetoferolSpike.name: [color=yellow]Bone Spike[/color]
ActionLetoferolSpike.description: Shoot a short salvo of bone spikes laced with [color=yellow]letoferol[/color].

BorgChassisSelectablePDV.name: PDV cyborg
BorgChassisSelectablePDV.description: A purpose built cyborg used by the PDV.

BorgChassisSelectableTSF.name: TSF cyborg
BorgChassisSelectableTSF.description: A purpose built cyborg used by the TSF.

BorgChassisSelectableXenoborg.name: Xenoborg cyborg
BorgChassisSelectableXenoborg.description: A man-machine hybrid that aims to replicate itself. They love extracting brains to insert into fresh Xenoborg chassis to grow their army. This one is the indecisive type and has yet to choose its specialization

NpcStationAiRammer.name: rammer core
NpcStationAiRammer.description: You feel like the fact you're looking at this means this isn't safe.

NpcDroneAiDander.name: orbiter core
NpcDroneAiDander.description: Orbits harmlessly and evades. Less valuable due to unremarkable subroutine.

MobKangarooPlanet.name: kangaroo
MobKangarooPlanet.description: A large marsupial herbivore. It has powerful hind legs, with nails that resemble long claws.

MobMonolithicGestalt.name: monolithic gestalt
MobMonolithicGestalt.description: An anomalous entity. Seems to be composed entirely of some kind of intangible energy, which it seems to be shooting you with. Watch out!

MobMonolithicGolom.name: monolithic golom
MobMonolithicGolom.description: An anomalous entity. Seems to be composed entirely of some kind of durable, crystal-like energy. It also seems to be heading right towards you.

MobMonolithicHellLocust.name: monolithic hell locust
MobMonolithicHellLocust.description: An anomalous entity. Seems to be composed of sharply tangible energy, in an oddly familiar form. Also seems to be running at you menacingly. Watch out!

MobMonolithicGolomRanged.name: monolithic golum
MobMonolithicGolomRanged.description: An anomalous entity. Seems to be composed entirely of some kind of durable, crystal-like energy, which it is shooting at you. Watch out!

MobMoproach.name: moproach
MobMoproach.description: This little mothroach has mopshoes on its feet! How adorable!

MobBoomroach.name: Boomroach
MobBoomroach.description: This little mothroach has a chinalake strapped to its back! Why and how?

MobImperiRoach.name: ImperiRoach
MobImperiRoach.description: Repurposed and highly trained elite member of the PDV, bewarned explosive personallity

MobOwORoach.name: OwOroach
MobOwORoach.description: Genetic Experimentionation between mothroaches and cats, too far or not far enough?

MobMothroachLeopard.name: leopard mothroach
MobMothroachLeopard.description: A charming result of numerous attempts to crossbreed insects with predators.

MobMothroachCecropia.name: cecropia mothroach
MobMothroachCecropia.description: A charming result of numerous attempts to cross a genus of the nettle family with cockroaches.

MobMothroachLunar.name: lunar mothroach
MobMothroachLunar.description: Someone left the moth under the moonlight.

MobMothroachMustard.name: mustard mothroach
MobMothroachMustard.description: A delightful result of the sectors's highest chefs crossing meat with sauce.

BorgChassisRedacted.description: A tender to an automated drone ship, to keep its internal mechanisms intact.

MobAsakimDummy.name: MobAsakimDummy
MobAsakimDummy.description: A dummy Asakim meant to be used in character setup.

DrinkIceCreamJug.description: A jug full of sweet, homemade ice cream.

DrinkRootBearFloatJug.name: root beer float jug
DrinkRootBearFloatJug.description: Root beer, but now with ice cream on top. It truly is the magnum opus of Canadian summertime drinks.

DrinkBeerCervezaCristalFull.description: A suspiciously cheap lager in a brown bottle. Emits a triumphant 'CERVEZA CRISTAAAL' when opened, as if it just won a prize for existing.

IriditeCrystal.description: A natural state of iridite from the result of non-atmospheric iridite processing. Needs to be processed in an arc furnace again with various chemicals to make 1 iridite sheet.

MaterialLithium.name: lithium
MaterialLithium.description: Lithium is a soft, brittle metal widely used in a range of electronic applications, most notably alkali-batteries. Its also dangerously reactive!

ArmorPlateEconomy1.name: basic armor plate
ArmorPlateEconomy1.description: A simple, refined "armor" alloy plate useful for things that need structural stability. Can be layered to start creating a heavy armor plate.

ArmorPlateEconomy2UnfinishedSpawner.name: heavy armor plate (unfinished)
ArmorPlateEconomy2UnfinishedSpawner.description: A work-in-progress heap of metal, in the process of being refined into a strong protective plate. Needs screwing to start processing.

ArmorPlateEconomy1Broken.name: broken basic armor plate
ArmorPlateEconomy1Broken.description: Wreckage from a simple armor plate. Not very surprising.

SiliconWaferEconomy.name: silicon wafer
SiliconWaferEconomy.description: A clean slice of pure monocrystalline silicon. Essential for advanced electronics!

SiliconWaferEconomySliceSpawner8.name: silicon wafer (x8)
SiliconWaferEconomySliceSpawner8.description: A clean slice of pure monocrystalline silicon. Essential for advanced electronics!

SiliconWaferScrapEconomy.name: silicon wafer scrap
SiliconWaferScrapEconomy.description: A broken, contaminated mess of silicon that used to be useful for computers. What a waste.

ArmorPlateEconomy2.name: heavy armor plate
ArmorPlateEconomy2.description: A heavier, layered alloy armor plate. Heavy, but strong. Useful for things that need significant structural stability, or more commonly, the ability to take a hit.

ArmorPlateEconomy2Start.name: heavy armor plate (unfinished)
ArmorPlateEconomy2Start.description: A work-in-progress heap of metal, in the process of being refined into a strong protective plate. Needs screwing to start processing.

ArmorPlateEconomy2Broken.name: broken heavy armor plate
ArmorPlateEconomy2Broken.description: Wreckage from a heavy alloy armor plate.

ArmorPlateEconomy3Fragment.name: composite armor plate fragment
ArmorPlateEconomy3Fragment.description: A fragment from a ceramic/carbide armor plate. Useful for smaller-scale applications.

SiliconBouleEconomy.name: silicon boule
SiliconBouleEconomy.description: A hefty but fragile chunk of refined silicon, ready for slicing into processor-grade wafers. Don't touch it without gloves!

SiliconBouleScrapEconomy.name: silicon boule scrap
SiliconBouleScrapEconomy.description: A broken, contaminated mess of silicon that used to be useful for computers. What a waste.

ArmorPlateEconomy3.name: composite armor plate
ArmorPlateEconomy3.description: A relatively difficult-to-produce ceramic/carbide armor plate. Lightweight for the amount of protection it grants, but it is still exceptionally heavy, making it primarily useful in ship hulls. Can be cut into two fragments.

ArmorPlateEconomy3Broken.name: broken composite armor plate
ArmorPlateEconomy3Broken.description: Wreckage from an advanced ceramic/carbide alloy armor plate. Kind of concerning.

ArmorPlateEconomy4Start.name: EMAG armor plate (unfinished)
ArmorPlateEconomy4Start.description: The ceramic/metallic plate component of an EMAG armor plate, fresh off the forge and awaiting its electronic components. Needs a compound electromagnet to begin construction, then significant screwing and cutting.

ArmorPlateEconomy4.name: EMAG armor plate
ArmorPlateEconomy4.description: A state-of-the-art EMAG electromagnetic armor plate. Exceptional resistance even when unpowered, but still very heavy. Useful for high-power reactor shielding, infantry armor, FTL drives, and most things that undergo significant stress.

ArmorPlateEconomy4Broken.name: broken EMAG armor plate
ArmorPlateEconomy4Broken.description: Wreckage from an advanced ceramic/carbide alloy armor plate. Extremely concerning.

MatterBinEconomy1.name: component bin
MatterBinEconomy1.description: Used for storing chemicals and other substances needed for industrial processes. Can be opened and closed. Don't use as a component while it has reagents inside!

MatterBinEconomy2.name: large component bin
MatterBinEconomy2.description: Used for storing chemicals and other substances needed for industrial processes. Much larger than its predecessor. Can be opened and closed. Don't use as a component while it has reagents inside!

MatterBinEconomy2Spawner.name: basic components
MatterBinEconomy2Spawner.description: A casing of mechanical-electrical interfacing systems, like gears, stepper motors, cabling and more.

MatterBinEconomy3.name: supercomponent bin
MatterBinEconomy3.description: Used for storing chemicals and other substances needed for industrial processes. Much larger than its predecessor. Can be opened and closed. Don't use as a component while it has reagents inside!

MicroprocessorEconomy1.name: microprocessor
MicroprocessorEconomy1.description: A fairly common field programmable microcontroller. Useful in everything that needs even a smidge of brain.

MicroprocessorEconomy2.name: nanoprocessor
MicroprocessorEconomy2.description: A more advanced, miniaturized computation system, capable of handling a basic operating system!

MicroprocessorEconomy3.name: quantum processor
MicroprocessorEconomy3.description: A state-of-the-art quantum computing system with in-built cooling, memory, and back-up power supply, capable of handling everything from persona level A.I to FTL piloting.

CapacitorEconomy1.name: industrial basic capacitor
CapacitorEconomy1.description: A simple capacitor useful in small-scale power storage and simple circuits.

CapacitorEconomy2.name: industrial advanced capacitor
CapacitorEconomy2.description: An upgraded capacitor capable of handling more voltage and storing more energy through the power of refined semiconductors.

CapacitorEconomy3.name: industrial supercapacitor
CapacitorEconomy3.description: A state-of-the-art capacitor capable of storing incredible amounts of energy for its size through the use of miniaturized SMES technology.

ComponentBrickEconomy1.name: basic components
ComponentBrickEconomy1.description: A casing of mechanical-electrical interfacing systems, like gears, stepper motors, cabling and more.

ComponentBrickEconomy1SpawnerT2.name: basic components
ComponentBrickEconomy1SpawnerT2.description: A casing of mechanical-electrical interfacing systems, like gears, stepper motors, cabling and more.

ComponentBrickEconomy2.name: advanced components
ComponentBrickEconomy2.description: A casing of more advanced, precise and durable mechanical-electrical interfacing systems.

ComponentBrickEconomy3.name: super components
ComponentBrickEconomy3.description: A casing of state-of-the-art interfacing systems and miscellaneous parts. Robust, efficient, and expensive.

ElectromagnetEconomy1.name: basic electromagnet
ElectromagnetEconomy1.description: A circular ring composed of magnetic metal and conductive cabling. Useful for containment structures and mechanical/electrical interfacing. Add basic components to start assembling a compound electromagnet.

ElectromagnetEconomy2Start.name: compound electromagnet (unfinished)
ElectromagnetEconomy2Start.description: A work-in-progress compound electromagnet. Needs 10 LV cables to begin construction.

ElectromagnetEconomy2.name: compound electromagnet
ElectromagnetEconomy2.description: A stacked electromagnet in the shape of a tube, lined with strong conductive material. Capable of powerfully interchanging electrical and kinetic energy.

ElectromagnetEconomy3Start.name: superconductive electromagnet (unfinished)
ElectromagnetEconomy3Start.description: A work-in-progress superconductive electromagnet. Needs further assembling in an precision assembler.

ElectromagnetEconomy3.name: superconductive electromagnet
ElectromagnetEconomy3.description: A hefty superconducting electromagnet. Extremely useful for high-energy containment and propulsion.

RadioEconomy1.name: T/R broadband radio component
RadioEconomy1.description: A transmitter/reciever radio component capable of tuning and transmitting to most common radio frequencies, even at a distance.

RadioEconomy2.name: HF signal tranciever component
RadioEconomy2.description: A high-frequency signal transmitter/reciever, capable of intercepting and communicating in various frequencies. The range of detection also gives it utility in high-end sensor systems, like radar, ELINT, and thermal panels.

OpticsEconomy1.name: optical sensor
OpticsEconomy1.description: An eye-like camera capable of capturing photons. Basically a fancy eyeball, though it has other uses.

OpticsEconomy2.name: precision optical sensor
OpticsEconomy2.description: An advanced, high-resolution photon sensor capable of maintaining visual clarity of distant objects. Extremely useful for monitoring, detection and tracking equipment.

CameraEconomy1.name: photonic flash camera
CameraEconomy1.description: An optical sensor adapted to both emit and recieve high-energy photons. Useful.

MotorEconomy1.name: industrial motor
MotorEconomy1.description: A powerful and dedicated electromotor, useful in high-torque-requiring electric-mechanical energy conversion.

DataFarmResearchCircuitboard.name: data farm (research) circuitboard
DataFarmResearchCircuitboard.description: Looks like you could use a screwdriver to change the board type. Unable to be flatpacked due to complex components.

BroadswordCentralElectronics.name: broadsword central control module
BroadswordCentralElectronics.description: The electrical control center for the durand mech.

BroadswordPeripheralsElectronics.name: broadsword peripherals control module
BroadswordPeripheralsElectronics.description: The electrical peripherals control for the broadsword mech.

BroadswordTargetingElectronics.name: broadsword weapon control and targeting module
BroadswordTargetingElectronics.description: The electrical targeting control for the broadsword mech.

FlailCentralElectronics.name: flail central control module
FlailCentralElectronics.description: The electrical control center for the durand mech.

FlailPeripheralsElectronics.name: flail peripherals control module
FlailPeripheralsElectronics.description: The electrical peripherals control for the flail mech.

FlailTargetingElectronics.name: flail weapon control and targeting module
FlailTargetingElectronics.description: The electrical targeting control for the flail mech.

BitcoinContribcoin.name: Contribcoin™
BitcoinContribcoin.description: A weirdly valuable bitcoin composed of many generic definitions, raw data and operating presets. Slightly volatile.

BitcoinIdeascoin.name: Ideascoin™
BitcoinIdeascoin.description: A strangely valuable bitcoin composed of raw conceptual data of a multitude of completely hypothetical things. Moderately volatile.

BitcoinLuxurycoin.name: Luxurycoin™
BitcoinLuxurycoin.description: An absurdly valuable and rare bitcoin, made up of tons of high(?)-quality code and generic systems. Highly volatile.

BookUSSPLaw.name: USSP Service Regulations
BookUSSPLaw.description: A field manual carried by all servicemen of the USSP Armed Forces. Every serzhant can quote it from memory, usually at an intensity unsuitable for cramped spaces.

BookTheCommonCause.name: The Common Cause
BookTheCommonCause.description: A mass-printed civic text issued to all citizens, of the Union. Its short passages emphasize duty, labour, discipline, and the moral value of collective life.

BookTheCommonCauseFirstEdition.name: The Common Cause
BookTheCommonCauseFirstEdition.description: An early edition of The Common Cause, attributed to the Autarch. The binding is severe, the paper aged, and the words far less restrained than later civic prints.

BookTSFSOP.name: TSFMC SOP
BookTSFSOP.description: A book containing the SOP for the TSFMC forces deployed to the Colossus Sector.

EconomyPlanner.name: industrial planner
EconomyPlanner.description: A tablet containing a visual flowchart on how to produce proprietary goods. (Place on the ground and interact with it to open the flowchart!)

PDVStampedGold.name: dynasty stamped gold
PDVStampedGold.description: A heavy crate stacked full of lab synthesized superconductive gold stamped with the Dynasty's logo and an identifying code. As an unapproved form of legal tender, the Federation would love to confiscate this.

TSFNaniteCanister.name: federation nanite canister
TSFNaniteCanister.description: A reinforced silvered-glass cylinder specially made to contain inert recombinative programmable nanites used for micro-scale advanced manufacturing outside the sector. The Dynasty's factories would love to get their hands on this.

Flare.name: emergency flare
Flare.description: A flare that produces a very bright light for a short while. Point the flame away from yourself.

FlareActivated.name: emergency flare
FlareActivated.description: A flare that produces a very bright light for a short while. Point the flame away from yourself.

BaseSignalFlare.name: signal flare
BaseSignalFlare.description: A flare that produces a very bright light and an IFF signal for a short while, used for communications in high-intensity situations.

BaseSignalFlareActivated.name: signal flare
BaseSignalFlareActivated.description: A flare that produces a very bright light and an IFF signal for a short while, used for communications in high-intensity situations.

SignalFlareGreenActivated.name: signal flare (friendly)
SignalFlareGreenActivated.description: A flare that produces a very bright light and an IFF signal for a short while. Indicates friendly intent.

SignalFlareGreen.name: signal flare (friendly)
SignalFlareGreen.description: A flare that produces a very bright light and an IFF signal for a short while. Indicates friendly intent.

SignalFlareWhiteActivated.name: signal flare (neutral/surrender)
SignalFlareWhiteActivated.description: A flare that produces a very bright light and an IFF signal for a short while. Indicates neutral intent, or, in combat, surrender.

SignalFlareWhite.name: signal flare (neutral/surrender)
SignalFlareWhite.description: A flare that produces a very bright light and an IFF signal for a short while. Indicates neutral intent, or, in combat, surrender.

SignalFlareRedActivated.name: signal flare (hostile)
SignalFlareRedActivated.description: A flare that produces a very bright light and an IFF signal for a short while. Indicates hostile intent.

SignalFlareRed.name: signal flare (hostile)
SignalFlareRed.description: A flare that produces a very bright light and an IFF signal for a short while. Indicates hostile intent.

SignalFlareGoldActivated.description: A flare that produces a very bright light and an IFF signal for a short while. Indicates a miscellaneous signal.

SignalFlareGold.name: signal flare (other)
SignalFlareGold.description: A flare that produces a very bright light and an IFF signal for a short while. Indicates a miscellaneous signal.

BoxDispenserFlareGreen.name: signal flare (friendly) dispenser
BoxDispenserFlareGreen.description: Dispenses signal flares, used for indicating friendly intent.

BoxDispenserFlareRed.name: signal flare (hostile) dispenser
BoxDispenserFlareRed.description: Dispenses signal flares, used for indicating hostile intent.

BoxDispenserFlareWhite.name: signal flare (neutral/surrender) dispenser
BoxDispenserFlareWhite.description: Dispenses signal flares, used for indicating neutral intent or, in combat, surrender.

BoxDispenserFlareGold.name: signal flare (other) dispenser
BoxDispenserFlareGold.description: Dispenses signal flares, used for indicating a miscellaneous signal.

GooglyEyes.name: googly eyes
GooglyEyes.description: Stick on things to make them look funny.

PhoneInstrumentHigh.name: command relay device
PhoneInstrumentHigh.description: Should any request be needed to higher command... this is your friend, best not lose it

UndeterminedPDVInfiltratorKit.name: PDV Infiltrator equipment selector
UndeterminedPDVInfiltratorKit.description: A small remote utilizing bluespace technology to drop in an imperial infiltrator kit of your choosing.

UndeterminedPDVTarkhanKit.name: PDV Tarkhan equipment selector
UndeterminedPDVTarkhanKit.description: A small remote utilizing bluespace technology to drop in an imperial Tarkhan kit of your choosing.

UndeterminedTSFMarsocKit.name: TSF Marsoc equipment selector
UndeterminedTSFMarsocKit.description: A small remote utilizing bluespace technology to drop in a TSF MARSOC kit of your choosing.

MonolithicCrystalSmall.name: small monolithic crystal
MonolithicCrystalSmall.description: A mysterious crystalline solid. Seems highly energetic, but fragile. Local factions and researchers are very interested in this.

MonolithicCrystalMedium.name: medium monolithic crystal
MonolithicCrystalMedium.description: A mysterious crystalline solid. Seems highly energetic, but fragile. Notably large. Local factions and researchers are very interested in this.

MonolithicCrystalLarge.name: large monolithic crystal
MonolithicCrystalLarge.description: A mysterious crystalline solid. Seems highly energetic, but fragile. It is of rare size! Local factions and researchers are very interested in this.

RubberStampWinterSolstice.name: TSF local operations command rubber stamp

FentanylSolidified.name: fentanyl crystal
FentanylSolidified.description: 25u of Fentanyl solidified with Tricordrazine. Worth a lot.

UsspTrackingImplant.name: ussp tracking implant
UsspTrackingImplant.description: This implant has a tracking device monitor for the GLORIOUS UNION OF SOVIET SOCIALIST PLANETS radio channel.

ViperTrackingImplant.name: Viper Group tracking implant
ViperTrackingImplant.description: This implant has a tracking device monitor for the Viper Group's private radio channel.

MieyoTrackingImplant.name: MMC tracking implant
MieyoTrackingImplant.description: This implant has a tracking device monitor for the Mieyo corporate radio channel.

NukeTestingProjectile.name: nuclear lobster
NukeTestingProjectile.description: You need to krill yourself NOW.

TradeGoodAmmo.name: ammo crate
TradeGoodAmmo.description: A sealed crate of ammunition. A label on the side indicates it as explosive if damaged.

TradeGoodSupplies.description: A sealed crate of generic supplies.

TradeGoodMedicalSupplies.name: medical supplies crate

TradeGoodChemicalSupplies.description: A sealed crate of chemical supplies.

TradeGoodChemicalsVolatile.name: volatile chemical supplies crate
TradeGoodChemicalsVolatile.description: A sealed crate of volatile chemicals. A label on the side indicates it as explosive if damaged.

TradeGoodFissionFuel.name: fission reactor fuel crate
TradeGoodFissionFuel.description: A sealed crate of packaged nuclear fuel rods. Radioactive. Handle with care.

TradeGoodFusionFuel.name: fusion reactor fuel crate
TradeGoodFusionFuel.description: A sealed crate of packaged D-T fuel cells for use in large fusion reactors. Radioactive and volatile if damaged. Handle with care.

TradeGoodWeaponParts.name: weapon parts crate
TradeGoodWeaponParts.description: A sealed crate of various firearm components.

TradeGoodScrap.name: scrap crate
TradeGoodScrap.description: A sealed crate of scrap and salvage.

TradeGoodEquipment.name: equipment crate
TradeGoodEquipment.description: A sealed crate of various pieces of equipment and gear.

TradeGoodComponents.name: components crate
TradeGoodComponents.description: A sealed crate of various machine parts.

TradeGoodShipComponents.name: ship components crate
TradeGoodShipComponents.description: A sealed crate of various ship parts.

TradeGoodFertilizer.name: fertilizer crate
TradeGoodFertilizer.description: A sealed crate of fertilizer. A label on the side indicates it as explosive if damaged.

TradeGoodFabric.name: fabric crate
TradeGoodFabric.description: A sealed crate of various fabrics.

TradeGoodMetals.name: metals crate
TradeGoodMetals.description: A sealed crate of various metals.

WeaponTurretMk290Packed.name: packed MK-290
WeaponTurretMk290Packed.description: A disassembled and packed MK-290 sentry system.

UndeterminedVoidsuitRD.name: RD voidsuit selector
UndeterminedVoidsuitRD.description: A small remote utilizing bluespace technology to drop in a voidsuit or hardsuit of your choosing.

UndeterminedVoidsuitCap.name: Captain voidsuit selector
UndeterminedVoidsuitCap.description: A small remote utilizing bluespace technology to drop in a voidsuit or hardsuit of your choosing.

PowerCellCombat.name: combat power cell
PowerCellCombat.description: A rechargeable standardized power cell. This combat brand is equipped with partial protection from power spikes.

HardlightShield.name: hardlight shield
HardlightShield.description: Z-22 produced hardlight shield, when folded, can even fit in your pocket. Its more emmitive than reflective, unlike its blue cousins.

Teaspoon.name: teaspoon
Teaspoon.description: A small spoon used for transferring minimal amount of powder to cups.

Kettle.name: kettle
Kettle.description: Used to boil water for tea.

DrinkTeapotEmpty.name: teapot
DrinkTeapotEmpty.description: An elegant teapot. It simply oozes class.

ReagentContainerBlackTeaPouch.name: black tea pouch
ReagentContainerBlackTeaPouch.description: A pouch of black tea powder. Good for brewing tea!

ReagentContainerSyndicateTeaPouch.description: A pouch of suspiciously spicy tea powder. Good for brewing... something!
