ReagentContainerCoffeePouch.description: A pouch of coffee grounds. Good for brewing coffee!

ReagentContainerDecafCoffeePouch.name: decaf coffee grounds pouch
ReagentContainerDecafCoffeePouch.description: A pouch of decaffeinated coffee grounds. Good for brewing coffee!

FoodBoxBiscuitSimple.name: Simple Biscuit Box
FoodBoxBiscuitSimple.description: A box containing simple biscuits. Perfect for a snack!

FoodBoxBiscuitSugar.name: Sugar Biscuit Box
FoodBoxBiscuitSugar.description: A box containing sugar biscuits. Perfect for a snack!

FoodBoxBiscuitOatmeal.name: Oatmeal Biscuit Box
FoodBoxBiscuitOatmeal.description: A box containing oatmeal biscuit. Perfect for a snack!

LightMechaAutocannon.name: LAC-29 35mm autocannon
LightMechaAutocannon.description: The everyman's mecha rifle. Chambered in 35mm AP rounds, with balanced stats to tackle both Armored Frames and do light damage against ships. Fits on Light Hardpoints.

LightMechaSMG.name: RAC-6 .45 ACP rotary machine gun
LightMechaSMG.description: An uncommon choice of weaponry, it consists of a 6 barrelled gatling gun, chambered in .45 ACP. Overwhelms mecha with sheer firerate. Good for CQC. Fits on Light Hardpoints.

LightMechaShotgun.name: SH-0.5 shotgun
LightMechaShotgun.description: A large mech-grade shotgun chambered in 0.5 gauge shells, perfect for CQC combat, the firerate leaves much to be desired however. Fits on Light Hardpoints.

MediumMechDMR.name: DMR-90mm autocannon
MediumMechDMR.description: A heavy duty autocannon chambered in 90mm. General purpose Medium Hardpoint gun.

MediumMechCoilgun.name: CL-03 EMP coilgun
MediumMechCoilgun.description: A medium-sized coilgun chambered in 3cm sabots. Inflicts minor damage, however spreads the dreaded EMP effect across an area. Needs a Medium Hardpoint.

MediumMechTOW.name: ASM-55 TOW anti-tank missile gantry
MediumMechTOW.description: Repurposed anti-tank missile. Wire guided computer is exchanged for a much more sophisticated targetting system, but the mobility leaves much to be desired. Fits in Medium Hardpoints.

HeavyMechRPG.name: R3 "Bazooka" rocket system
HeavyMechRPG.description: Ground based cruise missile launcher repurposed for mech usage. Guidance systems are all but removed to reduce the size, making the munitions glorified rockets. Mounts on Heavy Hardpoints.

HeavyMechCannon.name: 220mm "Metronome" heavy burst autocannon
HeavyMechCannon.description: A burst fire 220mm cannon, relatively inaccurate, but much longer ranged than the "Bazooka". Mounts on Heavy Hardpoints.

HeavyMechProjector.name: RAVAGER-type Plasma Cannon
HeavyMechProjector.description: Based on the MARAUDER, the Ravager sacrifices range for rate of fire. Extremely inaccurate, and subpar lensing causes the projectiles to dissipate only a few seconds away. Devastating up close. Fits on Large Hardpoints.

EWACMechaJammer.name: E-58 "Blanket" jammer
EWACMechaJammer.description: An extremely specialized jamming tool, fires a volley of flares with extremely large jamming signals to screen an advance. Fits on EWAR Hardpoints.

EWACMechaFlares.name: E-58 "Spark" jammer
EWACMechaFlares.description: A cheaper alternative to the Blanket, this emitter launches a volley of 5 flares to confuse enemy gunners. Fits on EWAR Hardpoints.

IFFMechaBlueSquare.description: A cheap strobe attached to mechs to give off a certain radar signature. Makes jamming useless.

MechIFFPDV.name: construction-graph-component-Mech-IFF-PDV

MonoMRE.name: MRE
MonoMRE.description: A modern ready-to-eat ration, filled with bits of individually wrapped slop.

ResinJelly.name: resin jelly
ResinJelly.description: An odd jelly, applying it will rapidly stimulate limb health at the cost of pain.

ChitinChunk.name: chitin chunk
ChitinChunk.description: A highly durable piece of chitin. Might fetch a rather high price.

BlueprintWarlordSuit.name: PMC combat suit WarlorD blueprint
BlueprintWarlordSuit.description: A blueprint with a schematic of an Warlord suit. It can be inserted into an autolathe or a techfab.

BlueprintMotleyAnneFighters.name: motley anne fighter blueprint
BlueprintMotleyAnneFighters.description: A blueprint containing schematics for each of the Motley Anne's drone-piloted fighters.

BombCollarSealer.name: bomb collar sealer
BombCollarSealer.description: Toggles the lock state of a bomb collar.

JetpackADM.name: pre-fracture jetpack
JetpackADM.description: An exotic, pre-fracture stealth jetpack, rated to be invisible to radar beyond 16 meters.

NaniteApplicatorMMC.description: Advanced tool that uses nanotechnology to repair structures. Faster variant manufactured by MMC.

ShipRepairDeviceMMC.name: mieyo SRD
ShipRepairDeviceMMC.description: A Ship Repair Device that can reconstruct destroyed sections of ships. Holds 300 charges. Faster variant manufactured by MMC.

RCDMMC.name: mieyo RCD
RCDMMC.description: The rapid construction device can be used to quickly place and remove various structures and fixtures. Requires compressed matter to function. Does not require swiping an ID to work. Higher-capacity variant manufactured by MMC.

RPDMMC.name: mieyo RPD
RPDMMC.description: The rapid piping device allows for the quick placement and removal of atmospheric-related buildings requires compressive matter to use. Higher-capacity variant manufactured by MMC.

AccessBreakerMMC.name: mieyo disposable authentication disruptor
AccessBreakerMMC.description: A single-use hacking device, specialized to unlock and erase access from digital locks.

MotionDetectorMMC.name: mieyo motion detector
MotionDetectorMMC.description: A handheld motion detector. Detects people not in the same company of the user.

MotionDetector.name: motion detector
MotionDetector.description: A handheld motion detector. Detects people not in the same company of the user.

NaniteApplicator.name: nanite applicator
NaniteApplicator.description: Advanced tool that uses nanotechnology to repair structures.

NaniteApplicatorExperimental.description: An experimental nanite applicator with a heavily upgraded nanite capacity capable of self-nanite generation.

NaniteApplicatorSyndicate.name: advanced nanite applicator
NaniteApplicatorSyndicate.description: Advanced nanite applicator with a heavily upgraded nanite capacity capable of self-nanite generation.

ShipRepairDevice.description: A Ship Repair Device that can reconstruct destroyed sections of ships. Holds 300 charges.

ShipRepairDeviceRecharging.description: A Ship Repair Device that can reconstruct destroyed sections of ships. Holds 300 charges and slowly recharges.

ShipRepairDeviceRedacted.description: An arcane repair device that can repair ADS ships.

ShipRepairDeviceAmmo.description: Ammo cartridge for a ship repair device.

BottleBombEmpty.description: Cheap alternative to nukes. This one has no fuel.

NailBomb.description: An improvised explosive made from nails and gunpowder.

Cartridge127x99mm.name: cartridge (12.7x99mm anti-material)
Cartridge127x99mm.description: Large anti-material round, capable of punching through armor and walls easily.

ShellShotgun12_gaugeImprovised.name: improvised shotgun shell (12 gauge)
ShellShotgun12_gaugeImprovised.description: A homemade shotgun shell that shoots painful glass shrapnel. The spread is so wide that it couldn't hit the broad side of a barn.

ShellShotgun12_gaugeOOBuckshot.name: shotgun shell (12 gauge OO magnum buckshot)

Cartridge145x114mm.name: cartridge (14.5x114mm AP)
Cartridge145x114mm.description: Even larger anti-material round, capable of punching through any armor and barriers without difficulty.

Cartridge145x114mmEMP.name: cartridge (14.5x114mm EMPHE)
Cartridge145x114mmEMP.description: Even larger anti-material round, capable of punching through any armor and barriers without difficulty. Electromagnetic Pulse disables all electronics at impact site, while a conventional explosive provides area denial.

Cartridge35mmGrenadeSAPHE.name: 35x53mm SAPHE grenade
Cartridge35mmGrenadeSAPHE.description: A powerful high-explosive grenade. Useful for area denial, mass casualties and sabotage. Keep your distance.

Cartridge35mmGrenadeStinger.name: 35x53mm FL/ST grenade
Cartridge35mmGrenadeStinger.description: A powerful less-lethal round. Essentially a long-range stinger and flashbang grenade, useful for counter-insurgency, counter-sniping and riot control.

Cartridge55_SAM.name: cartridge (.55 Smart Magnum Action)
Cartridge55_SAM.description: A .55 smart bullet with a quite heavy charge of booster propellant at the bottom.

CartridgeSmart.name: cartridge (.160 smart)
CartridgeSmart.description: A .160 smart bullet with a small charge of booster propellant at the bottom.

Magazine12_gaugeOOBuckshot.name: ammo drum (12 gauge OO magnum buckshot)

Magazine55_SAMPistol.name: pistol magazine (.55 SAM)
Magazine55_SAMPistol.description: A standard magazine for the MK5 smart magnum, holding 12 rounds.

Magazine55_SAMPistolHighCapacity.name: machine pistol magazine (.55 SAM)
Magazine55_SAMPistolHighCapacity.description: An extended magazine for the MK5 smart magnum, holding 18 rounds.

PulsedPlasmaLaserCanister.name: NT PPL magnetic storage container
PulsedPlasmaLaserCanister.description: A small, advanced magnetic containment unit for the storage of high-energy plasma. Powered off an internal microreactor with electromagnets, it can contain plasma indefinitely. Recharges via using electricity to synthesize plasma from surrounding air.

MilitaryPowerCellMG.name: EM72 Ashstorm battery cell
MilitaryPowerCellMG.description: A round battery cell designed for a EM72 Ashstorm.

LargePowerCell400Thz.name: DEW-1R 400Thz battery box (large)
LargePowerCell400Thz.description: A large and militarized power box for directed energy weapons. Tuned to fire low-frequency lasers with high capacity but low recharge speed. Slightly resistant to EMP.

LargePowerCell700Thz.name: DEW-VU 700Thz battery box (large)
LargePowerCell700Thz.description: A large and militarized power box for directed energy weapons. Tuned to fire high-frequency lasers with low capacity and low recharge speed. Resistant to EMP.

LargePowerCellPlasma68x52mm.name: DEW-PLC plasma condenser (large)
LargePowerCellPlasma68x52mm.description: A large and militarized power box for energy weapons, tweaked to function with ballistic firing mechanisms. Uses stored power to superheat particles into plasma before firing. Weak to EMP, but re-usable.

ChemicalSlop.name: chemical slop
ChemicalSlop.description: According to 9 out of 10 doctors, this causes cancer. Seems to be disintegrating.

ExGrenadeLaunched.name: explosive grenade
ExGrenadeLaunched.description: Grenade that creates a small but devastating explosion.

StickyGrenadeLaunched.name: sticky bomb
StickyGrenadeLaunched.description: An anti-tank sticky bomb based on old designs, still effective even in space. Packs a punch, but has a long delay.

EmpGrenadeLaunched.name: EMP grenade
EmpGrenadeLaunched.description: A grenade designed to wreak havoc on electronic systems.

SmokeGrenadeLaunched.name: smoke grenade
SmokeGrenadeLaunched.description: A tactical grenade that releases a large, long-lasting cloud of smoke when used.

CleanerGrenadeLaunched.name: cleanade
CleanerGrenadeLaunched.description: Special grenade for janitors, releasing large cloud of space cleaner foam.

MetalFoamGrenadeLaunched.name: metal foam grenade
MetalFoamGrenadeLaunched.description: An emergency tool used for patching up holes. Almost as good as real walls.

CartridgeRocket.name: PG-7VL grenade
CartridgeRocket.description: A 1.5 warhead designed for the RPG-7 launcher. Has tubular shape.

CartridgeRocketSlow.name: PG-7VL grenade "Snail-Rocket"
CartridgeRocketSlow.description: A 1.5 warhead designed for the RPG-7 launcher. It's unusually slow.

CartridgeRocketEmp.name: PG-7VL emp
CartridgeRocketEmp.description: A 1.5 emp warhead designed for the RPG-7 launcher. Has tubular shape.

CartridgeMPSSMMissile.name: MPSSM ASM-19 missile tube
CartridgeMPSSMMissile.description: A missile tube designed for the MPSSM launcher. Fires a ship-tracking EMP-HE missile with a lockon range of 1.2km

CartridgeMPSSMHEAT.name: MPSSM Mk.248 rocket tube
CartridgeMPSSMHEAT.description: A missile tube designed for the MPSSM launcher. Fires an unguided HEAT rocket for precise structural destruction and AT usage.

GunAttachmentGripErebusVFG.name: vertical foregrip (Erebus-HI railmount)
GunAttachmentGripErebusVFG.description: Makes it easier to control recoil, but harder to recover from it. Also helps with first-shot spread control.

GunAttachmentGripErebusLAM.name: Zenit PRL laser-aiming module (Erebus-HI railmount)
GunAttachmentGripErebusLAM.description: A visual-spectrum red laser for aiming. Looks awesome, and helps a lot with first shot accuracy!

GunAttachmentGripPistolLAM.name: Soyuz PGL laser-aiming module (handgun mount)
GunAttachmentGripPistolLAM.description: A visual-spectrum green laser for aiming. Looks awesome, and helps a lot with first shot accuracy!

GunAttachmentGripErebusLight.name: LM-300 weapon light (Erebus-HI railmount)
GunAttachmentGripErebusLight.description: It's a flashlight for your gun.

GunAttachmentOpticErebus2x.name: Spectre 388 2x optic (Erebus-HI railmount)
GunAttachmentOpticErebus2x.description: Doesn't let you see as far as other optics, but helps with putting the sight back on target after recoil.

GunAttachmentOpticErebus4x.name: Spectre 970 4x optic (Erebus-HI railmount)
GunAttachmentOpticErebus4x.description: Allows for more medium-range combat to be possible. Doesn't do much for recoil recovery or accuracy.

GunAttachmentOpticErebus8x.name: L6 Bowman 8x optic (Erebus-HI railmount)
GunAttachmentOpticErebus8x.description: Allows for long-range combat. Unwieldy and hard to recover from after recoil.

GunAttachmentSuppressorMulticalPistol.name: MULTI-CAL pistol suppressor
GunAttachmentSuppressorMulticalPistol.description: Supports weapons with threaded barrels that fire pistol cartridges.

GunAttachmentSuppressorMulticalRifle.name: MULTI-CAL rifle suppressor
GunAttachmentSuppressorMulticalRifle.description: Supports weapons with threaded barrels that fire intermediate cartridges.

WeaponRifleAsakimAutopulser.name: kunisa-pattern plasma autopulser
WeaponRifleAsakimAutopulser.description: An advanced handheld plasma rifle. The design bears similarities to pre-fracture plasma weapons.

WeaponRifleAsakimAutopulserADM.name: kunisa-pattern plasma autopulser
WeaponRifleAsakimAutopulserADM.description: An advanced handheld plasma rifle built for cyborgs. The design bears similarities to pre-fracture plasma weapons.

WeaponEnergyShotgunOverseer.name: energy shotgun "Dignity"
WeaponEnergyShotgunOverseer.description: A weapon that has been the last thing seen by many pirates, "Dignity" is a 1-handed energy shotgun often used by pirate hunting overseers.

WeaponEnergyGunFrost.name: VFD QBH-5 FROST
WeaponEnergyGunFrost.description: A self-recharging energy gun with lethal rounds that can inflict serious damage. Comes with disabling munitions and improved accuracy compared to it's previous versions.

WeaponLaserCellMG.name: EM72 Ashstorm
WeaponLaserCellMG.description: EM72 Ashstorm, The TSF-EM72 Ashstorm is a directed-energy light machine gun developed by Aetherion Dynamics under TSF weapons contract 934A. Designed for sustained suppressive fire in void or planetary combat. The signature green glow of the Ashstorm's thermal capacitors is feared across imperial lines in the Helion Belt.

WeaponLRC21PPL.name: wayward NT-WS LRC-21 PPL
WeaponLRC21PPL.description: A heavy pulsed plasma lance rifle. Eviscerates targets in one clean shot. A highly experimental brand, developed and reverse-engineered right before the Confederate Expansion... how do you know this?

WeaponHeavyMiningLaser.name: industrial heavy mining laser
WeaponHeavyMiningLaser.description: A giant heavy handheld laser. Capable of excavating metric tons of rock, and self-recharging after a long delay.

WeaponDEWBasilisk.name: 'Basilisk' DEW-15-XXR radiation rifle
WeaponDEWBasilisk.description: A dubious rifle reverse engineered by the Dynasty for use against Federation personnel. Probably not the safest to use, but its beams are not on the visible light spectrum and it is immune to EMP due to using chemical-based cartridges.

WeaponDEWCalico.name: QBH-20-C Calico energy rifle
WeaponDEWCalico.description: A cartridge-fed directed energy weapon used by Trans-Solarian Federation soldiers. Due to it using chemical-laser cartridges, it is unaffected by EMP, making it a favorite among the marines able to requisition one.

WeaponDEWSmilodon.name: QJH-50-C Smilodon automatic energy weapon
WeaponDEWSmilodon.description: Modified from the original Calico DEW, the Smilodon carries the philosophy of its predecessor into the world of LMGs - Capable of using battery boxes *and* chemical magazines while also having secondary storage for on-the-go marines, the Smilodon's only failures are the downsides of laser-based weapons and its bulky frame. Continued firing calibrates spread.

UllmanWeaponPulsePistol.name: U.I. DP-17 heavy pulse pistol
UllmanWeaponPulsePistol.description: A new gun on the market from Ullman, the DP-17 is a punchy laser pulse pistol based off designs of old.

UllmanWeaponPulseRifle.name: U.I. DP-27 pulse repeater rifle
UllmanWeaponPulseRifle.description: This larger pulse rifle is an automatic weapon capable of punching down groups of targets, be they robotic or organic. One of Ullman's top of the line Directed Pulse weapons.

UllmanWeaponPulseSniper.name: U.I. DP-40 pulse sniper rifle
UllmanWeaponPulseSniper.description: The peak of Ullman engineering, the DP-40 is the ultimate in long range surpression, having a beam that can melt a hole clean through plastitanium plated armor suits.

WeaponLMGRatel.name: VFD PSW "Ratel" (7.62x51mm)
WeaponLMGRatel.description: The precision support weapon chambered in 7.62x51mm and fits simple ammo box and all kind of magazines. Based on the Vulcan and made with higher quality materials, A label on the side that seems to have been tampered with reads "FOR MILI-CENARY USE ONLY". An Erebus railmount is present on the reciever for optics.

CyborgWeaponMinigun.name: Cyborg minigun
CyborgWeaponMinigun.description: Old highly-inaccurate rotary mini-gun chambered in a small caliber.

WeaponRifleWSPRTarkhan.name: PD-VI LA/22 "Kord" (7.62x51mm)
WeaponRifleWSPRTarkhan.description: A WSPR adapted into a 7.62x51mm GPMG for Tarkhans, somehow still integrally suppressed. An Erebus railmount is present on the top of the reciever for optics.

WeaponSmartLmg.name: SKR-WS MLA-79 smart LMG (.160 smart)
WeaponSmartLmg.description: A military prototype that saw rare use in front-lines field testing. This is a refined version for standard production.

WeaponLMGMR8B.name: VFD QBZ-244 Fenghuang (8x65mm SKR)
WeaponLMGMR8B.description: Carbine variant of the QLU-243, shortened barrel optimized for heavy sustained fire. Chambered in 8x65mm SKR, and accepts both box and STANAG magazines. Only issued to MARSOC, and blacklisted from standard TSFN & TSFMC requisition.

WeaponLMGGrizzly.name: TCA QJY-68 Grizzly (6.8x52mm caseless)
WeaponLMGGrizzly.description: A medium machine gun chambered in 6.8x52mm caseless, accepts both box and standard magazines. The weight of the machine gun make it hard to wield easily.

WeaponDP29.name: NCI DP-29
WeaponDP29.description: A staple of USSP military doctrine, the DP-29 is a mass-produced light machine gun designed for reliability, ease of use, and battlefield endurance. Featuring a distinctive top-mounted pan magazine and a folding bipod, the DP-29 excels at providing suppressive fire in both urban and open combat scenarios. While its design dates back decades, its reliability and ease of maintenance make it a favorite among USSP infantry squads.

WeaponLMGHammer.name: NCI AK-150 HAMMER (7.62x39mm)
WeaponLMGHammer.description: A modified old style AK from earth which has been improved with USSP engineering and new design philosophies. At a base level? It's been turned into an LMG with a box magazine attached alongside various recoil lessening upgrades and a stylized chassis. Hail The Commissariat.

WeaponHeavyPulseCannon.name: wayward NT-WS heavy pulse cannon
WeaponHeavyPulseCannon.description: An anomalous and massive shoulder mounted pulse cannon, packing enough power in its punches to blow holes through organics, or when tuned to high power, blow holes clean into shuttle hulls.

WeaponTetherGunBorg.name: cyborg tether gun
WeaponTetherGunBorg.description: Manipulates gravity around objects to fling them at high velocities.

WeaponForceGunBorg.name: cyborg force gun
WeaponForceGunBorg.description: Manipulates gravity around objects to fling them at high velocities.

WeaponLauncherPanzero.name: MANPAT "Panzero" disposable anti-tank
WeaponLauncherPanzero.description: Based on old designs, the "Panzero" is a (relatively) easy-to-carry disposable anti-tank rocket launcher. Devastating against mechs and walls, not very good at much else.

WeaponLauncherTSFOsiris.name: QLU-909 Osiris MGL
WeaponLauncherTSFOsiris.description: The TSF's powerful solution to things that don't have enough boom. Capable of firing most standard grenades.

WeaponLauncherTSFAnubis.name: TCA QLU-907 Anubis TPGL (35x53mm grenade)
WeaponLauncherTSFAnubis.description: A precision magfed grenade rifle with an inbuilt fire-control system, originally intended for use against fortifications & counterinsurgency. Fires 35mm grenades with high-velocity and precision.

WeaponLauncherMk348.name: wayward NT-WS Mk.348 "Hailstorm" DKPW
WeaponLauncherMk348.description: A bulky multi-barreled weapon firing 9x19mm. Ammo is fed via boxes, which is moved inside the gun to each respective barrel. Despite its clunkiness, it was a successful prototype developed before the great Confederate Expansion... how do you know this?

WeaponLauncherMPSSM.name: wayward NT-WS SM-27 MPSSM missile launcher
WeaponLauncherMPSSM.description: A multipurpose man-portable launcher, capable of firing both guided anti-ship and unguided HEAT warheads. While no longer in its prime, it nonetheless remains devastating, even against modern technology.

WeaponPistolCCTCGalactica.name: CAW-32 "Galactica" (9x19mm)
WeaponPistolCCTCGalactica.description: Suspiciously similar to the Mk.32, this Centennial Arms original functions as a compact yet potent weapon. Threading for silencers and a pistol underbarrel mount allows for exceptional customizability on the field, while an upgraded reciever allows for powerful burst-fire capability.

WeaponPistolUllmanSmartMagnumMK5.name: U.I Smart Pistol MK5 (.55 SAM)
WeaponPistolUllmanSmartMagnumMK5.description: A prototype smart pistol developed by Ullman Industries that uses .55 Smart Action Magnum, designed for precision and adaptability in combat situations. It features advanced targeting systems and a sleek design.

WeaponPistolKuosame.name: MMC VMK "Kuosame" (5.7x28mm)
WeaponPistolKuosame.description: A basic and simple handgun for MMC employees. Only issued in high-risk zones.

WeaponPistolHawk4.name: LWC HAWK-4 I.S
WeaponPistolHawk4.description: A modified, heavy Anaconda for the purpose of assassinating high value targets. This rare prototype is capable of printing armor penetrating bullets. A laser and holographic sight alongside a matte black chassis with a custom-built integrated silencer make for an exceedingly deadly stealth weapon.

WeaponRevolverDragoon.name: TPC Dragoon officer's revolver
WeaponRevolverDragoon.description: A heavy revolver, chambered in a replicating .500 magnum round. The Dragoon is a custom made revolver for the Grand Vizier of the PDV, meant to be a commanding presence in the hands of an experienced marshall.

explosivelasergun.name: explosive laser gun
explosivelasergun.description: Favoured by Nanotrasen Security for being cheap and easy to use.

BulletMonolithicGolomRanged.name: golum spike
BulletMonolithicGolomRanged.description: A pristine, nano-particulate weave crystal apparently made out of some sort of hard-light energy. It could probably revolutionize over five different industries if studied. Unfortunately, it seems to have been thrown right at you!

WeaponRifleOsaka.name: MMC V/78 "Osaka" (5.56x45mm)
WeaponRifleOsaka.description: An accurate and cheap rifle produced by MMC. Fires 5.56x45mm.

WeaponRifleIzumo.name: MMC V/79P "Izumo" (5.56x45mm)
WeaponRifleIzumo.description: An even more accurate and much less cheap rifle produced by MMC, selected out of the highest-performing V/78 rifles and converted to a DMR role. An Erebus railmount is present on the reciever for optics.

WeaponRifleNtsfLtr.name: wayward NTSF-LTR-556 (5.56x45mm,6.8x52mm Caseless)
WeaponRifleNtsfLtr.description: An anomalous rifle. A Light Tactical Rifle ready for use by special forces operatives, chambered in 5.56x45mm. Also accepts 6.8x52mm due to it being a prototype. But... how do you know all this?

WeaponRifleMolot.name: PD-VI LA/53 Molot (7.62x51mm)
WeaponRifleMolot.description: Hard-hitting rifle firing 7.62x51mm for PDV Tarkhans. Good firerate, and exceptional muzzle velocity.

WeaponRifleWSPR.name: CS KMP-WSPR (7.62x39mm)
WeaponRifleWSPR.description: A cutting-edge Dynasty integrally-suppressed rifle, versatile and reliable, and capable of a fast-firing hyperburst. Uses 7.62x39mm ammo. An Erebus railmount is present on the top of the reciever for optics.

WeaponRifleVympel.name: PD-VI M-32 Vympel (5.56x45mm)
WeaponRifleVympel.description: A compact bullpup design. Uses 5.56x45mm rifle ammo. The barrel is threaded for suppressors, and an Erebus railmount is present on the handguard for grips.

WeaponRifleM90.name: PA M-90 (7.62x51mm)
WeaponRifleM90.description: A compact bullpup design. Uses 7.62x51mm rifle ammo. The barrel is threaded for suppressors, and an Erebus railmount is present on the carryhandle and handguard for optics/grips.

WeaponRifleBurner.name: CS Burner (12.7x99mm)
WeaponRifleBurner.description: A high caliber syndicate gun chambered in 12.7x99mm, capable of firing anti-material and high explosive rounds.

WeaponRifleVulcanFCMC.name: HWM FCM-C "Vulcan" (7.62x51mm)
WeaponRifleVulcanFCMC.description: The Herstal Weapon Manufacture "Vulcan" Civilian Medium combat rifle (Fusil de Combat Moyen Civil) in 762x51mm, this civilian version only has semi-automatic mode and reduced firerate.

WeaponRiflePrometheus.name: HWM FCL "Prometheus" (5.56x45mm)
WeaponRiflePrometheus.description: The Herstal Weapon Manufacture "Prometheus" Light combat rifle (Fusil de Combat Léger) in 556x45mm. Made to be mass producable for fight against xenos. Its firerate is decent with burst being superior and accuracy poor.

WeaponRifleMla34.name: SKR-WS MLA-34 smartgun (.160 smart)
WeaponRifleMla34.description: A limited-production special smartgun made as a self-defense weapon for untrained ship crew.

WeaponRifleIroh.name: HWL FG.J "Iroh" (5.56x45mm)
WeaponRifleIroh.description: A premium, finely-tuned rifle. Accurate, fast firing, and expensive as shit. Outfitted with Erebus rails on the handguard and carryhandle, and a threaded barrel for attachments.

WeaponRifleXlr556.name: VFD QBZX-281 ICWS (5.56x45mm)
WeaponRifleXlr556.description: A proposed next-gen "rifle" for TSF standard infantry. Chambered in 5.56x45mm rifle rounds, its RPM is incredible - but with great firerate comes great fire control...

WeaponRifleLecter.name: TCA QBZ-410 Lecter (6.8x52mm Caseless)
WeaponRifleLecter.description: The result of a project to make a new standard rifle for the branches of the TSF military. Highly accurate and easy to use, but poor damage output. Also accepts 5.56x45mm magazines to assist with standardization. The barrel is threaded for suppressors, and an Erebus railmount is on the bottom for grips.

WeaponRifleAnnie.name: TCA QBZ-430 Annie (7.62x39mm)
WeaponRifleAnnie.description: A CQB beast designed to shoulder the weight of impossible missions. Uses 7.62x39mm ammo. The barrel is threaded for suppressors, and an Erebus railmount is present on the receiver and handguard for optics/grips.

WeaponRifleRiversong.name: TCA QBZ-91 Riversong (6.8x52mm Caseless)
WeaponRifleRiversong.description: A bullpup rifle designed for usage in tanks, landing craft and other low space vehicles of the TSFMC Ground Infantry, this weapon also became popular for boarding crew due to the small frame and the ability to be fired one handed. Accurate, easy to use, and firing the 6.8x52mm STANAG round. Also accepts 5.56x45mm magazines to assist with standardization. The barrel is threaded for suppressors, and an Erebus railmount is present on the carryhandle and on the bottom for optics and grips.

WeaponRifleDragonfang.name: TCA QBB-81-1 Dragonfang (7.62x51mm)
WeaponRifleDragonfang.description: A heavy battle rifle used by FORECON in the early stage of Colossus expedition, this rifle packs an outstanding firepower in an otherwise compact frame. Chambered in 7.62x51mm it decimates anything brave enough to stand in our military conquest. The barrel is threaded for suppressors, and an Erebus railmount is on the carryhandle and on the bottom for optics and grips.

WeaponRifleAK502.name: NCI AK-502 (7.62x39mm)
WeaponRifleAK502.description: A standard-issue USSP combat rifle. Uses 7.62x39mm ammo. It has an Erebus railmount attached to the carryhandle for optics.

WeaponSubMachineGunVectorNtsfHclm.name: NTSF-HCLM-45 (.45 magnum)
WeaponSubMachineGunVectorNtsfHclm.description: The NTSF Heavy Caliber Light Machinegun. A very high-quality heavy SMG chambered in .45 magnum for use for the Nano Trasen Security Force and NT spec-ops, from the corporate war.

WeaponSubMachineGunMla73.name: SKR-WS MLA-73 (6.35x40mm caseless)
WeaponSubMachineGunMla73.description: A reliable and precise PDW design, commonly issued to pilots and AFV crewmen. This one has been modified with an integral suppressor. Legends around this weapons say it's a Corporate-Era schematic that's been built by the Phaethon Dynasty. Can take 9x19mm smg magazines in a pinch. An Erebus railmount is present on the top and bottom of the handguard for optics and grips.

WeaponSubMachineGunAtreides.name: MA PDW-58 Atreides (5.7x28mm)
WeaponSubMachineGunAtreides.description: Midnight Arms Co. Streamlined SMG that's commonly found use among uprisings and criminals. Uses 5.7x28mm ammo.

WeaponSubMachineGunC20r.name: CS C-20r submachine gun (9x19mm)
WeaponSubMachineGunC20r.description: A Corporate-Era SMG, once used by Nuclear Operatives, it now finds purchase among the Phaethon Dynasty. Uses 9x19mm ammo.

WeaponSubMachineGunVector9x19mm.name: LWC Vector (9x19mm)
WeaponSubMachineGunVector9x19mm.description: An excellent fully automatic SMG. Uses 9x19mm ammo. An Erebus railmount is present on the top of the reciever and the bottom of the handguard for optics and grips.

WeaponSubMachineGunVector45_ACP.name: LWC Vector (.45 ACP)
WeaponSubMachineGunVector45_ACP.description: An excellent fully automatic SMG. Uses .45 ACP ammo. An Erebus railmount is present on the top of the reciever and the bottom of the handguard for optics and grips.

WeaponSubMachineGunKnallstock.name: LWC Knallstock (9x19mm/.45 ACP)
WeaponSubMachineGunKnallstock.description: A rugged and reliable SMG using large, rapid fire bursts. Accepts 9x19 or .45 ACP pistol magazines. Watch out for its ammo consumption.

WeaponSubMachineGunTypewriterPMC.name: PA Keyboard (.45 ACP)
WeaponSubMachineGunTypewriterPMC.description: A modern take on the classic design used by mobsters throughout space and time. This one is an offbrand mercenary version of the typewritter nicknamed the "keyboard", its barrel heat rapidly which reduce accuracy. Uses .45 ACP ammo.

WeaponSubMachineGunFirestarter.name: HWM Firestarter (.45 ACP)
WeaponSubMachineGunFirestarter.description: An excellent fully automatic SMG. Uses .45 ACP ammo.

WeaponSubMachineGunMalandro.name: RS-2 Malandro (9x19mm)
WeaponSubMachineGunMalandro.description: A rugged, run down SMG chambered in 9x19mm designed for short range shootouts, featuring a 10 round burst at the cost of accuracy.

WeaponSubMachineGunMasamune.name: MMC VK-550 Masamune (5.7x28mm)
WeaponSubMachineGunMasamune.description: A basic PDW for corporate security. No modularity whatsoever.

WeaponSubMachineGunSakura.name: MMC Sakura Smart-SMG (.160 smart)
WeaponSubMachineGunSakura.description: A full production variant of the Abielle smart gun, fully developed by MMC.

WeaponSubMachineGunDrozd.name: TCA CS/LR-8 Drozd (.45 ACP)
WeaponSubMachineGunDrozd.description: An SMG that once found use among NT security forces, now has found itself as one of the most reliable boarding and anti-boarding weapons on the market. Uses .45 ACP ammo. The barrel is threaded for suppressors, and an Erebus railmount is on the bottom for grips.

WeaponSubMachineGunAK220.name: NCI AK-220 (9x19mm)
WeaponSubMachineGunAK220.description: A mass produced 9x19mm bullpup SMG. The design originates from the USSP, but various TSF and PDV manufacturers produce it via licenses or suspiciously similar "original" designs.

WeaponShotgunSultanPulsar.name: PD-VI "Sultan's Pulsar" shotgun (4 gauge)
WeaponShotgunSultanPulsar.description: A beast of a bolt-action shotgun, capable of firing the Sultan's finest 4-gauge with exceptional accuracy. Overkill for most space fauna, but using this means its certain you're hunting the most dangerous game.

WeaponShotgunFlagbearer.name: PD-VI LK/210 Flagbearer (12 gauge)
WeaponShotgunFlagbearer.description: A fully-automatic 12 gauge shotgun feeding from a giant built-in drum. 32 round capacity.

WeaponShotgunBigLeady.name: Big Leady (4 gauge)
WeaponShotgunBigLeady.description: A large 4 gauge (23x75mm) shotgun made to kill what any caliber below an autocannon cant.

WeaponShotgunBigJohnny.name: Big Johnny (4 gauge)
WeaponShotgunBigJohnny.description: A large 4 gauge (23x75mm) shotgun made to kill what any caliber below an autocannon cant. This one is outfitted with various tactical additions and is made for CQC at the cost of low ammo capacity. It has an Erebus railmount attached to the reciever for optics.

WeaponShotgunBigBuddy.name: Big Buddy (4 gauge)
WeaponShotgunBigBuddy.description: A massive 4 gauge (23x75mm) shotgun made to kill what any caliber below an autocannon cant.

WeaponShotgunJack.name: GS-004-A Jack (4 gauge)
WeaponShotgunJack.description: An incredibly heavy automated fire 23x75mm shotgun that loads from a belt and a specialized backpack.

WeaponShotgunHelepolis.name: UW12-B Helepolis (12 gauge)
WeaponShotgunHelepolis.description: The Union Wrightworks 12-gauge breaching model "Helepolis", a compact shotgun that sacrifices all combat ergonomics to better serve as a breaching tool. Breaks doors with slugs. Combat use unadvised.

WeaponShotgunBuckshot.name: roulette shotgun
WeaponShotgunBuckshot.description: Smells like despair, greed, and fear. Careful, now...

WeaponSniperHristov.name: SKR-WS M96 Hristov (14.5x114mm)
WeaponSniperHristov.description: A portable, 3-round anti-material rifle. Fires high velocity 14.5mm shells. Uses 14.5x114mm ammo.

WeaponSniperHristovEmpty.name: SKR-WS M96 Hristov (14.5x114mm)
WeaponSniperHristovEmpty.description: A portable, 3-round anti-material rifle. Fires high velocity 14.5mm shells. Uses 14.5x114mm ammo.

WeaponSniperHristovEMPHE.name: SKR-WS M96 Hristov (14.5x114mm)
WeaponSniperHristovEMPHE.description: A portable, 3-round anti-material rifle. Fires high velocity 14.5mm shells. Uses 14.5x114mm ammo.

WeaponRifleLeeEnfield.name: MI Lee Enfield Mk 98 (7.62x51mm)
WeaponRifleLeeEnfield.description: Reliable 762x51mm sniper rifle, designed and produced by Militia Ironworks to fit modern standards sniper rifle.

WeaponAMRShenzhen.name: TCA QBU-284 'Shenzhen' coilgun AMR
WeaponAMRShenzhen.description: Magazine-fed AMR, utilizing electromagnets to fire 13.4x92mm DU-APFSDS rounds with extreme velocity.

WeaponAMRShenzhenEmpty.name: TCA QBU-284 'Shenzhen' coilgun AMR
WeaponAMRShenzhenEmpty.description: Magazine-fed AMR, utilizing electromagnets to fire 13.4x92mm DU-APFSDS rounds with extreme velocity.

WeaponRifleMR8C.name: VFD QBU-243 Xian DMR (8x65mm SKR)
WeaponRifleMR8C.description: High powered, relatively fast-firing marksman rifle, intended for MARSOC usage. Chambered in 8x65mm SKR. An Erebus railmount is attached to the top of the reciever and the bottom of the handguard for optics and grips.

WeaponRifleMR3C.name: SKR-WS QBU-430 Bandit (8x65mm SKR)
WeaponRifleMR3C.description: A precise and reliable bullpup DMR, developed as a cheaper production model from early QBU-243 prototypes. Feeds from 8x65mm STANAG magazines. It has a Erebus railmount for optics.

WeaponRifleAK410.name: NCI AK-410 (7.62x54mmR)
WeaponRifleAK410.description: Bullpup DMR feeding from 7.62x54mmR magazines, developed to modernize USSP long-range infantry weapons. It has an Erebus railmount attached to the reciever for optics.

WeaponSniperMosin.name: NCI Kardashev-Mosin (7.62x54mmR)
WeaponSniperMosin.description: A weapon for hunting, or endless trench warfare. Uses 762x54mmR ammo. Equipped with bayonet.

BallisticTurretHeavyBase.name: heavy ballistic turret
BallisticTurretHeavyBase.description: A massively reinforced turret, firing a barrage of anti-material 7.62x51mm rounds that rip up targets and mechs alike. Woe be the fool who walks in front of this.

WeaponTurretHeavyRIPBase.name: heavy ballistic RIP turret
WeaponTurretHeavyRIPBase.description: A variant on the standard heavy ballistic turret, firing a barrage of 7.62x51mm RIP ammunition to delete anything unarmored. Chimera hate these.

WeaponTurretRepairableBroken.name: heavy ballistic RIP turret (broken)
WeaponTurretRepairableBroken.description: Chimera prefer it like this. It looks like it can be brought back online with a bit of welding or nanites.

WeaponRadAx.name: axium
WeaponRadAx.description: A one handed ax with an ampable uranium blade, favored by IPC soldiers the galaxy round.

WeaponOverseerMace.name: heavy maul "Honor"
WeaponOverseerMace.description: A large, weighty maul, designed to deal the pain, alongside disabling targets. But when activated, becomes an energy axe made of searing plasma, cleaving through anything in its way.

WeaponShockMaul.name: tintreach
WeaponShockMaul.description: A heafty hammer designed for violent application of blunt force, and swift application of electrocution after. In a pinch it can serve as a defib, good for saving allies...or taking your time with a hated foe.

WeaponHFKatana.name: high-frequency blade
WeaponHFKatana.description: A high-frequency blade. It's incredibly powerful.

WeaponVT7.name: VT-7 high-frequency blade
WeaponVT7.description: A high-frequency blade tuned with ill-advised modifications designed to sunder armor.

WeaponPhaseBlade.name: nano-laminate phaseblade
WeaponPhaseBlade.description: A heavy bladed weapon with a wicked edge, commonly seen in the hands of pre-fracture warriors. Can be activated to adjust to combat needs

UllmanPlasmaBlade.name: U.I. unstable plasma blade
UllmanPlasmaBlade.description: A unique weapon, using welding fuel as a catalyst to ignite. The unstable plasma bursts forth with a wild, powerful flame to temporarily boost damage output.

WeaponVizierShamshir.name: officer's shamshir
WeaponVizierShamshir.description: A uniquely curved sword, a sharp weapon styled after weapons of old, made of pale plastitanium. Primed to strike and sever.

NanolaminateFoamGrenade.name: nanolaminate foam grenade
NanolaminateFoamGrenade.description: An advanced version of a metal foam grenade. Instead of aluminium, the foam grows a nano-reinforced alloy in a large area, capable of sustaining much more damage than aluminium.

StickyGrenade.name: sticky bomb
StickyGrenade.description: An anti-tank sticky bomb based on old designs, still effective even in space. Packs a punch, but has a long delay.

DirtyRadGrenade.name: dirty bomb
DirtyRadGrenade.description: A unique weapon, effective at area denial. After a few seconds, degrades into a highly radioactive sludge. Probably illegal in the inner sectors, but that won't stop you.

DirtyRadHeap.name: radioactive heap
DirtyRadHeap.description: Basically the elephant's foot. Even just looking at this makes you feel cancerous.

ShotgunTrap.name: shotgun trap
ShotgunTrap.description: A makeshift 4-gauge shotgun hooked up to a remote signaler.

WeaponTurretType35.name: Type-35 MARAUDER-type plasma cannon
WeaponTurretType35.description: Launches magnetically contained balls of plasma at targets. Can be remotely activated, or linked up to a GCS.

WeaponTurretCerberus.name: TPC Cerberus Plasma scattercannon
WeaponTurretCerberus.description: Borrowing from the design of the Marauder, the Cerberus fires very similar shots, but in a tight spread of 3 blasts

WeaponTurretType54.name: Type-54C plasma autopulser
WeaponTurretType54.description: A rapidly firing energy weapon, well known for its devastating burst followed by a constant stream of plasma.

WeaponTurretM25.name: M25 mining pulser
WeaponTurretM25.description: Uses mechanisms to launch... something. Destroys rock easily. Limited range.

WeaponTurretM220.name: M220 RUBICON EMP launcher
WeaponTurretM220.description: Launches EMP projectiles at ships, disabling systems with powerful electromagnetic pulses. Ideal for non-lethal engagements and can be remotely activated or linked to a GCS.

WeaponTurretScylla.name: TPC Scylla plasma impulse driver
WeaponTurretScylla.description: A more specialized energy weapon, the Scylla fires a massive burst of plasma projectiles down range, in a huge spew to erase large and small targets alike.

WeaponTurretDymere.name: ADEX-9 DYMERE Turbolaser
WeaponTurretDymere.description: Aetherion Dynamics' most iconic supercapital battery. Fires enormous ionized gas projectiles that melt through the toughest ship armor. Can be remotely activated or linked to a GCS.

WeaponLaserTurretL1Phalanx.name: L-1 Phalanx
WeaponLaserTurretL1Phalanx.description: A light laser emplacement designed by the Pantheon Collective, used to shred threats of all types.

WeaponLaserTurretPrometheus.name: TPC Prometheus Laser Cannon
WeaponLaserTurretPrometheus.description: A heavier laser cannon mount, after the relative failure of the Apollo and its subsequent conversion into a mining laser, the Prometheus comes to the field as the new heavy laser cannon, perfect for melting through hostile hulls.

WeaponLaserTurretApollo.name: L-20 Apollo Mining Laser Cannon
WeaponLaserTurretApollo.description: One of the Pantheon Collective's top weapons, the Apollo is aptly named for its beams heating surfaces to beyond the temperature of nearby stars.

WeaponTurretType241.name: Curio-8640 plasma lance "Malice"
WeaponTurretType241.description: A devastating weapon, known for glassing whole fleets when used en masse

WeaponTurretReaper.name: Curio-1089 tachyon lance "Reaper"
WeaponTurretReaper.description: A terrifying weapon to have aimed at you, the Reaper is an ancient piece of pre-fracture tech capable of shattering the strongest of hulls within one or two blasts.

WeaponTurretHarbringer.name: Curio-129 ion cannon "Harbringer"
WeaponTurretHarbringer.description: One of the most powerful EMP weapons in sector, it is a sign of doom for its targets.

WeaponTurretTartarus.name: Curio-1810 antimatter particle cannon "Tartarus"
WeaponTurretTartarus.description: A rarer, powerful cannon mounted on larger ADS units. Firing a singular particle of antimatter wrapped in energy. Annihalating sections of shuttles at a time.

WeaponTurretSunder.name: Curio-1007 proton cannon "Sunder"
WeaponTurretSunder.description: A potent proton cannon from before the Fracture, known for melting holes through both inorganic and organic matter with ease.

WeaponTurretScythe.name: Curio-1008 neutron repeater "Scythe"
WeaponTurretScythe.description: A burst firing neutron repeater, firing high-damage but slow balls of hell. A marvel of rapture weapons technology. Specializes in tunneling through anything that can't outmanuever it.

WeaponLaserTurretFlayer.name: Curio-183 auto-coil "Flayer"
WeaponLaserTurretFlayer.description: A unique pre-fracture weapon, the Flayer fires a storm of tungsten alloy darts at near the speed of light, barraging targets to pieces.

120mmCartridgeAPHEDS.name: 120mm APHEDS shell
120mmCartridgeAPHEDS.description: A chemically-propelled armor-piercing high-explosive discarding-sabot shell for 120mm cannons.

220mmCartridgeAPHE.name: 220mm APHE shell
220mmCartridgeAPHE.description: A chemically-propelled armor-piercing high-explosive shell for 220mm cannons.

220mmCartridgeHECluster.name: 220mm HE-CLST shell
220mmCartridgeHECluster.description: A chemically-propelled high-explosive cluster shell for 220mm cannons. Shoots a spread of explosive projectiles.

220mmCartridgeSmartCluster.name: 220mm HMNG-CLST shell
220mmCartridgeSmartCluster.description: A chemically-propelled homing cluster shell for 220mm cannons. Shoots a spread of explosive projectiles that seek targets with basic tracking.

Box220mmAPHE.name: 220mm APHE ammo box
Box220mmAPHE.description: A big box containing 24 220mm APHE rounds. Usable by vessel-mounted artillery pieces.

Box220mmHECluster.name: 220mm HE-CLST ammo box
Box220mmHECluster.description: A big box containing 24 220mm high-explosive cluster rounds. Usable by vessel-mounted artillery pieces.

Box220mmSmartCluster.name: 220mm HMNG-CLST ammo box
Box220mmSmartCluster.description: A big box containing 24 220mm homing-cluster rounds. Usable by vessel-mounted artillery pieces.

255mmCartridgeAPHE.name: 255mm APHE shell
255mmCartridgeAPHE.description: A chemically-propelled armor-piercing high-explosive shell for 255mm cannons.

255mmCartridgeEMP.name: 255mm EMP shell
255mmCartridgeEMP.description: A chemically-propelled electromagnetic pulse shell for 255mm cannons.

255mmCartridgeMinelayer.name: 255mm minelayer shell
255mmCartridgeMinelayer.description: A chemically-propelled shell for 255mm cannons with a timed fuse. When the fuse expires after 1 seconds, it ejects a payload of 4 large anti-ship mines that persist for 1 hour.

Box255mmAPHE.name: 255mm APHE ammo box
Box255mmAPHE.description: A big box containing 16 255mm APHE rounds. Usable by vessel-mounted artillery pieces.

Box255mmEMP.name: 255mm EMP ammo box
Box255mmEMP.description: A big box containing 16 255mm EMP rounds. Usable by vessel-mounted artillery pieces.

Box255mmMine.name: 255mm minelayer ammo box
Box255mmMine.description: A big box containing 16 255mm minelayer rounds. Usable by vessel-mounted artillery pieces.

R300ShellHE.name: 430mm HE shell
R300ShellHE.description: Giant sluggish HE shell. Exclusive to the R300.

CharonSlugAmmo.name: M381 CHARON 280mm 26.5kg slug cartridge
CharonSlugAmmo.description: An all-in-one package containing plasma gas accelerant and a high-density tungsten slug. Cheap, devastating, and long ranged.

CharonApheSlugAmmo.name: M381 CHARON 280mm 26.5kg APHE slug cartridge
CharonApheSlugAmmo.description: An all-in-one package containing plasma gas accelerant and a high-density tungsten slug loaded with a small explosive payload. Cheap, devastating, and long ranged.

CharonEmpSlugAmmo.name: M381 CHARON 280mm 26.5kg EMP slug cartridge
CharonEmpSlugAmmo.description: An all-in-one package containing plasma gas accelerant and a high-density tungsten slug loaded with a large electromagnetic payload. Creates massive EMP arcs on impact, but has limited penetration power. Amazing for shields!

CharonSubnuclearSlugAmmo.name: M381 CHARON 280mm 1.5kt subnuclear slug cartridge
CharonSubnuclearSlugAmmo.description: NUCLEAR. CARNAGE. An all-in-one package containing plasma gas accelerant, and a low-yield fission warhead. May cause public outcry, but you *had* to use this, right?

150mmEmpShell.name: 150mm EMP shell
150mmEmpShell.description: A chemically-propelled EMP shell, used in 150mm cannons such as the TARNYX. Nothing fancy.

150mmApShell.name: 150mm AP shell
150mmApShell.description: A chemically-propelled AP shell for 150mm cannons. Its not very good, as most 150mm cannons are optimized for EMP shells. Its a crude method, and it certainly wouldn't pass a TSFN inspection.

150mmApheShell.name: 150mm APHE shell
150mmApheShell.description: A chemically-propelled APHE shell for 150mm cannons. It'll work.

Magazine140mm.name: 140mm APHE ammo loader
Magazine140mm.description: An ammunition loader containing infinite 140mm APHE rounds. Usable by vessel-mounted artillery pieces.

Magazine140mmSACLOS.name: 140mm SACLOS ammo loader
Magazine140mmSACLOS.description: An ammunition loader containing 120 140mm laser-guided semi-automatic-command-line-of-sight rounds. Thats a mouthful, but it just means it's guided by you directly mid-flight. Usable by vessel-mounted artillery pieces.

Magazine20mm.name: 20mm solid ammo loader
Magazine20mm.description: An ammunition loader containing infinite 20mm solid rounds. Usable by vessel-mounted artillery pieces.

Magazine20mmAS.name: 20mm AS ammo loader
Magazine20mmAS.description: An ammunition loader containing 1250 20mm anti-shield rounds. Usable by vessel-mounted artillery pieces.

Magazine30mm.name: 30mm solid ammo loader
Magazine30mm.description: An ammunition loader containing infinite 30mm solid rounds. Usable by vessel-mounted artillery pieces.

Magazine30mmHE.name: 30mm HE ammo loader
Magazine30mmHE.description: An ammunition loader containing 2000 30mm HE rounds. Usable by vessel-mounted artillery pieces.

Magazine35mm.name: 35mm solid ammo loader
Magazine35mm.description: An ammunition loader containing infinite 35mm solid rounds. Usable by vessel-mounted artillery pieces.

Magazine35mmHE.name: 35mm HE ammo loader
Magazine35mmHE.description: An ammunition loader containing 2000 35mm HE rounds. Usable by vessel-mounted artillery pieces.

Magazine57mmHE.name: 57mm HE ammo loader
Magazine57mmHE.description: An ammunition loader containing infinite 57mm high-explosive rounds. Usable by vessel-mounted artillery pieces.

Magazine57mmSmart.name: 57mm HMNG ammo loader
Magazine57mmSmart.description: An ammunition loader containing 600 57mm homing rounds. Usable by vessel-mounted artillery pieces.

Magazine57mmSmartInfinite.name: 57mm HMNG ammo loader
Magazine57mmSmartInfinite.description: An ammunition loader containing infinite 57mm homing rounds. Usable by vessel-mounted artillery pieces.

Magazine57mmSACLOS.name: 57mm LG-SACLOS ammo loader
Magazine57mmSACLOS.description: An ammunition loader containing 600 57mm laser-guided semi-automatic-command-line-of-sight rounds. Thats a mouthful, but it just means it's guided by you directly mid-flight. Usable by vessel-mounted artillery pieces.

Magazine57mmSACLOSInfinite.name: 57mm LG-SACLOS ammo loader
Magazine57mmSACLOSInfinite.description: An ammunition loader containing infinite 57mm laser-guided semi-automatic-command-line-of-sight rounds. Thats a mouthful, but it just means it's guided by you directly mid-flight. Usable by vessel-mounted artillery pieces.

90mmMagazineHE.name: 90mm HE ammo loader
90mmMagazineHE.description: An ammunition loader containing infinite 90mm high-explosive rounds. Usable by 90mm vessel-mounted artillery pieces.

90mmMagazineAP.name: 90mm AP ammo loader
90mmMagazineAP.description: An ammunition loader containing infinite 90mm armor-piercing rounds. Usable by 90mm vessel-mounted artillery pieces.

90mmMagazineFlak.name: 90mm flak ammo loader
90mmMagazineFlak.description: An ammunition loader containing infinite 90mm flak rounds. Usable by 90mm vessel-mounted artillery pieces.

90mmMagazineMinelayerInfinite.name: 90mm minelayer ammo loader
90mmMagazineMinelayerInfinite.description: An ammunition loader containing infinite 90mm minelayer rounds. Usable by 90mm vessel-mounted artillery pieces.

90mmMagazineMinelayer.name: 90mm minelayer ammo loader
90mmMagazineMinelayer.description: An ammunition loader containing 400 90mm minelayer rounds. Usable by 90mm vessel-mounted artillery pieces.

SunnyCartridge.name: Packaged flare
SunnyCartridge.description: An individual electronically activated flare for the GS-002 countermeasure system.

WeaponTurretCharon.name: M381 CHARON mass driver
WeaponTurretCharon.description: A capital-class railgun that fires a massive slug at extreme velocity, capable of catastrophic damage to enemy ships. Heavy linear accelerator, can be remotely activated or linked up to a GCS. This one feeds from an autoloader somewhere, and doesn't need manual reloads.

WeaponTurretCharonReload.name: M381 CHARON mass driver
WeaponTurretCharonReload.description: A capital-class railgun that fires a massive slug at extreme velocity, capable of catastrophic damage to enemy ships. Heavy linear accelerator, can be remotely activated or linked up to a GCS.

WeaponTurretShard.name: Light mass driver "Shard"
WeaponTurretShard.description: Ultralight mass driver weapon of unknown origin, designated "Shard" during initial reverse engineering attempts. Light damage, but long range and little upkeep to mount on ships.

WeaponTurretFragment.name: "Fragment" modified mass driver
WeaponTurretFragment.description: Appears to be a heavily modified "Shard" mass driver. Unstable and rarely found in the wild.

WeaponTurretPinhole.name: Pinhole-class railgun
WeaponTurretPinhole.description: Mass driver weapon of unknown origin. Reverse engineering attempts have indicated extremely high projectile velocity and high-mass projectiles with unresolved ship-pushing payload.

WeaponTurretFlare.name: GS-002 Sunny flare system
WeaponTurretFlare.description: A relatively small flare flinging hardpoint used to fool heat seeking missiles. Also good for search and rescue.

ShipRailgunProjectileSubnuclear.name: M381 CHARON 280mm 1.5kt nuclear slug
ShipRailgunProjectileSubnuclear.description: Once the genie is out of the bottle, there's no putting it back inside, Tarkhan.

WeaponTurretCyrexa.name: CYREXA 220mm cannon
WeaponTurretCyrexa.description: A main battery with dual barrels, delivering rapid, punishing salvos at extreme range. Fires 220mm auto shells with slightly reduced brute strength. Can be remotely activated or linked up to a GCS.

WeaponTurretAk820.name: AK820 120mm autocannon
WeaponTurretAk820.description: Large hard hitting naval gun for steady damage. Fires APHEDS rounds, allowing for enhanced penetration, but not as much explosive power as full-sized APHE rounds. Feeds from an 96 round internal magazine.

WeaponTurretBofors.name: Bofors 255mm cannon
WeaponTurretBofors.description: A single-barrel, heavy artillery cannon designed for cruisers, delivering massive impact with each long-range shot. Can be remotely activated or linked up to a GCS.

WeaponTurretHades.name: HADES 255mm cannon
WeaponTurretHades.description: One of the largest chemical-based kinetic weapons in the sector. Its power is only rivaled by mass drivers such as the M381. Automatically reloads full-power 255mm shells.

WeaponTurretLongbow.name: L/65 "Longbow" 140mm autocannon
WeaponTurretLongbow.description: Fires 140mm shells in a 15 round burst from an internal autoloader.

WeaponTurretL85Autocannon.name: L85 20mm autocannon
WeaponTurretL85Autocannon.description: A light 20mm ballistic autocannon designed for rapid fire point defense and suppressing smaller targets at close range. Cheap, light, and can be remotely activated or linked up to a GCS.

WeaponTurretRAC30.name: RAC-30 Draupnir Autocannon
WeaponTurretRAC30.description: A heavy duty rapid fire 30mm autocannon, originally mounted as a dogfighting weapon on atmospheric craft.

WeaponTurretAK570.name: AK570 57mm autocannon
WeaponTurretAK570.description: A dual-barrel, heavy 57mm autocannon firing general-purpose APHE rounds, effective for sustained fire against medium targets. Can be remotely activated or linked up to a GCS.

WeaponTurretDravon.name: ADBP-7 DRAVON 90mm Autocannon
WeaponTurretDravon.description: A single-barrel autocannon made by Aetherion Dynamics. Medium artillery piece with high impact but relatively low fire rate, firing HEAT shells to damage ship armor and systems. Can be remotely activated or linked up to a GCS.

WeaponTurretAdderScattercannon.name: Adder scattercannon
WeaponTurretAdderScattercannon.description: A large, twin-barrelled scatter cannon, firing bursts of canister shot to shred any incoming missiles or potential boarders. Uses a self loading mechanism similar to the anaconda handgun.

WeaponTurretFang.name: Fang heavy 90mm autocannon
WeaponTurretFang.description: A heavy 90mm autocannon of syndicate design, created during the corporate war. Made for shattering opponent destroyers. Uses a self loading mechanism similar to the anaconda handgun.

WeaponTurretHydra.name: Hydra 220mm battery
WeaponTurretHydra.description: A main cannonade of syndicate origin, the hydra is a monstrous tri-barreled battery of 220-millimeter pain, designed to shatter corpations' toughest vessels. Loads with a similar mechanism as the anaconda handgun.

WeaponTurretLeviathan.name: LEVIATHAN 520mm howitzer
WeaponTurretLeviathan.description: A heavy artillery gun of syndicate origin, the leviathan is tyrannic testiment of Syndicate ingenuity, designed to send a message. Able to crack NanoTrasen battleships, and small fighters in a single shell. Loads with a similar mechanism as the anaconda handgun.

WeaponTurretTarnyx.name: ADBX-31 TARNYX 150mm EMP Cannon
WeaponTurretTarnyx.description: A heavy EMP cannon made by Aetherion Dynamics, designed to disable large sections of enemy ships with a single, powerful shot. Effective in asymmetric combat. Can be remotely activated or linked up to a GCS.

WeaponTurretTarnyxReload.name: ADBX-31 TARNYX 150mm EMP Cannon
WeaponTurretTarnyxReload.description: A heavy EMP cannon made by Aetherion Dynamics, designed to disable large sections of enemy ships with a single, powerful shot. Effective in asymmetric combat. Can be remotely activated or linked up to a GCS.

WeaponTurretThanatos.name: THANATOS twin mass driver
WeaponTurretThanatos.description: The charon's mean older brother, the Thanatos is a force to be reckoned with. It can be remotely activated or linked up to a GCS. This one feeds from an autoloader somewhere, and doesn't need manual reloads.

LightFighterOrdinanceGPOItem.name: GPO-L 50kg Unguided Bomb
LightFighterOrdinanceGPOItem.description: A fairly durable and relatively high yield explosive payload. Rarely seen in conventional space combat and a remnant of ground-based warfare, bombs can deal devastating damage... if they manage to hit their target. It can fit in a light GPOL housing.

LightFighterOrdinanceZenithItem.name: ASM(LF)5 "Zenith" Anti-Ship Warhead
LightFighterOrdinanceZenithItem.description: A military-grade guided missile usually deployed by light spacecraft. Capable of significant damage and more easy to hit targets with than a bomb, the Zenith is accurate and fast, but not durable. It can fit in a light GPOL housing.

LightFighterOrdinanceQuasarItem.name: AD-901 "QUASAR" disposable hyperpenetrator
LightFighterOrdinanceQuasarItem.description: A costly and experimental foray into the minification of hyperaccelerator technologies for use on smaller spaceframes, the QUASAR hyperpenetrator is a relatively weak, but fast-moving munition impervious to most anti-munition weapons. It can fit in a light GPOL housing.

SandboxHEMissile.name: SS-N-40 8K30 cruise missile (HE-SACLOS)
SandboxHEMissile.description: A high-velocity long-range cruise missile. Hard to shoot-down, hard to survive, and requires constant guidance from the gunnery console.

SandboxNuclearMissile.name: SS-N-40 'Atlant' nuclear cruise missile
SandboxNuclearMissile.description: A high-velocity cruise missile equipped with multi-kiloton nuclear warhead, capable of disabling any ship in a single blow. Almost unstoppable, and looks identical to a normal 8K30 on radar. This is a weapon of mass destruction, the destroyer of worlds. Hopefully you don't need to use it.

TovekCartridge.name: 250mm EMPHE missile
TovekCartridge.description: An individual ASM-250 EMPHE missile for a Tovek/Paladin launcher.

MissileCartridge250mm.name: 250mm HEAT missile
MissileCartridge250mm.description: An individual ASM-250 HEAT missile for a Tovek/Paladin launcher.

MissileCartridge250mmHV.name: 250mm HV missile
MissileCartridge250mmHV.description: An individual ASM-250 high-velocity missile for a Tovek/Paladin launcher.

Asm220TorpedoHE.name: ASM-220 high-explosive torpedo
Asm220TorpedoHE.description: Contains a large explosive payload. High-Explosive is an understatement.

Asm220TorpedoHESACLOS.name: ASM-220 high-explosive SACLOS torpedo
Asm220TorpedoHESACLOS.description: Contains a large explosive payload. High-Explosive is an understatement. This one is equipped with a SACLOS guidance system and requires manual guidance to target, but can move faster.

Asm220TorpedoLOSAT.name: ASM-220 LOSAT missile
Asm220TorpedoLOSAT.description: Effectively a large plastitanium hyper-penetrator. Tears through hull with ease.

Asm220TorpedoECM.name: ASM-220 ECM torpedo
Asm220TorpedoECM.description: Compared to a standard HE torpedo, this one is much more destructive to electronics due to an EMP payload installed inside, though it's almost completely harmless to the hull.

VanykCartridge.name: 150mm HEAT missile
VanykCartridge.description: An individual ASM-150 HEAT missile used in the Vanyk.

MissileCartridge50mmHE.name: 50mm HE missile
MissileCartridge50mmHE.description: An individual ADMP-50 high-explosive missile for a 50mm missile launcher.

WeaponTurretSerpentMissile.name: Serpent torpedo launcher
WeaponTurretSerpentMissile.description: A light torpedo launcher developed by the Syndicate during the corporate war, uses similar systems to the anaconda for self loading munitons.

WeaponTurretTorpedoEntropy.name: Curio-1602 electron torpedo launcher "Entropy"
WeaponTurretTorpedoEntropy.description: An odd weapon of the pre-fracture era, it projects a mass of electrons that seek out the positive charge of nearby targets, overloading systems and shattering sections of hull.

WeaponTurretLightMunitionsBay.name: GPOB-L Light Munitions Bay
WeaponTurretLightMunitionsBay.description: A relatively small, armored munitions bay capable of holding up to two lightweight ordinance packages. Typically found on light spacecraft, particularly bombers, and provide a limited use method of damaging targets far above the user's weight class.

WeaponTurretPaladin.name: MLRS-382 "Paladin" Missile Pod
WeaponTurretPaladin.description: Heavy missile pod firing 250mm guided rockets in bursts of 4.

WeaponTurretSandbox.name: SS-N-40 "Sandbox" launcher
WeaponTurretSandbox.description: A strategic cruise missile launcher, able to fire extremely fast, long-ranged and nuclear-capable SARH munitions. Born from an almost genetic fear from long ago, this weapon system has long brought peace... until now.

WeaponTurretTovek.name: ADMX-250 TOVEK Missile Pod
WeaponTurretTovek.description: A 250mm missile pod created by Aetherion Dynamics. Fires 250mm warheads to devastate enemy ships at long range. Can be remotely activated or linked to a GCS.

WeaponTurretASM220.name: ASM-220 "Trident" Torpedo Rack
WeaponTurretASM220.description: A heavy built-in torpedo rack for cruisers which relies on manual loading, usually done at harbor. Despite this, it has the largest missiles in the sector.

WeaponTurretASM220Station.name: WeaponTurretASM220Station
WeaponTurretASM220Station.description: A heavy built-in torpedo rack for cruisers which relies on manual loading, usually done at harbor. Despite this, it has the largest missiles in the sector. This one is connected to a system for autoloading the VLS from a capital or stations reserves.
WeaponTurretASM220Station.suffix: Supercap/Station, Infinite HE, I'll kill you if you put this on a normal capital.

WeaponTurretVanquisher.name: SRM-573 "Vanquisher" Missile Pod
WeaponTurretVanquisher.description: A short-ranged missile pod firing 150mm unguided rockets with devastating fire rate.

WeaponTurretVanyk.name: ASM-150 "Vanyk" Missile Pod
WeaponTurretVanyk.description: An escort missile pod manufactured by Aetherion Dynamics. Launches 150mm guided missiles for basic ship-to-ship combat and area denial. Uses a built-in autoloader instead of a rack, increasing capacity but reducing rate of fire. Can be remotely activated or linked to a GCS.

WeaponTurretVespera.name: ADMP-50 VESPERA Missile Rack
WeaponTurretVespera.description: A rapid-fire swarm missile rack manufactured by Aetherion Dynamics. Saturates targets with guided warheads to overwhelm defenses. Limited ammo, but deadly. Can be remotely activated or linked to a GCS.

BannerNGC.name: TSF banner
BannerNGC.description: A banner proudly displaying the stars of the Trans-Solar Federation.

BannerSHM.name: SHM banner
BannerSHM.description: A banner effectively representing the iconography of Steel Hammer Manufacturing Inc.

BannerDrakeIndustries.name: DI banner
BannerDrakeIndustries.description: A banner harboring Drake Industries' emblem. The mega corp's emblem is woven into a high quality textile that you've doubt you've every seen anywhere else in the sector. Must be why the banner is not attached to, but rather fused on it's pole.

GreebleAntenna1.name: antenna
GreebleAntenna1.description: Like antennas to hell. Usually part of a ship or station's UHF communication systems.

GreebleAntenna2.name: antenna
GreebleAntenna2.description: Like antennas to hell. Usually part of a ship or station's UHF communication systems.

GreebleAntenna3.name: antenna
GreebleAntenna3.description: Like antennas to hell. Usually part of a ship or station's UHF communication systems.

GreebleRadiator1.name: radiator
GreebleRadiator1.description: A large and delicate heat-dispersing array found on the outside of ships. Useful for cooling down reactors, but there are usually failsafe internal heat sinks.

GreebleRadiator2.name: radiator
GreebleRadiator2.description: A large and delicate heat-dispersing array found on the outside of ships. Useful for cooling down reactors, but there are usually failsafe internal heat sinks.

GreebleElint1.name: ELINT system
GreebleElint1.description: Used for reading noncommunication electromagnetic radiation and their properties, such as radar signals. Who gives a shit?

GreebleSideLabel1.name: warning label
GreebleSideLabel1.description: A generic hazard label. Something dangerous is probably nearby.

GreebleSideLabel2.name: warning label
GreebleSideLabel2.description: A generic hazard label. This one seems to be related to thrust plumes.

GreebleSideLabel3.name: warning label
GreebleSideLabel3.description: A generic hazard label. Something dangerous is probably nearby.

GreebleSideLabel4.name: warning label
GreebleSideLabel4.description: A generic hazard label. Something dangerous is probably nearby.

GreebleRadarpanel1.name: radar panel
GreebleRadarpanel1.description: Some kind of protective fiberglass panelling. Seen in various systems, such as weather and altitude mapping to military early-warning systems. If it's powerful enough, you might get cancer a bit faster!

GreebleRadarpanel2.name: radar panel
GreebleRadarpanel2.description: Some kind of protective fiberglass panelling. Seen in various systems, such as weather and altitude mapping to military early-warning systems. If it's powerful enough, you might get cancer a bit faster!

CrystalMonolithic.name: small aether crystal
CrystalMonolithic.description: A mysterious crystalline solid. Seems highly energetic, but fragile.

AirlockGlassShuttleNfsdOutpostLocked.name: AirlockGlassShuttleNfsdOutpostLocked
AirlockGlassShuttleNfsdOutpostLocked.suffix: OUTPOST ONLY, TSFMC, Glass, Docking, Locked

AirlockGlassShuttleNfsdCapitalLocked.name: AirlockGlassShuttleNfsdCapitalLocked
AirlockGlassShuttleNfsdCapitalLocked.suffix: CAPITAL ONLY, TSFMC, Glass, Docking, Locked

AirlockHeavy.name: heavy-duty airlock
AirlockHeavy.description: It opens, it closes, and maybe crushes you. An uparmored & more advanced model, for use in heavy industrial & military applications. Faster & smoother opening, more strength, and more deadly when crushing you.

AirlockHeavyGlass.name: heavy-duty glass airlock
AirlockHeavyGlass.description: It opens, it closes, and maybe crushes you. An uparmored & more advanced model, for use in heavy industrial & military applications. Faster & smoother opening, more strength, and more deadly when crushing you.

AirlockHeavyAssembly.name: heavy-duty airlock assembly
AirlockHeavyAssembly.description: It opens, it closes, and maybe crushes you. An uparmored & more advanced model, for use in heavy industrial & military applications. Faster & smoother opening, more strength, and more deadly when crushing you.

AirlockExternalShuttleMieyoLockedOutpost.name: AirlockExternalShuttleMieyoLockedOutpost
AirlockExternalShuttleMieyoLockedOutpost.suffix: ТОЛЬКО АВАНПОСТ, Внешний, Стыковочный, ММС, Закрыто

AirlockExternalGlassShuttleMieyoLockedOu.name: AirlockExternalGlassShuttleMieyoLockedOutpost
AirlockExternalGlassShuttleMieyoLockedOu.suffix: ТОЛЬКО АВАНПОСТ, Внешний, Стыковочный, ММС, Закрыто, Стеклянный

BlastDoorIndestructible.name: blast door
BlastDoorIndestructible.description: An exceptionally tough blast door, good luck blasting through this.

BlastDoorMonolithic.name: monolith tenebris crack
BlastDoorMonolithic.description: Some kind of break in the surrounding dark tenebris.

StationAdminBankATMMMC.name: StationAdminBankATMMMC
StationAdminBankATMMMC.description: Used to transfer funds to and from the local MMC account.

TSFNChengduComputer.name: TSFN Chengdu internal hangar console
TSFNChengduComputer.description: Lighter shipyard using the Chengdu's internal hangars, doesn't have access to the full roster of TSFMC ships.

JupiterCarrierComputer.name: jupiter shipyard console
JupiterCarrierComputer.description: Lighter shipyard using the Jupiter's internal hangars, doesn't have access to the full roster of Phaethon Dynasty ships.

ComputerShuttleTSFNVWS.name: shuttle console
ComputerShuttleTSFNVWS.description: Used to pilot a shuttle. This one is outfitted with a TSFN VWS for missile warning tones.

ShuttleConsoleCircuitboardTSFN.name: shuttle console board (TSFN VWS)
ShuttleConsoleCircuitboardTSFN.description: A computer printed circuit board for a shuttle console. This one has a TSFN VWS for missile lock tones.

ComputerShuttleKPV63RWR.name: shuttle console
ComputerShuttleKPV63RWR.description: Used to pilot a shuttle. This one is outfitted with a KPV-63 RWR for missile warning tones.

ShuttleConsoleCircuitboardKPV63RWR.name: shuttle console board (KPV-63 RWR)
ShuttleConsoleCircuitboardKPV63RWR.description: A computer printed circuit board for a shuttle console. This one has a KPV-63 RWR for missile lock tones.

ComputerShuttleANALR67RWR.name: shuttle console
ComputerShuttleANALR67RWR.description: Used to pilot a shuttle. This one is outfitted with a AN/ALR-67 RWR for missile warning tones.

ShuttleConsoleCircuitboardANALR67RWR.name: shuttle console board (AN/ALR-67 RWR)
ShuttleConsoleCircuitboardANALR67RWR.description: A computer printed circuit board for a shuttle console. This one has a AN/ALR-67 RWR for missile lock tones.

MieyoComputerComms.name: mieyo communications computer
MieyoComputerComms.description: The primary communications computer for issuing MMC announcements.

ComputerEliteRadar.name: elite radar computer
ComputerEliteRadar.description: A radar using rare, pre-fracture bluespace technology to detect enemies from even farther away.

ComputerStationRadar.name: overwatch radar computer
ComputerStationRadar.description: A visual uplink to a station's advanced, long-range intelligence suite, allowing commanders to have eyes on unfolding combat at all times.

RogueComputerComms.name: imperial vanguard communications computer
RogueComputerComms.description: The Imperial Vanguard's primary communications computer for issuing announcements.

ComputerShipyardUSSP.name: USSP shipyard console
ComputerShipyardUSSP.description: Used to buy ships from USSP naval reserves.

ComputerShipyardSHM.name: SHM shipyard console
ComputerShipyardSHM.description: Used to transfer ships from the SHM employ reserves.

ComputerShipyardDrakeIndustries.name: drake industries shipyard console
ComputerShipyardDrakeIndustries.description: Used by Drake Industries affiliates to purchase specialty cargo shuttles.

ComputerShipyardViper.name: Viper Group shipyard console
ComputerShipyardViper.description: Used to import ships from various manufacturers.

ComputerShipyardMMC.name: MMC shipyard console
ComputerShipyardMMC.description: Used to transfer ships from the MMC employ reserves.

TSFComputerComms.name: TSFMC communications computer
TSFComputerComms.description: A communications console used by Trans-Solar installations to make sector-wide announcements.

GunneryServerBase.name: gunnery control server
GunneryServerBase.description: Manages the remote operation of ship weapons.

ComputerGunneryConsole.name: gunnery control console
ComputerGunneryConsole.description: Interfaces with the gunnery control server to operate ship weapons.

SyndicateBombSilicon.name: modified syndicate bomb
SyndicateBombSilicon.description: A bomb for Syndicate operatives and agents alike. Looks like this one explodes from physical impact

TSFBomb.name: TSF 'Hiroshima' bunker buster
TSFBomb.description: A explosive device designed to decimate enemy fortifications.

PDVBomb.name: PDV 'Adam' bunker buster
PDVBomb.description: A explosive device designed to decimate enemy fortifications.

MachineCarpCaller.name: carp caller
MachineCarpCaller.description: A device that seems interesting to wild space carp.

StationAiUploadComputerUnlocked.name: AI upload console
