MobBloodCultistZealotRanged.description: Adorned in matching red robes symbolizing devotion to their dark deity, each member is eager to prove their loyalty in the most gruesome ways.

MobBloodCultistCaster.name: blood cult zealot
MobBloodCultistCaster.description: Adorned in matching red robes symbolizing devotion to their dark deity, each member is eager to prove their loyalty in the most gruesome ways.

MobBloodCultLeech.name: blood leech
MobBloodCultLeech.description: This cultist, once human, is now a twisted and corrupted abomination, its body warped and distorted by the dark energies of Nar'Sie's influence.

MobBloodCultistAscended.name: ascended cultist
MobBloodCultistAscended.description: Elevated above their mortal forms by Nar'Sie herself as a reward for their devotion.

MobBloodCultDrainedOne.name: drained one
MobBloodCultDrainedOne.description: A tortured soul, stripped of free will and left as a mere shadow of a human, enslaved and bound to obey its captors.

MobBloodCultShade.name: cultist shade
MobBloodCultShade.description: A cultist's shade, brought back to reality through foul means to gather more blood.

BloodCultTurret.name: blood pylon
BloodCultTurret.description: Through blood rites, the entrapped souls of sacrificed cultists have been gathered in this pylon to defend their living members. Behaves like a sentry turret.

MobFleshJaredExpeditions.name: MobFleshJaredExpeditions
MobFleshJaredExpeditions.description: A mindless meat shield who charges threats directly. Weaker than the average human.

MobFleshGolemExpeditions.name: MobFleshGolemExpeditions
MobFleshGolemExpeditions.description: A mindless brute with a heavy build. A bit more resilient than other flesh monsters, but less agile.

MobFleshAssimilatedMiner.name: MobFleshAssimilatedMiner
MobFleshAssimilatedMiner.description: An unfortunate miner that was infected upon contact with aberrant flesh and has been slowly assimilated.

MobFleshClampExpeditions.name: MobFleshClampExpeditions
MobFleshClampExpeditions.description: A flying flesh monster that can shoot spikes or toothy creatures that can latch on.

MobFleshLoverExpeditions.name: MobFleshLoverExpeditions
MobFleshLoverExpeditions.description: The Lover's light frame makes it fragile, but capable of flight.

MobHorrorExpeditions.name: aberrant flesh horror
MobHorrorExpeditions.description: Tougher and more resilient than most aberrant flesh monsters. Has sharp, bony protrusions and highly developed musculature.

BoneSpikeGun.name: bone spike
BoneSpikeGun.description: Shoots a short salvo of bone spikes.

ActionBoneSpike.name: [color=yellow]Bone Spike[/color]
ActionBoneSpike.description: Shoot a short salvo of bone spikes laced with toxins. [color=yellow]5 second cooldown.[/color]

MobMawExpeditions.name: aberrant flesh maw
MobMawExpeditions.description: Immobile, flesh-boring creatures that are launched at victims. Latches on until killed or shaken off. Don't put your fingers in it.

MobArgocyteSlurvaExpeditions.name: slurva
MobArgocyteSlurvaExpeditions.description: The first lifecycle stage of the Stalker morphotype. A pathetic creature, incapable of doing much. It is better to kill it now before it has a chance to mature.

MobArgocyteSkitterExpeditions.name: skitter
MobArgocyteSkitterExpeditions.description: The second lifecycle stage of the Stalker morphotype. Still small, these creatures tend to travel in small packs for safety.

MobArgocyteSwiperExpeditions.name: swiper
MobArgocyteSwiperExpeditions.description: The third lifecycle stage of the Stalker morphotype. Roaming scavengers, usually out on reconnaisance or gathering materials.

MobArgocyteGliderExpeditions.name: glider
MobArgocyteGliderExpeditions.description: The fourth lifecycle stage of the Stalker morphotype. Born and bred hunters, these stalk and prey upon smaller wildlife.

MobArgocyteCrawlerExpeditions.name: crawler
MobArgocyteCrawlerExpeditions.description: The fifth lifecycle stage of the Stalker morphotype. These deadly pack animals ambush and maul unsuspecting travelers.

MobArgocyteFounderExpeditions.name: founder
MobArgocyteFounderExpeditions.description: The last known lifecycle stage of the Stalker morphotype. Most often seen in mature hives preparing for an expansion.

MobArgocyteBarrierExpeditions.name: barrier
MobArgocyteBarrierExpeditions.description: The first lifecycle stage of the Guardian morphotype. Equally as pathetic as the "Slurva". Not yet fully formed, its protective plates are still soft.

MobArgocyteMolderExpeditions.name: molder
MobArgocyteMolderExpeditions.description: The second lifecycle stage of the Guardian morphotype. Usually seen building and repairing structures in the hive.

MobArgocytePouncerExpeditions.name: pouncer
MobArgocytePouncerExpeditions.description: The third lifecycle stage of the Guardian morphotype. Provides rapid response for minor threats to the hive.

MobArgocyteHarvesterExpeditions.name: harvester
MobArgocyteHarvesterExpeditions.description: A mutation that develops in the third lifecycle stage of the Guardian morphotype. "Harvesters" use their highly caustic saliva to break down and process materials for the hive.

MobArgocyteEnforcerExpeditions.name: enforcer
MobArgocyteEnforcerExpeditions.description: The fourth lifecycle stage of the Guardian morphotype. The main guards of the hive, these fend off would-be attackers.

MobArgocyteLeviathingExpeditions.name: leviathing
MobArgocyteLeviathingExpeditions.description: The final known lifecycle stage of the Guardian morphotype. These hulking beasts lead attacks on the hive's enemies.

MobDinosaurCompyExpeditions.name: compsognathus
MobDinosaurCompyExpeditions.description: Compsognathus is a genus of small, bipedal, carnivorous theropods. They have long hind legs and longer tails, which they used for balance during locomotion. Their forelimbs are small but beware of their claws.

MobDinosaurDiloExpeditions.name: dilophosaurus
MobDinosaurDiloExpeditions.description: With a name meaning "two-crested lizard", these measure in at about 7 m in length and 400 kg in weight. Slender and lightly built, these are very agile.

MobDinosaurRaptorExpeditions.name: velociraptor
MobDinosaurRaptorExpeditions.description: A bipedal, featherless carnivore with a long tail. Each of its hindfeet has an enlarged sickle-shaped claw, which is used to tackle and restrain prey. Very fast, exercise caution.

MobDinosaurParaExpeditions.name: parasaurolophus
MobDinosaurParaExpeditions.description: A large carnivore that can reach over 9 metres (30 ft) long and weigh over 5 metric tons (5.5 short tons), these can move on two legs or four. Reasonably fast for its size, but comparatively fragile and weak.

MobDinosaurKentroExpeditions.name: kentrosaurus
MobDinosaurKentroExpeditions.description: On the smaller side of dinosaurs, Kentrosaurus generally measure around 4–4.5 m, and weigh about 700–1,600 kg. Its elongated head and beak are used to bite off plant material or tear off limbs.

MobDinosaurTrikeExpeditions.name: triceratops
MobDinosaurTrikeExpeditions.description: Bearing a large bony frill with three horns on its skull, this massive quadruped is one of the most recognizable of all dinosaurs and the best-known ceratopsian. Typically tries to gore whatever it attacks.

MobDinosaurAnkiExpeditions.name: ankylosaurus
MobDinosaurAnkiExpeditions.description: Typically between between 6 and 8 meters long and between 4.8 and 8 tons in weight, this lumbering beast shouldn't be underestimated. Its wide, low skull and robust body can take a beating and still survive, and the large club on the end of its tail can be used as a weapon.

MobDinosaurSpinoExpeditions.name: spinosaurus
MobDinosaurSpinoExpeditions.description: With a typical length of 14 m and a mass of 7.4 tons, Spinosaurus has large, robust forelimbs. Each of its hands has three-fingers, with an enlarged claw on the first digit. Surprisingly quick for its size, this giant can take a lot of punishment.

MobDinosaurStegoExpeditions.name: stegosaurus
MobDinosaurStegoExpeditions.description: Large and heavily built, these herbivorous quadrupeds have rounded backs, short fore limbs, long hind limbs, and tails held high in the air. Lumbering, but lethal up close.

MobDinosaurTrexExpeditions.name: tyrannosaurus
MobDinosaurTrexExpeditions.description: A massive therapod, its giant thorax is balanced by a long, heavy tail. Relative to its large and powerful hind limbs, the forelimbs of Tyrannosaurus are short but incredible powerful for their size, and they have two clawed digits.

MobExplorerMeleeT1.name: looter
MobExplorerMeleeT1.description: Armed with a trusty pickaxe and greed, every group needs its grunts.

MobExplorerRangedT1.name: scrapper
MobExplorerRangedT1.description: Proto-kinetic accelerator in one hand, flashlight in the other, beer in the belly. That's how you explore.

MobExplorerMeleeT2.name: scavenger
MobExplorerMeleeT2.description: A looter that scavenged enough coins to afford some decent equipment.

MobExplorerRangedT2.name: salvager
MobExplorerRangedT2.description: Sawn-off proto-kinetic accelerator in one hand, crusher dagger in the other, magm-ale both in the belly and in the hardsuit's boots.

MobExplorerMeleeT3.name: miner
MobExplorerMeleeT3.description: Drilling in the name of... drilling. No rock formation can withstand the power of dual-wielded mining drills - good thing you aren't a rock.

MobExplorerRangedT3.name: explorer
MobExplorerRangedT3.description: Veteran scrappers, these salvagers are wealthy enough to explore abandoned ruins for the adrenaline rush and adventure alone.

MobExplorerHauler.name: hauler
MobExplorerHauler.description: Loaded with heavy equipment for industrial-scale looting. Pardon me, "asset recovery".

MobExplorerBoss.name: explorer captain
MobExplorerBoss.description: Fearless and battle-hardened salvage team leaders, it takes years picking through the darkest corners of space and navigating the galaxy's criminal underbelly of the galaxy before you can become a captain. Not to be underestimated.

ActionSeismicCharge.name: [color=yellow]Throw Seismic Charge[/color]
ActionSeismicCharge.description: Hurls activated seismic charge, that explodes on contact. [color=yellow]50 second cooldown.[/color]

MobMercenarySoldierKnife.name: mercenary soldier
MobMercenarySoldierKnife.description: Low-ranking soldiers armed with a variety of surplus weapons.

MobMercenarySoldierPistol.name: mercenary soldier
MobMercenarySoldierPistol.description: Low-ranking soldiers armed with a variety of surplus weapons.

MobMercenarySoldierNovalite.name: mercenary soldier
MobMercenarySoldierNovalite.description: Low-ranking soldiers armed with a variety of surplus weapons.

MobMercenaryBreacherMachete.name: mercenary breacher
MobMercenaryBreacherMachete.description: Shock troopers that specialize in using the element of surprise and swift, aggressive action to achieve their objectives.

MobMercenarySoldierRevolver.name: mercenary breacher
MobMercenarySoldierRevolver.description: Shock troopers that specialize in using the element of surprise and swift, aggressive action to achieve their objectives.

MobMercenaryBreacherShotgun.name: mercenary breacher
MobMercenaryBreacherShotgun.description: Shock troopers that specialize in using the element of surprise and swift, aggressive action to achieve their objectives.

MobMercenarySpecialistMedic.name: mercenary paramedic
MobMercenarySpecialistMedic.description: Experienced mercenaries, specialists are practised and proficient in combat or support roles, possibly both.

MobMercenaryCaptain.name: mercenary captain
MobMercenaryCaptain.description: The leaders of these bands of brigands, a mercenary captain is both cruel and lethally effective. Exercise caution.

MobPunkGangerLeader.name: punk gang leader
MobPunkGangerLeader.description: It takes a formidable figure to lead a pack of street trash. These leaders usually wield scavenged SMGs and wear armor taken from unfortunate security forces. Usually high on meth and booze.

ActionThrowPartyNade.name: [color=yellow]Throw a party 'nade[/color]
ActionThrowPartyNade.description: Hurls activated party 'nade filled with party chems, explodes on contact. [color=yellow]20 second cooldown.[/color]

MobRogueSiliconDroneLethals.name: MobRogueSiliconDroneLethals
MobRogueSiliconDroneLethals.description: Hacked by a rogue AI, these security drones are programmed to kill.

MobRogueSiliconDroneNonLethals.name: MobRogueSiliconDroneNonLethals
MobRogueSiliconDroneNonLethals.description: These engineering drones are capable of shooting disabler bolts. Dangerous in combination with other enemies.

MobRogueSiliconDroneScience.name: MobRogueSiliconDroneScience
MobRogueSiliconDroneScience.description: A science drone, this rogue drone comes equipped with an experimental C.H.I.M.P. cannon.

MobRogueSiliconViscerator.name: viscerator unit
MobRogueSiliconViscerator.description: Small, quick, and nimble, these drones are designed to chase its targets through narrow areas and incapacitate those it catches. Often accompanies catcher units.

MobRogueSiliconServo.name: servo unit
MobRogueSiliconServo.description: With its programming rewritten, this crash test dummy will stop at nothing in exacting its revenge.

MobRogueSiliconHerder.name: herder unit
MobRogueSiliconHerder.description: This rogue silicon unit's primary directive is to corral and herd captives. Its stun prod can be used to good effect, take caution.

MobRogueSiliconHunter.name: hunter unit
MobRogueSiliconHunter.description: These mobile drones are tasked with reconnaissance, threat identification, and target elimination.

MobRogueSiliconCatcher.name: catcher unit
MobRogueSiliconCatcher.description: Equipped with bolas, this unit is designed to slow, capture, and detain targets.

MobRogueSiliconTesla.name: tesla unit
MobRogueSiliconTesla.description: Originally designed to service tesla power generators, this silicon's equipment has been repurposed as a makeshift stun gun.

MobRogueSiliconGuardian.name: guardian unit
MobRogueSiliconGuardian.description: An advanced security silicon, typically used to safeguard high-security areas such as vaults and server rooms. After being hacked, this unit carries out the AI's will.

MobRogueSiliconBoss.name: one star unit
MobRogueSiliconBoss.description: An autonomous combat-grade mech, typically used for offensive operations. Now a rogue AI's elite guard. Equipped with missile launchers, exercise extreme caution.

MobSyndicateNavalCaptainA.name: wayward captain
MobSyndicateNavalCaptainA.description: Long gone from home, hollowed out from emissions. Expect a fight. Seems to be armed with a revolver.

MobSyndicateNavalEngineerA.name: wayward engineer
MobSyndicateNavalEngineerA.description: Long gone from home, hollowed out from emissions. Expect a fight. Seems to be armed with a shotgun.

MobSyndicateNavalMedicA.name: wayward medic
MobSyndicateNavalMedicA.description: Long gone from home, hollowed out from emissions. Expect a fight. Seems to have a pouch of darts.

MobSyndicateNavalSecondOfficerA.name: wayward second officer
MobSyndicateNavalSecondOfficerA.description: Long gone from home, hollowed out from emissions. Expect a fight. Seems to be armed with a laser pistol.

MobSyndicateNavalOperatorA.name: wayward operative
MobSyndicateNavalOperatorA.description: Long gone from home, hollowed out from emissions. Expect a fight. Looks to have an SMG.

MobSyndicateNavalGrenadierA.name: wayward grenadier
MobSyndicateNavalGrenadierA.description: Long gone from home, hollowed out from emissions. Expect a fight. HOLY SHIT, THAT GUY HAS A BOMB!

MobSyndicateNavalSaboteurA.name: wayward saboteur
MobSyndicateNavalSaboteurA.description: Long gone from home, hollowed out from emissions. Seems armed with a shocking gun.

MobExperimentationVictim.name: wayward captive
MobExperimentationVictim.description: Long gone from home, hollowed out from emissions and whatever their captors did to them.

MobSyndicateNavalCommanderA.name: wayward commander
MobSyndicateNavalCommanderA.description: Long gone from home, hollowed out from emissions. Your target.

MobSyndicateNavalDeckhandA.name: wayward deckhand
MobSyndicateNavalDeckhandA.description: Long gone from home, hollowed out from emissions. Looks like it has a gun.

MobSyndicateNavalMime.name: wayward mime
MobSyndicateNavalMime.description: Long gone from home, hollowed out from emissions... or was it always this way?

MobSyndicateNavalChemwarriorA.name: wayward chemwarrior
MobSyndicateNavalChemwarriorA.description: Long gone from home, hollowed out from emissions. Seems to have janitorial equipment..?

MobCatClippy.name: Clippy
MobCatClippy.description: It looks like you’re writing a letter, would you like help?

MobCatClarpy.name: Clarpy
MobCatClarpy.description: First cat to gain a bounty.

MobCatCappy.name: Cappy
MobCatCappy.description: First cat to shoot a gun.

MobCatBloodCult.name: blood cult cat
MobCatBloodCult.description: Founded the Blood Cult out of boredom.

ActionEldritchPush.name: [color=yellow]Force Push[/color]
ActionEldritchPush.description: Summon forth an eldritch hand. [color=yellow]5 minute cooldown.[/color]

MobKoboldYipyip.name: Yip Yip
MobKoboldYipyip.description: He lives in a pineapple on the Frontier!

MobCleanBotSyndie.name: syndicate cleanbot
MobCleanBotSyndie.description: The creep of automation now threatening space janitors with a knife.

MobGoblinDummy.name: Urist McGoblin
MobGoblinDummy.description: A dummy goblin meant to be used in character setup.

DrinkAstrotameJug.name: astrotame jug
DrinkAstrotameJug.description: The sweetness of a thousand sugars but none of the calories. Put it in your coffee.

DrinkColdsauceJug.name: coldsauce jug
DrinkColdsauceJug.description: Something to make every meal a little cooler.

DrinkHotsauceJug.name: hotsauce jug
DrinkHotsauceJug.description: The antithesis of no more tears shampoo.

DrinkKetchupJug.name: ketchup jug
DrinkKetchupJug.description: Someone filled a tomato with sugar until it burst. Delicious.

DrinkMustardJug.name: mustard jug
DrinkMustardJug.description: All of the implications of real mustard with none of the flavor.

DrinkSoysauceJug.name: soy sauce jug
DrinkSoysauceJug.description: You can only dream of putting some of this on a bowl of rice.

CondimentCup.name: condiment cup
CondimentCup.description: A flimsy cup that can be filled with condiments. Warranty void if filled with other things.

DrinkIceBucketEmpty.name: ice bucket
DrinkIceBucketEmpty.description: A special bucket that was specifically designed to hold ice.

FoodBreadChallah.name: honey challah
FoodBreadChallah.description: Twisted bread sprinkled with poppy seeds.

FoodBreadChallahSlice.name: challah slice
FoodBreadChallahSlice.description: A slice of poppy and honey, oh my!

FoodDonutUncooked.name: uncooked donut
FoodDonutUncooked.description: Needs a moment in the deep fryer, then it'll be good to eat.

FoodBakedCookieDivine.name: divine cookie
FoodBakedCookieDivine.description: This cookie looks incredibly delicious. Whoever made it must really appreciate you.

FoodBakedMuffinPear.name: pear muffin
FoodBakedMuffinPear.description: I won't tell if you just try to pick out the chocolate.

FoodBakedAppleStrudelBite.name: apple strudel bite
FoodBakedAppleStrudelBite.description: Just put a little icing on top and enjoy!

FoodPieAppleHoney.description: A pie full of honey-laced apples baked under a crumbly oat streusel topping.

FoodPieAppleHoneySlice.description: A slice of honey-laced apples baked under a crumbly oat streusel topping.

FoodCondimentSqueezeBottleClear.description: When it comes to squeeze bottles this is the clear choice.

FoodCondimentBottleSoysauce.description: Used to season dishes to umami perfection. With extra sodium!

FoodBurgerRosyMothRoach.name: rosy mothroachburger
FoodBurgerRosyMothRoach.description: The last lamp it saw was the one inside the microwave.

FoodFrozenMochi.description: A delicious blorb of chewey sticky rice encapsulating a core of ice cream. Tasty!

FoodFrozenMochiBungo.description: A delicious blorb of chewey sticky rice encapsulating a core of ice cream. It's bungo flavored!

FoodFrozenMochiCherry.name: cherry mochi
FoodFrozenMochiCherry.description: A delicious blorb of chewey sticky rice encapsulating a core of ice cream. It's cherry flavored!

FoodFrozenMochiChocolate.name: chocolate mochi
FoodFrozenMochiChocolate.description: A delicious blorb of chewey sticky rice encapsulating a core of ice cream. It's chocolate flavored!

FoodFrozenMochiFiber.name: fiber mochi
FoodFrozenMochiFiber.description: A delicious blorb of chewey sticky rice encapsulating a core of ice cream. It's woven with fiber!

FoodFrozenMochiMoth.name: rosy mochi
FoodFrozenMochiMoth.description: A delicious blorb of chewey sticky rice encapsulating a core of ice cream. It's almost too cute to eat! Almost.

FoodFrozenMochiTea.name: tea mochi
FoodFrozenMochiTea.description: A delicious blorb of chewey sticky rice encapsulating a core of ice cream. It's infused with tea!

FoodFrozenMochiUbe.name: ube mochi
FoodFrozenMochiUbe.description: A delicious blorb of chewey sticky rice encapsulating a core of ice cream. You're not sure if it's really ube.

ReagentContainerRaisin.description: A big bag of raisins. Good for baking!

FoodCoffeeBeansRoastedMedium.name: medium roasted coffee beans
FoodCoffeeBeansRoastedMedium.description: City roast coffee beans. Smooth and nutty.

FoodCoffeeBeansRoastedDark.name: dark roasted coffee beans
FoodCoffeeBeansRoastedDark.description: Viennese roast coffee beans. Smoky and spicy.

ReagentContainerHoney.name: honey bottle
ReagentContainerHoney.description: A big squeeze bottle of honey. Great for sweetening up your day!

FoodDoughFlatPastry.description: A buttery, rolled out pastry dough.

FoodRiceDough.name: rice dough
FoodRiceDough.description: You're pretty sure this is just rice and water. You have no idea how it's holding together.

FoodSausageRaw.description: A simple sausage. Who knows what's in this thing?

FoodSausageCasing.name: sausage casing
FoodSausageCasing.description: The intestine or some equivalent of some poor creature out there..

FoodBreadAvocadoToast.description: It was this or home ownership.

FoodMealBreakfastBagel.name: breakfast bagel
FoodMealBreakfastBagel.description: For when your morning egg sandwich needs a touch of green and quadruple the asking price.

FoodMealBreakfastBagelPoppy.name: poppyseed breakfast bagel
FoodMealBreakfastBagelPoppy.description: The miners breakfast. Take a bite everytime you get punched in the face.

FoodMealCucumberSandwich.description: They forgot to cut the crusts off AGAIN.

FoodSaladAvocado.description: You were so close to making guacamole. So close.

FoodMealPearsBelleHelene.description: The delicate flavor of the immaculate pear drenched in chocolate.

FoodMeatChickenCutletBattered.description: A cut of chicken, dredged in a gloopy flour and egg mixture.

FoodCuredCarpBattered.description: A slice of fresh space fish, dredged in a gloopy flour and egg mixture.

FoodMeatGlazedHamSlice.description: A slice of wonderful ham, glazed in delicious honey.

FoodMeatGoblin.description: Just look at that marbling! Wait, is that microplastic?

FoodPickleSlice.description: Like tangy crispy water, but smaller.

FoodPotatoSlice.description: Raw potato sticks ready for the deep fryer.

CrossbowBoltEMP.description: A bolt with small power cell attached to it.

CrossbowBoltIncendiary.name: incendiary bolt
CrossbowBoltIncendiary.description: A bolt with a flare attached to it.

CrossbowBoltShrapnel.name: shrapnel bolt
CrossbowBoltShrapnel.description: A bolt with a buckshot shotgun shell attached to it.

CrossbowBoltBloodDrinker.name: blood drinker bolt
CrossbowBoltBloodDrinker.description: A razor-sharp bolt with a serrated tip. Unquestionably unethical.

BulletBBDamaged.name: damaged BB
BulletBBDamaged.description: Did you shoot your eye out?

BulletRGBB.name: RGBB
BulletRGBB.description: Don't shoot your eye out, gamer.

BulletRGBBDamaged.name: damaged RGBB
BulletRGBBDamaged.description: Did you shoot your eye out, gamer?

WeaponRevolverArgenti.name: Argenti (5.56x45mm)
WeaponRevolverArgenti.description: The civilian grade Argenti Type 20 revolver. Manufactured by Silver Industries. While the design with expanded cylinder is quite ancient, the right gunslinger will know how to utilise it well. Uses 5.56x45mm ammo.

WeaponRifleGestio.name: PA Gestio (7.62x39mm)
WeaponRifleGestio.description: An old burst-fire rifle that never left trials. Accepts low capacity 762x39mm magazines.

WeaponRifleNovaliteC1.name: LWC Novalite C1 (5.56x45mm)
WeaponRifleNovaliteC1.description: A modification to the Lecter from LWC, a civilian grade semi-automatic rifle with an internal magazine. Uses 5.56x45mm ammo.

WeaponRifleSVS.name: NCI SVS-42 (7.62x54mmR)
WeaponRifleSVS.description: Originally designed by Samonov, this old surplus rifle looks like it's seen a few wars. Uses low capacity 10 rounder 762x54mmR magazines. Equipped with bayonet.

WeaponRifleGestioPMC.name: PA Gestio (7.62x39mm)
WeaponRifleGestioPMC.description: An old burst-fire rifle that never left trials. Accepts low capacity 762x39mm magazines. Acquired legally from a licensed provider.

WeaponSniperRepeater.name: N2524 Pattern Repeater (.45 magnum)
WeaponSniperRepeater.description: A civilian grade lever action firearm, favored by space cowboys across the Frontier for its reliability and stopping power. Uses .45 magnum ammo.

WeaponTurretContrabandDenyingDeployed.name: CDET
WeaponTurretContrabandDenyingDeployed.description: A Contraband Denying Energy Turret (CDET). A disabler turret with built-in microreactor. Use screwdriver to disassemble.

WeaponTurretContrabandDenyingPacked.name: packed CDET
WeaponTurretContrabandDenyingPacked.description: A disassembled and packed Contraband Denying Energy Turret (CDET).

WeaponTurretLaserNanoTrasenDeployed.name: SLAT
WeaponTurretLaserNanoTrasenDeployed.description: A Self-Recharging Laser Auto Turret (SLAT). A laser turret with built-in microreactor. Use screwdriver to disassemble.

WeaponTurretLaserNanoTrasenPacked.name: packed SLAT
WeaponTurretLaserNanoTrasenPacked.description: A disassembled and packed Self-Recharging Laser Auto Turret (SLAT).

WeaponTurretAsmgtNtDeployed.name: ASMGT
WeaponTurretAsmgtNtDeployed.description: An Autonomous Sentry Machine Gun Turret (ASMGT) is a magazine-fed turret with barrels compatible with 5.56x45mm, 7.62x39mm, 9x19mm and 6.35x40mm cartridges. Use screwdriver to disassemble. This one is reinforced and has a Colonial Security IFF reader.

WeaponTurretAsmgtNtPacked.name: packed CSec ASMGT
WeaponTurretAsmgtNtPacked.description: A disassembled and packed Autonomous Sentry Machine Gun Turret (ASMGT) for Colonial Security.

WeaponTurretAsmgtHostileUniversallyDeplo.name: WeaponTurretAsmgtHostileUniversallyDeployed
WeaponTurretAsmgtHostileUniversallyDeplo.description: An Autonomous Sentry Machine Gun Turret (ASMGT) is a magazine-fed turret with barrels compatible with 5.56x45mm, 7.62x39mm, 9x19mm and 6.35x40mm cartridges. Use screwdriver to disassemble. This one is a Civilian model for shipboard defense in hostile sectors, with reduced armor plating and a restricted firerate to comply with interstellar commerce law.

WeaponTurretAsmgtHostileUniversallyPacke.name: packed Civilian ASMGT
WeaponTurretAsmgtHostileUniversallyPacke.description: A disassembled and packed Civilian-model Autonomous Sentry Machine Gun Turret (ASMGT). WARNING! Unpacked turret will be hostile towards anyone who wasn't in close proximity (within 3 m) after unpacking!

WeaponBrassKnuckles.name: brass knuckles
WeaponBrassKnuckles.description: When you need to punch just a little harder.

CavemanClubCursed.name: caveman club
CavemanClubCursed.description: Big stick make big... this no wood?

EnergySwordNfsd.name: TSFMC energy sword
EnergySwordNfsd.description: A very loud & dangerous sword with a beam made of pure, concentrated plasma. Cuts through unarmored targets like butter.

NFEnergyPickaxe.name: holopickaxe
NFEnergyPickaxe.description: A holographic mining tool with blades comprised of hard light. Doesn't pack the same punch as an energy weapon, but more compact than most mining tools when turned off.

PirateBreachingAnchor.name: pirate anchor
PirateBreachingAnchor.description: A large, heavy anchor to beat down anyone and anything standing between you and your plunder.

PlasteelArmingSword.name: plasteel arming sword
PlasteelArmingSword.description: An ancient design manufactured with modern materials and machines for a very specific target demographic.

WizardStaffMeleeBase.name: wizard staff
WizardStaffMeleeBase.description: Symbol of wizard's mastery of arcane arts.

WoodenStake.name: wooden stake
WoodenStake.description: Essential appliance for pitching tents and killing vampires.

PirateGrenadeRadiation.name: green pirate grenade
PirateGrenadeRadiation.description: A foul-smelling grenade that makes you feel fuzzy.

PirateGrenadeConcussion.name: gray pirate grenade
PirateGrenadeConcussion.description: A solid grenade that feels like a cannonball.

PirateGrenadeFire.name: red pirate grenade
PirateGrenadeFire.description: A grenade that's hot to the touch; prone to catch things on fire.

GrilleDungeon.description: A grille covered in soot and grime.

AltarFrameNF.description: Altar of the Gods. Kinda hollow to be honest.

NFBedroll.name: bedroll
NFBedroll.description: When there's nowhere else to sleep, you'll want to bring at least one thing of comfort. The tag on it states to unfold it before rest, but who needs rules anyway, right?

NFBedrollStained.name: NFBedrollStained
NFBedrollStained.description: Glamping used to look different back in my days.

IceboxEmpty.name: ice box
IceboxEmpty.description: This delightful machine is slowly filling with ice!

TableFolding.name: folding table
TableFolding.description: If you carry six of these you become the coolest kid at church.

ToiletDirtyWaterMcCargo.name: mccargo toilet
ToiletDirtyWaterMcCargo.description: The HT-451MC is the McCargo version of the device. It says on the side that it is made of fake gold and a a fake leather seat.

HolosignNfsd.name: TSFMC holographic barrier
HolosignNfsd.description: A barrier of hard light that blocks movement, but pretty weak.

ComputerAdvancedRadar.name: advanced radar computer
ComputerAdvancedRadar.description: This advanced radar lets you detect far away objects for an increased tactical advantage.

ComputerPirateBountyRedemption.name: bounty redemption console

KitchenAssembler.description: Assembles and prepares NT-approved meals. You don't know what it's doing in there.

VendingMachineCuddlyCritterVend.name: CuddlyCritterVend

VendingMachinePottedPlantVend.description: Sometimes potted plants are the best crewmates money can get.

VendingMachineNfsdDrobe.description: A vending machine for TSFMC clothing!

VendingMachineFuelVend.name: FuelVend
VendingMachineFuelVend.description: A vendor selling fuel for ship engines. Smells like ozone.

VendingMachineCiviMedPlus.name: CiviMed Plus

GaslockFrame.name: portable gaslock
GaslockFrame.description: Pumps gas through. Accepts docking, but cannot dock. Both sides must be docked and pumping in the same direction for gas to flow.

GasMiningDrill.name: gas mining drill
GasMiningDrill.description: A powerful, luggable drill for mining gas deposits on asteroids. Outputs gas through a pipe.

GasSalePoint.name: gas sale point
GasSalePoint.description: Gas piped into here can be sold using the linked console. Bluespace linked to massive storage vaults off-site.

PortableGeneratorDK.name: D-K-type portable generator
PortableGeneratorDK.description:
A prototype Dunn-Kikko fission reactor. Use with caution.
Runs off bananium and is rated for up to 120 kW.
Highly radioactive without protection.

PortableGeneratorDKJr.name: D-K Jr.-type portable generator
PortableGeneratorDKJr.description:
A miniaturized Dunn-Kikko fission reactor. Use with caution.
Runs off bananium and is rated for up to 100 kW.
Quite radioactive without protection.

CrateTradeSecureNormal.name: cargo trading crate
CrateTradeSecureNormal.description: Contains goods made in the Frontier sector, ready to be sold at a cargo depot for higher value. MAKE SURE THE CRATE IS INTACT.

CrateTradeSecureHigh.name: express cargo trading crate
CrateTradeSecureHigh.description: An urgent crate of goods made in the Frontier sector, ready to be quickly sold at a cargo depot for higher value. MAKE SURE THE CRATE IS INTACT.

AberrantFleshDigestiveSack.name: assimilation sack
AberrantFleshDigestiveSack.description: Huh, an assimilation sack? How do I even know this?

ArgocyteEgg.name: argocyte egg
ArgocyteEgg.description: Looks more like a fossil than egg.

BloodCollector.name: blood collector
BloodCollector.description: A vile chamber filled with blood. Seems to hold more than it's volume.

BloodCultAlwaysPoweredLight.name: blood cult light
BloodCultAlwaysPoweredLight.description: How is this thing glowing? Why?

DinosaurEgg.description: Looks more like a fossil than egg.

MercenaryCounterfeitCache.description: Cache with counterfeit credits, bootleg movie posters.

PunkPartySupplies.description: The only thing that can hold a gang together.

CybersunDataMiner.name: cybersun dataminer

LockerWoodenGeneric.name: wooden cabinet
LockerWoodenGeneric.description: Dusty old wooden cabinet. Smells like grandparents.

ClosetO2N2.name: emergency internals closet
ClosetO2N2.description: It's a storage unit for emergency breathing equipment for all species.

NFWardrobePrison.description: It's a storage unit for Space Law compliant prisoner garb.

CratePirateGrey.name: pirate chest

CrateWoodCage.description: Looks like somebody made this in a cave, with a box of scraps.

BarSignNeonFlamingos.name: Neon Flamingos
BarSignNeonFlamingos.description: You doubt you'll be able to stand on one leg after you're done here.

BarSignWyvernShipyards.name: Wyvern Shipyards
BarSignWyvernShipyards.description: Have a seat, relax and don't worry, the future can't come any faster!

PaintingNightOfThePostGoblin.name: Night Of The Post Goblin

PaintingSpookyLady.name: The Lady and the Banners
PaintingSpookyLady.description: A woman stands invitingly before a castle of ominous portent. How the windows beckon! How your gaze is arrested!

PaintingFireaxeCabinet.name: The Fireaxe Cabinet
PaintingFireaxeCabinet.description: This painting is a masterfully designed image of a fireaxe cabinet. The artwork relates to the loss of the masterwork ☼fireaxe☼ in the early winter of 2523. Oil. Canvas. Tears.

PaintingGhostHanging.name: festive ghost streamers
PaintingGhostHanging.description: Decorative wall streamers! They look like the people you've lost to the void!

PaintingBatHanging.name: festive bat streamers
PaintingBatHanging.description: Decorative wall streamers! Bats are scary and also important pollinators!

PaintingPumpkinHanging.name: festive pumpkin streamers
PaintingPumpkinHanging.description: Decorative wall streamers! It's decorative gourd season!

NFPosterLegitMagnusWatching.name: Always Watching
NFPosterLegitMagnusWatching.description: This poster depicts an ethereal judge. You think you hear a 'BWOINK,' but it is just your imagination, right?

NFPosterLegitGoblinTinkerer.name: Tinkering!
NFPosterLegitGoblinTinkerer.description: This poster depicts a cheerful goblin engineer telling you that explosions are the spice of tinkering.

NFPosterLegitBahamaMama.name: Bahama Mama's

NFPosterLegitWinnerWinner.name: Winner Winner
NFPosterLegitWinnerWinner.description: A mouthwatering looking roast taunts you. So close, yet so far.

NFPosterLegitWantedClarpy.name: Wanted: Clarpy
NFPosterLegitWantedClarpy.description: Wanted for insurgency. Spot them? You can help deal a blow to the Rogue Sector, contact the TSFMC.

NFPosterLegitMothPlease.name: Mothroaches: More Than Pests!

NFPosterLegitHaveYouSeenThisEgg.name: Have You Seen This Egg?

NFPosterContrabandEmsCoords.name: EMS Suit Coordinates Reminder

NFPosterContrabandGoblinate.name: Da Great Space Goblinate!
